Beat mixture at medium speed of electric mixer until spreading consistency. Stir in additional milk, if necessary, to maintain spreading consistency."]

title: Red Wine Vinaigrette
ingredients: ["3 tablespoons Burgundy or other dry red wine", "3 tablespoons red wine vinegar", "1 tablespoon Dijon mustard", "1/2 teaspoon sugar", "1/8 teaspoon pepper", "1/2 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce", "3/4 cup olive oil"]
directions: ["Process first 6 ingredients in a blender until smooth. With blender running, add oil in a slow steady stream."]

title: Curried Currant Couscous Pilaf
ingredients: ["1 tablespoon olive oil", "1/4 cup finely chopped shallots", "1/4 teaspoon curry powder", "1 cup uncooked couscous", "1 1/4 cups fat-free, lower-sodium chicken broth", "1/4 cup dried currants", "1/4 teaspoon salt", "1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley"]
directions: ["Heat a small saucepan over medium-high heat. Add oil to pan, swirling to coat. Add shallots and curry powder; saute 2 minutes or until tender. Stir in couscous; saute 1 minute. Add broth, currants, and salt; bring to a boil. Cover, remove from heat, and let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Stir in parsley."]

title: Roasted Baby Potatoes
ingredients: ["3 pounds thin-skinned potatoes (1 1/2 in. wide), scrubbed", "3 tablespoons olive oil", "Salt and pepper"]
directions: ["In a 10- by 15-inch pan, mix potatoes and oil. Lightly sprinkle with salt and pepper.", "Roast potatoes in a 400\u00b0 oven, shaking pan occasionally, until tender when pierced, 45 to 50 minutes (35 to 40 minutes in convection oven).", "Serve potatoes hot or warm with tarragon aioli.", "Nutritional analysis per serving without aioli."]

title: Creamy Yogurt Dip
ingredients: ["1 (7-ounce) container plain 2% low-fat Greek yogurt", "1 1/2 tablespoons honey", "1/4 teaspoon vanilla extract"]
directions: ["Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, stirring well. Cover and chill until ready to serve.", "for your toddler: Serve the dip with any fruit such as grapes, strawberries, pineapple, or blueberries. Cut the fruit as needed into bite-sized pieces."]

title: Pralines
ingredients: ["Butter", "3/4 cup firmly packed light brown sugar", "3/4 cup sugar", "3/4 cup half-and-half", "3 tablespoons butter or margarine", "1 1/4 cups coarsely chopped pecans", "1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract"]
directions: ["Butter bottom of a heavy 3-quart saucepan. Cook brown sugar and next 3 ingredients in saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, until sugars dissolve; stir in pecans. Bring to a boil over medium heat; cook, stirring occasionally, 6 to 8 minutes or until a candy thermometer registers 238\u00b0 (soft ball stage). Remove from heat.", "Stir in vanilla; let stand 3 minutes. Beat with a wooden spoon 3 minutes or until mixture begins to thicken. Working rapidly, drop by tablespoonfuls onto wax paper. Let stand until firm."]

title: Favorite Chocolate Fudge
ingredients: ["2 cups sugar", "2 cups firmly packed brown sugar", "4 (1-ounce) squares unsweetened chocolate, grated", "2 (5.33-ounce) cans evaporated milk", "1/4 cup butter", "2 teaspoons vanilla extract"]
directions: ["Combine sugar, grated chocolate, and milk in a large Dutch oven; cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves. Cover and continue to cook over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes to wash down sugar crystals from sides of pan. Uncover and cook, stirring occasionally, until mixture reaches soft ball stage (236\u00b0).", "Remove from heat; add butter and vanilla (do not stir). Let stand 15 minutes or until mixture cools to lukewarm (110\u00b0). Beat with a wooden spoon until mixture thickens and begins to lose its gloss.", "Working rapidly, spread mixture in a buttered 9-inch square baking pan. Mark top of warm candy into 1 1/2-inch squares, using a sharp knife. Cool completely before cutting. Store in an airtight container."]

title: Brown Sugar Caramel Icing
ingredients: ["1 cup firmly packed brown sugar", "1 cup half-and-half", "1/2 cup sugar", "1 tablespoon butter or margarine", "1 teaspoon vanilla extract"]
directions: ["Combine first 3 ingredients in a heavy saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until mixture comes to a boil and sugar is dissolved. Continue cooking, stirring frequently, until mixture reaches soft ball stage (240\u00b0).", "Let cool slightly; add butter and vanilla, and beat until spreading consistency."]

title: Chinese Barbecue Sauce
ingredients: ["1/2 cup Chinese barbecue sauce (char siu sauce)", "1/4 cup low-sodium soy sauce", "1 teaspoon sugar"]
directions: ["Combine all ingredients in a small bowl; stir well, and set aside."]

title: Tropical Browned Butter Pancake Topping
ingredients: ["2 tablespoons part-skim ricotta cheese", "1 teaspoon browned butter", "1/8 teaspoon vanilla extract", "1/4 cup diced pineapple", "1/4 cup thinly sliced kiwifruit", "1 1/2 teaspoons toasted unsweetened coconut"]
directions: ["Combine ricotta, browned butter, and vanilla; spoon onto pancakes. Top with pineapple, kiwi, and coconut."]

title: Spicy Crunchy Chickpeas
ingredients: ["2 tablespoons olive oil", "1 teaspoon cinnamon", "1 teaspoon cumin", "1 teaspoon allspice", "1 teaspoon salt", "1/2 teaspoon pepper", "2 15 1/2-oz. cans chickpeas, rinsed, drained, thoroughly patted dry"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil. In a large bowl, combine olive oil, cinnamon, cumin, allspice, salt and pepper. Add chickpeas and toss to coat thoroughly. Turn chickpeas out onto baking sheet and roast, stirring or shaking baking sheet often, until chickpeas are browned and crunchy, 45 to 50 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and let cool before serving, stirring occasionally."]

title: Herbed Bay Shrimp With Rye Crackers
ingredients: ["1 pound cooked small bay shrimp", "1/4 cup mayonnaise", "2 thinly sliced scallions", "1 tablespoon chopped tarragon", "Salt and pepper"]
directions: ["In a large bowl, combine shrimp, mayonnaise, scallions, tarragon, 1/4 teaspoon salt, and 1/8 teaspoon pepper.", "Serve chilled with rye crackers."]

title: Barbecued Sausage
ingredients: ["2 pounds smoked sausage", "1 1/2 cups Barbecue Sauce"]
directions: ["Place sausage on grill over low coals. Grill about 15 minutes; turn sausage, and baste with Barbecue Sauce. Continue cooking for 1 hour and 15 minutes, turning and basting sausage every 15 minutes. Cut into 1-inch slices to serve."]

title: Jalapeño Sour Cream
ingredients: ["1 (8-oz.) container sour cream", "1/4 cup chopped pickled jalapeno pepper slices", "Garnish: pickled jalapeno slices"]
directions: ["Stir together first 2 ingredients. Cover and chill until ready to serve. Garnish, if desired."]

title: Summer Tomato-And-Carrot Soup
ingredients: ["2 1/2 teaspoons olive oil", "1 cup chopped onion", "1/2 cup chopped carrot", "6 cups chopped seeded peeled tomato (about 3 1/2 pounds)", "1/4 teaspoon black pepper", "1 (14 1/2-ounce) can vegetable broth", "6 tablespoons plain fat-free yogurt", "1 tablespoon minced fresh tarragon"]
directions: ["Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and carrot; saute 5 minutes or until tender. Add tomato; cook for 10 minutes. Stir in pepper and broth; cook 10 minutes. Pour half of tomato mixture in blender; process until smooth. Pour soup into a large bowl. Repeat procedure with remaining tomato mixture. Ladle 1 cup soup into each of 6 serving bowls; top each serving with 1 tablespoon yogurt and 1/2 teaspoon tarragon."]

title: Herbed Salad Dressing
ingredients: ["1/2 cup mayonnaise", "1/2 cup buttermilk or sour cream"]
directions: ["Whisk together Salad Dressing Mix, mayonnaise, and buttermilk. Chill at least 2 hour. Serve over mixed salad greens or as a vegetable dip."]

title: Crispy Asiago Frico
ingredients: ["1 pound aged Asiago cheese, coarsely shredded", "Optional seasonings: sesame seeds or finely chopped macadamia nuts"]
directions: ["Sprinkle 6 tablespoon-size mounds of the cheese in a large nonstick skillet. Top each mound with a pinch of the seasonings. Transfer to paper towels to drain. Wipe out the skillet and repeat."]

title: Cream Cheese Filling
ingredients: ["2 (8-ounce) packages cream cheese, softened", "3/4 cup sugar", "1 large egg", "2 teaspoons vanilla extract"]
directions: ["Beat all ingredients at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth."]

title: Hummingbird Cake Shake
ingredients: ["3 scoops butter pecan ice cream", "1/4 cup milk", "1 teaspoon vanilla", "1 banana", "1/4 cup chopped pineapple", "1/8 teaspoon nutmeg", "1/8 teaspoon cinnamon", "Rim with cream cheese frosting and chopped pecans", "Garnish with whipped cream and chopped pecans, if desired"]
directions: ["Combine first 7 ingredients in a blender; process until smooth. Rim glass with frosting and chopped pecans. Pour into a tall glass and garnish as desired with whipped cream and chopped pecans."]

title: Bubble And Squeak
ingredients: ["2 cups finely shredded cabbage (about 1 small cabbage)", "1 small onion, finely chopped", "3 tablespoons butter or margarine", "Salt and pepper to taste", "2 cups mashed potatoes"]
directions: ["Cook cabbage, covered, in a small amount of boiling salted water for 15 minutes; drain well, and set aside.", "Saute onion in butter until tender. Combine cabbage and onion; add salt and pepper. Cook over low heat 2 minutes. title: Cocktail Sauce
ingredients: ["1 cup ketchup", "2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice", "2 tablespoons prepared horseradish", "1 tablespoon Worcestershire sauce", "1 to 2 teaspoons hot sauce"]
directions: ["Stir together all ingredients; cover and chill. Serve with oysters on the half shell."]

title: Sweet-And-Sour Dressing
ingredients: ["1 egg, beaten", "1 tablespoon bacon drippings", "1/4 cup sugar", "1/4 cup vinegar", "1/4 cup commercial sour cream"]
directions: ["Combine egg and drippings in a small ceramic saucepan; beat well with a wire whisk. Place over medium heat; cook until thickened slightly, beating constantly with wire whisk.", "Dissolve sugar in vinegar; gradually add to egg mixture. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened. Cool slightly, and fold in sour cream."]

title: Baked Pork Butt Roast
ingredients: ["1 (4- to 5-lb.) boneless pork shoulder roast (Boston butt)", "1 tablespoon olive oil", "2 teaspoons salt", "2 teaspoons pepper"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Trim boneless pork shoulder roast. Rinse and pat dry. Rub roast with olive oil. Let stand 15 minutes before slicing."]

title: Buttered Pecans
ingredients: ["2 cups coarsely chopped pecans", "1/4 cup butter, melted"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Stir together pecans and melted butter. Spread in a single layer in a 13- x 9-inch pan. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until toasted and fragrant, stirring halfway through. Remove from oven, and let cool in pan."]

title: Cucumber Sauce
ingredients: ["1/2 cup finely chopped, peeled cucumber", "1 cup mayonnaise", "3 tablespoons lemon juice", "1/4 teaspoon curry powder", "Dash of hot sauce"]
directions: ["Pat cucumber between paper towels to remove moisture, and set aside.", "Combine remaining ingredients in a small mixing bowl. Stir cucumber into mayonnaise mixture; mix well. Cover; chill thoroughly before serving. Serve sauce cold with poached fish."]

title: Steamed Sugar Snap Peas
ingredients: ["1 10-ounce package frozen sugar snap peas", "1 tablespoon butter", "2 teaspoons lemon juice", "1/2 teaspoon salt"]
directions: ["Prepare 1 (10-ounce) package frozen sugar snap peas according to package directions. Stir in 1 tablespoon butter, 2 teaspoons lemon juice, and 1/2 teaspoon salt."]

title: Fresh Homemade Butter (And Buttermilk)
ingredients: ["2 cups heavy cream (preferably not ultra-pasteurized)", "Fine sea salt"]

title: Mast Farm Inn Shrimp And Grits
ingredients: ["1 pound large shrimp (about 20 shrimp)", "Cooking spray", "2 teaspoons Cajun seasoning (such as Paul Prudhomme's Seafood Magic)"]

title: Infused Four Citrus Vodka
ingredients: ["1 (750-milliliter) bottle vodka", "1 small Rio Star grapefruit", "1 tangerine", "1 Meyer lemon (or 1 regular lemon)", "2 Key limes (or 1 regular lime)"]
directions: ["Pour vodka into a well-cleaned 1 1/4- to 1 1/2-liter glass jar with lid. Thoroughly wash rinds of the grapefruit, tangerine, Meyer lemon, and Key limes. Strain vodka through a coffee filter or cheesecloth-lined strainer into a well-cleaned bottle or jar. Cover; store in the refrigerator or freezer for up to 4 months."]

title: Sherried Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: ["2 (1-ounce) squares unsweetened chocolate", "2 tablespoons butter or margarine", "2/3 cup sugar", "1/2 cup evaporated milk", "1/4 cup sherry", "1 teaspoon vanilla extract"]
directions: ["Combine chocolate and butter in a heavy saucepan; cook over low heat, stirring frequently, until chocolate and butter melt. Add sugar and milk; continue to cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat; cool. Stir in sherry and vanilla. Serve warm over ice cream."]

title: Warm Pecan Vinaigrette
ingredients: ["2 finely chopped shallots", "3 tablespoons olive oil", "1/2 cup chopped toasted pecans", "3 tablespoons apple cider vinegar", "1 tablespoon Dijon mustard", "1 tablespoon honey", "1/4 teaspoon salt", "1/4 teaspoon pepper"]
directions: ["Saute chopped shallots in hot olive oil over medium heat 3 minutes. Stir in pecans, vinegar, Dijon mustard, honey, salt, and pepper. Reduce heat to low; cook, stirring constantly, until warm."]

title: Yogurt Cheese
ingredients: ["1 (32-ounce) container plain yogurt*", "Salt (optional)"]

title: Fried Cabbage
ingredients: ["4 bacon slices", "1 large head fresh cabbage, coarsely chopped", "1 teaspoon salt", "1 teaspoon pepper"]
directions: ["Cook bacon in a large skillet 10 minutes or until crisp. Remove bacon, and drain on paper towels, reserving 1 tablespoon drippings in skillet. Crumble bacon.", "Add cabbage to hot drippings in skillet; sprinkle with salt and pepper. Saute cabbage over medium-high heat 10 to 12 minutes or until tender. Sprinkle with bacon."]

title: Strawberry Sauce
ingredients: ["4 cups sliced strawberries", "1/3 cup honey", "3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice"]
directions: ["Combine all ingredients in a bowl; stir well. Cover and let stand 1 hour."]

directions: ["Preheat broiler.", "Place pineapple slices on a jelly-roll pan. Drizzle with butter; sprinkle with sugar. Broil 4 minutes or until sugar melts. Sprinkle coconut over pineapple; broil 2 minutes or until coconut is toasted."]

directions: ["Place the potato in a medium saucepan; cover with water. Bring to a boil. Add potato; let stand 5 minutes or until butter melts.", "Beat the potato mixture with a mixer at medium speed until smooth."]

title: Tailgater'S Cheese Spread
ingredients: ["1 cup Hellmann's(R) or Best Foods(R) Real Mayonnaise", "1 package (8 oz.) cream cheese, softened", "2 cups shredded cheddar cheese (about 8 oz.)", "1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese", "1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper sauce or to taste", "1/2 cup toasted chopped walnuts"]
directions: ["In large bowl, with electric mixer, beat Hellmann's(R) or Best Foods(R) Real Mayonnaise, cheeses and cayenne pepper sauce on medium speed until smooth. title: Brown Sugar-Pecan Topping
ingredients: ["1 cup firmly packed brown sugar", "1 cup chopped pecans", "1 cup sweetened flaked coconut", "1/2 cup butter, softened", "1/3 cup milk"]
directions: ["Beat together all ingredients at medium speed with an electric mixer until well combined.", "Brown Sugar-Walnut Topping: Substitute chopped walnuts for pecans. Proceed with recipe as directed."]

title: Creamy Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: ["2/3 cup refrigerated horseradish", "1/2 cup finely chopped English cucumber", "1/2 teaspoon salt", "1 (16-oz.) container sour cream"]
directions: ["Stir together all ingredients in a medium bowl; chill."]

title: Tree Cookies

directions: ["Heat oven according to the label directions. Cut the dough into 1/4-inch slices. Arrange on an ungreased baking sheet. Using green, yellow, and brown M&M's Minis, design Christmas trees as shown above. Bake until golden as the label directs. Cool on wire racks."]

title: New Potatoes In Butter

title: Pink Grapefruit Sorbet

directions: ["Combine 1/2 cup grapefruit juice and sugar in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook until sugar dissolves, stirring frequently.", "Combine the sugar mixture and the remaining 2 1/2 cups grapefruit juice in a medium bowl; cover and refrigerate until chilled.", "Pour mixture into the freezer can of an ice-cream freezer, and freeze the mixture according to manufacturer's instructions. Spoon the sorbet into a freezer-safe container; cover and freeze for 1 hour or until the sorbet is firm.", "MyRecipes is working with", ", the Partnership for a Healthier America, and USDA's MyPlate to give anyone looking for healthier options access to a trove of recipes that will help them create healthy, tasty plates. title: Blackberry Frozen Yogurt
ingredients: ["12 ounces blackberries", "1 (33.5-oz.) container 2% plain Greek yogurt (such as FAGE)", "3/4 to 1 1/4 cups honey"]
directions: ["Process blackberries in a food processor until smooth. Strain into a bowl, discarding solids. Stir in yogurt and honey. Pour into freezer container of a 2-qt. electric ice-cream maker; freeze according to manufacturer's instructions."]

title: Horseradish And Chives
ingredients: ["Lemon juice", "Prepared horseradish", "Chives or green onion tops (chopped)"]
directions: ["Combine 6 to 8 parts lemon juice and 1 part each prepared horseradish and finely chopped chives or green onion tops."]

title: Mustard Baked Chicken
ingredients: ["1 (4-lb.) whole chicken", "1 tablespoon paprika", "1 1/2 teaspoons dry mustard", "1 teaspoon salt", "1 teaspoon pepper", "2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce", "1 tablespoon olive oil"]
directions: ["Remove giblets and neck, and rinse chicken with cold water; pat dry. Place chicken in a large zip-top plastic freezer bag. Stir together paprika and next 5 ingredients until well blended; rub over chicken, coating evenly. Seal and chill at least 30 minutes or up to 8 hours, turning occasionally. Let stand, covered, 15 minutes before slicing."]

title: Maître D'Hôtel Butter
ingredients: ["1/2 cup butter, softened", "1/2 teaspoon salt", "1/8 teaspoon pepper", "1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley", "1 tablespoon lemon juice"]
directions: ["Cream butter in a small mixing bowl. Add salt, pepper, parsley, and lemon juice; stir well. Store mixture in a covered container in refrigerator until ready to use. Serve butter at room temperature with pompano or other baked or broiled fish."]

title: Broiled Oysters
ingredients: ["1 dozen unshucked oysters", "1/4 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce", "1/8 teaspoon hot sauce", "3 slices bacon, cut into pieces", "Dash of paprika"]
directions: ["Rinse oysters thoroughly in cold water. Shuck oysters, reserving deep half of shells. Arrange oysters in a single layer in a shallow baking pan.", "Combine sauces; brush oysters with sauce mixture. Place a piece of bacon on each oyster; sprinkle with paprika.", "Broil 4 inches from heating element 3 to 4 minutes; serve immediately."]

title: Tuscan-Style Penne
ingredients: ["2 1/2 cups sauce (remaining from Many Meals Pot Roast recipe)", "3 tablespoons Hunt's Tomato Paste (or more paste, if desired)", "1 package (16 oz each) dry penne pasta, cooked according to package directions"]
directions: ["Hands On: 15 minutes", "Total: 15 minutes", "Skim fat from surface of sauce; discard fat. Pour sauce into medium saucepan. Add tomato paste; stir until well blended.", "Cook over medium heat 5 minutes, or until heated through, stirring occasionally.", "Serve over the hot pasta."]

title: Campanelle With Roasted Grapes And Feta
ingredients: ["Cooking spray", "8 ounces uncooked campanelle (bellflower-shaped pasta) or farfalle", "3 cups seedless grapes (any combination of red, green, and black)", "1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon olive oil, divided", "1/4 teaspoon salt", "1 cup chopped onion", "1/2 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme", "1/2 cup less-sodium chicken or vegetable broth", "1/2 cup dry white wine", "1 cup crumbled feta cheese"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray.", "Cook pasta according to package directions; drain.", "Toss grapes with 1 teaspoon olive oil and 1/4 teaspoon salt. Place on baking sheet. Roast 5-7 minutes, or until first few grapes begin to split. Remove from oven and let stand.", "Heat remaining olive oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion and thyme; cook until onion is softened, about 4 minutes. Pour in broth and wine; boil 5-6 minutes, or until sauce is amber-colored and no longer tastes of \"raw\" wine.", "Combine pasta and sauce; toss with grapes and feta."]

title: Pumpkin Puree
ingredients: ["1 (2-pound) pumpkin"]
directions: ["Cut the pumpkin in half lengthwise, discarding seeds and membranes. Place pumpkin halves, cut sides down, in a baking dish, and add 1/4 cup water to the dish. Cover with heavy-duty plastic wrap, and vent. Microwave at high 10 minutes (or about 5 minutes per pound) until pumpkin is tender when pierced with a fork. Cool slightly, and scoop out filling."]

title: Hot Oven-Roasted Chicken
ingredients: ["1/3 cup olive oil", "1/4 cup lemon juice", "1 teaspoon salt", "1/2 teaspoon dried oregano", "1/4 teaspoon pepper", "1 (2 1/2- to 3-pound) whole chicken"]
directions: ["Stir together first 5 ingredients.", "Place chicken in a shallow dish or heavy-duty zip-top plastic bag; pour oil mixture over chicken. title: Herbed Couscous Pilaf
ingredients: ["1 tablespoon olive oil", "1/4 cup finely chopped shallots", "1 cup uncooked couscous", "1 cup plus 2 tablespoons fat-free, lower-sodium chicken broth", "1/8 teaspoon salt", "1 tablespoon chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley", "1 teaspoon chopped fresh thyme"]
directions: ["Heat a small saucepan over medium-high heat. Add oil to pan, swirling to coat. Add shallots; saute 2 minutes or until tender. Stir in couscous; saute 1 minute. Add broth and salt; bring to a boil. Cover, remove from heat, and let stand 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Stir in parsley and thyme."]

title: Sweet Barbecue Glaze
ingredients: ["1 1/4 cups premium tomato-based barbecue sauce", "1/4 cup honey"]
directions: ["Stir together all ingredients. Store in an airtight container in refrigerator up to 2 weeks.", "Note: For testing purposes only, we used Big Bob Gibson Bar-B-Q Championship Red Sauce."]

title: Caramelized Condensed Milk
ingredients: ["1 (14-ounce) can fat-free sweetened condensed milk"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0.", "Pour milk into a 9-inch pie plate, and cover with foil. Place pie plate in a shallow roasting pan. Add enough hot water to pan to come halfway up sides of pie plate (about 4 cups). Bake at 400\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours, adding additional water as needed (about 2 cups).", "Carefully remove pie plate from water. Uncover, and stir milk with a whisk until smooth. Milk should be golden brown."]

title: Pineapple Satay With Coconut Caramel
ingredients: ["1 ripe pineapple", "1 cup sugar", "3/4 cup coconut milk", "1/4 cup unsweetened shredded coconut, toasted"]
directions: ["Soak skewers in water 30 minutes. Meanwhile, trim ends from pineapple, then stand it upright and cut off peel. Quarter pineapple lengthwise and cut out core. Reserve half the pineapple for another use. Cut each remaining quarter into 4 lengthwise slices, then cut each slice in half crosswise to make 16 thin wedges. Skewer each lengthwise.", "In a small saucepan, combine sugar with 1/2 cup water. Bring to a boil, swirling to dissolve sugar; boil, swirling occasionally (do not stir), just until golden and honeylike. Remove from heat and slowly whisk in coconut milk (mixture will bubble furiously).", "Heat a grill to high (450\u00b0 to 550\u00b0). Using a pastry brush, coat pineapple pieces with caramel sauce. Grill just until marks appear, then turn to mark other side, 4 to 5 minutes total. Put skewers on a platter, sprinkle with toasted coconut, and serve with remaining caramel sauce for dunking.", "You will need 16 wooden skewers for this recipe (soak in water 30 minutes).", "Tip from Amy Machnak, Recipe Editor: Use big pieces of firm fruit. While the pastry chef at Boulevard in San Francisco, I tried using the grill with different fruits. Early disasters: strawberries (they fell through or stuck to the grates) and cherries (hard to skewer). Some customers complained that my grilled fruit tasted like meat. My solution: choosing denser fruits like peaches, nectarines, and pineapples-the first two cut in half, the third thickly sliced. They were instant winners. Also, I cleaned the grill well to let the fruit flavor shine through. I'm glad I kept at it, because warm grilled fruit is perfect with ice cream in summertime, and it makes use of an already hot barbecue."]

title: Sweet-Hot Coconut Shrimp
ingredients: ["1 pound shelled, deveined shrimp (21 to 31 per lb.), rinsed and well drained", "1/2 cup coconut milk", "2 cups thinly sliced English cucumber"]
directions: ["In a bowl, mix shrimp, coconut milk, and 2 tablespoons sweet-hot chili sauce. Cover and chill at least 1 hour or up to 1 day (see notes).", "Thread shrimp onto 8 to 10 soaked wooden skewers (see notes). Place on a rack in a 10- by 15-inch broiler pan.", "Broil shrimp 3 to 4 inches from heat, turning once, until shrimp are opaque but still moist-looking in center of thickest part (cut to test), 5 to 6 minutes.", "Arrange the cucumber slices on a platter. Set shrimp on top. Drizzle about 3 more tablespoons chili sauce over shrimp. Serve shrimp hot or cool with remaining chili sauce to add to taste."]

title: Strawberry Syrup
ingredients: ["16 ounces strawberries, chopped", "1 cup sugar"]
directions: ["Combine strawberries, sugar, and 1 cup water in a saucepan over medium heat. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, and simmer 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Strain, discarding solids, and pour into a glass jar. (Skim foam from top, if necessary.) Cool completely. Cover and store in refrigerator up to 2 weeks."]

title: Strawberry-Pineapple Conserve
ingredients: ["1 quart finely chopped fresh pineapple", "4 cups sugar", "1 quart washed and hulled strawberries"]
directions: ["Combine pineapple and sugar in a large glass mixing bowl, stirring well. Cover and let stand 4 hours.", "Place pineapple mixture in a flat-bottomed kettle; cook over low heat, stirring frequently, 30 minutes or until tender. Add strawberries, stirring well. Bring to a rolling boil; boil, stirring frequently, until mixture registers 220\u00b0 on a candy thermometer or until mixture sheets from a cold metal spoon.", "Quickly ladle conserve into hot sterilized jars, leaving 1/4- inch head space. Cover at once with metal lids, and screw bands tight. Process in boiling water bath 15 minutes."]

title: Tropical Salsa
ingredients: ["1 cup peeled, diced ripe mango", "1/2 cup finely chopped tomato", "2 tablespoons minced onion", "2 tablespoons minced cilantro", "1 tablespoon lime juice"]
directions: ["Combine all ingredients in a small bowl; stir well. Cover and chill."]

title: White Chocolate Brandy Sauce
ingredients: ["1/2 cup sugar", "1/2 cup butter or margarine", "1/2 cup half-and-half", "1 (4-ounce) white chocolate bar, chopped (we tested with Ghirardelli)", "3 tablespoons brandy"]
directions: ["Combine first 3 ingredients in a saucepan; bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring until sugar dissolves. Reduce heat, and simmer 5 minutes. Remove from heat; add white chocolate, stirring until chocolate melts. Stir in brandy. Serve warm."]

title: Grilled Chicken Breasts
ingredients: ["4 boned, skinned chicken breast halves (about 5 oz. each)"]
directions: ["Rinse chicken; pat dry. Trim off and discard any excess fat.", "Set breasts on an oiled grill 4 to 6 inches above a solid bed of hot coals or high heat on a gas grill (you can hold your hand at grill level only 2 to 3 seconds); close lid on gas grill. Cook chicken, turning once, until no longer pink in center of thickest part (cut to test), 7 to 9 minutes. Serve hot or cold."]

title: Roasted Potatoes With Grape Mincemeat
ingredients: ["2 pounds red thin-skinned potatoes (each about 1 1/2 in. wide)", "About 1 tablespoon olive oil", "3 tablespoons minced parsley"]
directions: ["Scrub potatoes and cut each in half. With a melon-baller or a spoon, scoop out a well in each potato half, leaving a shell 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick. Reserve scooped-out potato for other uses.", "Lightly oil a 10- by 15-inch pan. Arrange potatoes in a single layer, cut sides up, in pan. Brush lightly with 1 tablespoon olive oil total.", "Bake in a 400\u00b0 oven for 20 minutes, then turn potatoes over and bake until cut sides are lightly browned, 5 to 10 minutes longer.", "Meanwhile, heat mincemeat in a microwave-safe bowl in a microwave oven at full power (100%) until hot, about 1 minute, stirring once.", "Spoon mincemeat equally into potatoes. Sprinkle with parsley. Serve hot, warm, or at room temperature."]

title: Triple-Berry Popsicles
ingredients: ["2/3 cup sugar (see Notes)", "1 cup blueberries", "1 cup strawberries, hulled and sliced", "1 cup raspberries", "1/4 cup fresh lemon juice"]
directions: ["Put sugar and 1/3 cup water in a small saucepan and bring to boil over high heat, stirring until sugar is dissolved. Set aside.", "Combine blueberries, strawberries, raspberries, and lemon juice in a blender and puree until smooth, about 30 seconds. Add 1/3 cup simple syrup and blend just until combined. (Save remaining syrup for another use, such as sweetening iced tea.)", "Transfer puree to popsicle molds (see Notes) and freeze 4 hours. Insert popsicle sticks and freeze an additional 4 to 6 hours, or until frozen solid.", "Note: Nutritional analysis is per popsicle.", "Notes: Simple syrup (sugar water) makes the popsicles less icy and more velvety than sugar alone. (If you don't have time to make the syrup, just add 1/3 cup undissolved sugar to the puree in step 2.) You will need 10 (4-oz.) popsicle molds and 10 popsicle sticks for this recipe."]

title: Barbecue Shrimp
ingredients: ["1 1/2 pounds unpeeled jumbo raw shrimp (2 1/25 count)", "1 large lemon, cut into wedges", "1 (0.7-oz.) envelope Italian dressing mix", "1/2 cup melted butter", "1/2 cup loosely packed fresh flat-leaf parsley"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 425\u00b0. Place shrimp and lemon in a 13- x 9-inch baking dish. Stir together dressing mix and butter. Pour butter mixture over shrimp, stirring to coat.", "Bake, covered, at 425\u00b0 for 25 to 30 minutes or just until shrimp turn pink, stirring once.", "Remove shrimp mixture from oven, and sprinkle with parsley."]

title: How To Prepare Fresh Corn
ingredients: ["6 ears fresh corn", "1 teaspoon sugar"]
directions: ["To Clean: Com should be as fresh as possible since it loses its sweetness in a few hours after being picked from the stalk. To retain freshness leave in husks until just before servings. Remove husks by pulling down from top of ear. Cut or break stem off at base of ear. Remove silks using a stiff, dry vegetable brush. Trim tip, and remove blemishes with a knife, if necessary.", "To Cut Kernels: Hold an ear of corn securely in one hand, resting the base of the ear in a large bowl. Using a sharp knife, cut down the length of the ear to the base; cut through the kernels, being careful not to cut into the tough cob. Rotate ear, and repeat procedure until all kernels are removed from ear. Scrape cob to remove any remaining pulp.", "To Scrape Kernels: Hold the ear of com securely in one hand. Using the tip of a sharp knife, slice through the center of a row of kernels from the base to the tip. Repeat procedure until all kernels are sliced. Holding the ear securely in one hand, rest base of ear in a large bowl. Using the back of the knife, scrape down the ear to remove the flesh and milk; rotate ear and continue scraping procedure until all flesh and milk are removed from the ear.", "To Steam Corn On The Cob: Arrange com on steaming rack. Place rack in steamer over 1 inch of water. Bring to a boil. Cover and steam for 10 minutes or until com is crisp-tender.", "To Boil Corn On The Cob: Combine sugar and enough water to half fill a large saucepan. Bring water to a boil; add corn. Return to a boil; cover, and cook 10 minutes or until com is tender. Drain well.", "Other Cooking Methods: Bake corn on the cob; fry, deep-fry, or stew after cutting or scraping kernels from the cob.", "Serving Suggestions: Corn on the cob may be served with melted butter and salt to taste or any of the following: Drawn Butter, Lemon-Butter Sauce, or any herb butter or spread."]

title: Raisins On The Stem
ingredients: ["1 bunch (about 2 lbs.) grapes"]
directions: ["Snip grapes from center stem to create small clusters. Lay on a dehydrating tray, leaving space between clusters.", "Dry in a dehydrator until wrinkled and barely soft when squeezed, about 30 hours, turning clusters at least once for even drying. Store airtight at room temperature.", "Note: Nutritional analysis is per 1/4 cup."]

title: Spiced Whipped Cream
ingredients: ["1 tablespoon dark cane syrup or honey", "1 cup heavy cream", "Pinch of cinnamon"]
directions: ["Microwave dark cane syrup or honey in a medium-size microwave-safe bowl at HIGH 10 seconds. Stir in heavy cream and a pinch of cinnamon until well blended. Beat at medium-high speed with an electric mixer just until soft peaks form."]

title: Wine Sauerkraut
ingredients: ["2 (1-pound) heads cabbage, cleaned, shredded, and boiled", "1 medium onion, chopped", "1/2 cup butter or margarine", "1/4 cup sugar", "2 cups dry white wine", "1/2 teaspoon salt", "1/8 teaspoon pepper"]
directions: ["Saute onion in butter until tender. Add sugar; cook until sugar dissolves; stir constantly.", "Combine sauteed onion mixture, cabbage, wine, salt, and pepper in a Dutch oven. Cover and cook over low heat 1 hour."]

title: Maple Syrup And Spice Bag
ingredients: ["12 ounces maple syrup"]
directions: ["Simmer maple syrup and Spice Bag over low heat 5 minutes. Cover and chill 24 hours. Discard Spice Bag. Store in refrigerator up to 2 weeks. Serve warm with pancakes or waffles."]

title: Homemade Hot Cocoa
ingredients: ["1 cup milk"]
directions: ["Heat milk to 180\u00b0; stir in Homemade Hot Cocoa Mix."]

title: Maple Pralines
ingredients: ["1 teaspoon vinegar", "2/3 cup milk", "2 cups sugar", "1 cup maple syrup", "2 cups chopped walnuts"]
directions: ["Combine vinegar and milk in a small Dutch oven, stirring well; add sugar and syrup, stirring well. Slowly bring to a boil, stirring until sugar dissolves. Cover and continue to cook over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes to wash down sugar crystals from sides of pan. Uncover and continue cooking, stirring occasionally, until mixture reaches soft ball stage (232\u00b0).", "Remove from heat, and cool to lukewarm (110\u00b0). Beat with a wooden spoon until mixture is creamy and begins to thicken; stir in walnuts. Working rapidly, drop mixture by tablespoonfuls onto waxed paper; let cool. Store in airtight containers."]

title: Ranch Olé
ingredients: ["1 teaspoon finely chopped, seeded jalapeno", "2 scallions, white and light green parts sliced", "1 cup ranch dressing"]
directions: ["Stir jalapeno and sliced scallions into ranch dressing. Chill before serving."]

title: Caramel Frosting
ingredients: ["1 1/4 cups sugar", "3/4 cup firmly packed brown sugar", "About 1 cup evaporated milk", "1/2 cup butter or margarine"]
directions: ["Combine all ingredients in a heavy saucepan; cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until mixture reaches soft ball stage (240\u00b0). Remove from heat, and beat until spreading consistency; add additional milk, if necessary. Spread immediately on cooled cake."]

title: Basic Cocktail Sauce
ingredients: ["1/2 cup ketchup", "2 tablespoons horseradish", "1 tablespoon lemon juice", "Dash of hot sauce"]
directions: ["Stir together 1/2 cup ketchup and remaining ingredients in a small bowl. Store cocktail sauce in an airtight container in refrigerator up to 2 weeks."]

title: Cucumber-Horseradish Relish
ingredients: ["3/4 cup finely chopped cucumber", "2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice", "2 teaspoons sugar", "2 teaspoons chopped fresh dill", "2 teaspoons prepared horseradish", "1/8 teaspoon salt"]
directions: ["Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. Cover and chill 2 hours."]

title: Roasted Corn In The Husk
ingredients: ["6 ears fresh corn", "Butter or margarine", "Salt and pepper to taste"]
directions: ["Remove outer husks from corn; turn back inner husks, and remove silk. Replace inner husks over cob and tie. Let stand in cold water 1 hour. Remove from water and drain.", "Place corn on grill. Cover and cook over medium coals 30 minutes or until corn is tender, turning ears frequently. Remove husks; serve with butter and seasonings."]

title: Grilled Zucchini Squash With “Special Seasoning!”
ingredients: ["1/4 cups Extra Virgin Olive Oil", "1/2 teaspoons Crushed Mint", "1/2 teaspoons Basil, Dried", "1/2 teaspoons Dill, Dried", "1/4 teaspoons Salt", "3 whole Zucchini Squash, Sliced Into Spears"]
directions: ["1. In a small bowl, combine the oil, mint, basil, dill, and salt.", "2. Brush over the zucchini/squash.", "3. On a grill (or even a frying pan), cook 2 to 3 minutes each side.", "4. Eat your servings, and if you can get your hands on someone else's serving too! And, of course, enjoy!"]

title: Sarsaparilla Floats With Bourbon Vanilla
ingredients: ["1 Scoop Vanilla Ice Cream", "1 ounce, fluid Jeremiah Weed's Sarsaparilla Whiskey", "12 ounces, fluid Root Beer", "1 Bourbon Vanilla Bean Pod, Seeds Scraped"]
directions: ["Put 1 scoop of ice cream in bottom of mason jar or tall glass. Add sarsaparilla whiskey. Fill with root beer. Sprinkle with bourbon vanilla bean seeds, or use the pods as stirrers. Sip and savor. Repeat."]

title: Raw Vegan Lime Cheesecake
ingredients: ["1-1/2 cup Cashews, Soaked", "3/4 cups Dates", "1/2 cups Almonds", "2 Tablespoons Desiccated Coconut", "1/2 cups Fresh Lime Juice", "1 whole Lime, Zested", "2 Tablespoons Coconut Oil, Melted", "1/2 cups Coconut Milk", "2 Tablespoons Maple Syrup"]
directions: ["1. Soak cashews in cold water for at least 8 hours but overnight is best.", "2. Soak dates in warm water for 15 minutes and then drain the water before putting in the food processor.", "3. Add almonds and desiccated coconut to the food processor along with the dates and pulse into a fine grain.", "4. Press the mixture into a 12-inch springform pan or smaller individual tins like you see in the picture.", "5. Push down firmly until it is well compacted and even. Put in the fridge to set. This can be made the day before.", "6. Add soaked cashews to the food processor along with lime juice, lime zest, coconut oil, coconut milk and maple syrup and blend well until the mixture is smooth and creamy, scraping down the sides as needed.", "7. Pour mixture onto the base, spread evenly and sprinkle with lime zest. Store in the freezer and take out 30 minutes before serving."]

title: Salted Caramel Vodka Hot Chocolate
ingredients: ["1 cup, 11 tablespoons, 2-1/2 pinches Milk", "2-7/8 ounces, weight Dark Chocolate, Chopped", "1 pinch Sea Salt (more To Taste)", "1 tablespoon, 2 teaspoons, 1-1/4 pinches Caramel Vodka", "1 Tablespoon Heavy Cream"]
directions: ["1. Heat the milk in a small saucepan on the stove until it's just about to boil.", "2. Take it off the heat and add the chocolate and the salt. Stir with a wooden spoon until all the chocolate has melted and the mixture has thickened. The smaller your chocolate, the easier this will be. Add more salt to taste.", "3. When all the chocolate has melted, stir in the vodka and the double cream.", "4. Pour into mugs, top with some whipped cream if you want and enjoy."]

title: Salted Butter Caramel Sauce
ingredients: ["1 cup Granulated Sugar", "1 dash Sea Salt", "6 Tablespoons Salted Butter, Cubed", "2/3 cups Half-and-half"]
directions: ["Place sugar in a medium saucepan. Melt over medium heat. Watch it as it starts to melt. Whisk once every 15-20 seconds. It will start to clump up as it melts even more.", "Once all the sugar is melted and is golden brown, take the pot of the heat. Add some sea salt. Add butter all at once. Be careful! It will foam up and there will be steam! Keep whisking and whisking, until the butter is all melted.", "Place the pot over the heat again. Slowly pour in the half-and-half. Whisk it together. Keep whisking until you get a uniform color.", "Cook the sauce over medium-low heat for 1 minute, whisking constantly. Take off the heat. Pour into a heat-proof jar or measuring cup. Let stand on a counter for 15 minutes. You have way more than a cup of the sauce. It is very thin at this point.", "Place the lid on the jar and refrigerate until it thickens. Pour over your dessert."]

title: Frozen Cream Corn
ingredients: ["24 cups Corn, Cut From Cob", "1 pound Butter, Cubed", "1 quart Half-and-half"]
directions: ["This takes about 3 dozen cobs of corn to make. Blanch corn and cut from cob. Put into a large roaster. Add butter and half-and-half. Stir and place in a 325-degree oven. Bake for one hour, stirring every fifteen minutes. Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature. Put into freezer containers and freeze."]

title: Saffron-Infused Rabdi Over Summer Berries
ingredients: ["1/2 gallons Whole Milk", "1 cup Condensed Milk", "1 pinch Saffron", "1/2 cups Blueberries", "1/2 cups Raspberries"]
directions: ["Cook milk in a thick-bottomed pan with a wide mouth. If a deep pan or pot is used to cook a lot of milk, the bottom layer sticks to the base while the top layer is still not hot enough. Bring milk to a quick boil, turn the heat to low and let it simmer, stirring occasionally. Using a plastic or wooden spatula, scrape the bottom occasionally, not allowing it to stick to the bottom. Cook it until the milk starts to thicken, and then add the condensed milk.", "While continuously stirring, add saffron strands and cook until it reduces to a thick consistency. I personally like a pancake batter consistency.", "Let the rabdi cool down and then you can either chill it or pour it mildly warm over fresh berries."]

title: Peach Bellini
ingredients: ["2 whole Peaches, Peeled & Cut Into Chunks", "1/2 cups Sugar", "2 teaspoons Lemon Juice, Fresh If You Have It", "1 bottle Champagne (standard Size)"]
directions: ["Combine the peaches, sugar, and lemon juice in a sauce pan. Bring to a boil, stirring almost constantly, until it boils and the sugar is dissolved. Reduce heat to low, cover and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat, allow to cool. Once it's cooled, pour the mixture through a strainer set over a pitcher and discard the solids. Chill the liquids.", "Pour as much (or as little) in the bottom of a champagne flute and top with chilled champagne. Refrigerate the remainder.", "Enjoy!!"]

title: Rutabaga Fries
ingredients: ["1 whole Rutabaga", "1 teaspoon Salt", "1/2 teaspoons Pepper", "3/4 Tablespoons Chili Powder"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400 degrees (F).", "Peel a large rutabaga using a vegetable peeler. Slice the peeled rutabaga into fries. Spray cooking sheet with cooking spray and spread fries onto sheet. Spray fries with cooking spray (or toss fries in olive oil) and season with salt, pepper and chili powder (or seasonings of your choice).", "Flip fries several times to coat before baking for 15 minutes. Flip the fries and bake for another 10 - 20 minutes until desired doneness is achieved."]

title: Orange Dream Ice Cream
ingredients: ["2 cups Heavy Whipping Cream, Cold", "3/4 cups Granulated Sugar", "2/3 cups Half-n-half, Cold", "1/2 cups Frozen Orange Juice Concentrate, Thawed"]
directions: ["Note: You'll need to freeze the canister of your ice cream maker ahead of time so it's very cold when you are ready to make the ice cream (at least 24 hours).", "This recipe yields about 1 quart of ice cream.", "Whisk whipping cream and sugar in a mixing bowl until sugar dissolves, about 1 minute. Add half-and-half and whisk briefly to incorporate. Mix in orange juice concentrate. Immediately add mixture into the frozen canister of your ice cream maker. Run ice cream maker according to manufacturer's instructions. (My ice cream maker produces soft-serve ice cream in about 25 minutes).", "Once at the soft-serve stage, you can transfer the ice cream into a freezer safe airtight container, cover with parchment paper and freeze. It can store in the freezer for up to a couple of months though it has never lasted that long at my home. So I cannot vouch personally for the taste after two or three months. I know it is wonderfully creamy and refreshing for at least a couple of weeks later.", "Recipe slightly adapted from \"Ben & Jerry's Homemade Ice Cream & Dessert Book\"."]

title: Rose Hip Syrup
ingredients: ["1 pound Fresh Rose Hips", "1-1/2 cup Sugar"]
directions: ["Remove the stem and blossom ends from the rose hips, and rinse with cold water. Boil 2 quarts of water and keep hot.", "Pulse the hips in a food processor a few times until broken up, but not mushy. Immediately empty the hips into a saucepan and cover with 1 quart of the boiling water. Bring the mixture back to the boil over high heat, then remove from the stove and steep for 15 minutes.", "Strain the liquid into a bowl through a sieve lined with a clean dish towel or cheesecloth. Squeeze the hips to get out all the juice, then return the hips back to the saucepan and cover with the remaining quart of boiling water. Bring to the boil again, then steep, off heat for 15 minutes. Strain as above. Discard the hips.", "Add the sugar to the hot rose hip juice, then put it back in your pot and boil over medium-high heat for 1 minute. Remove and cool 5 minutes.", "Pour into warm sterilized jars and seal. Store in a cool, dark place. Refrigerate after opening."]

title: Romanian Eggplant Salad
ingredients: ["4 whole Eggplant", "2 Tablespoons Unrefined Sunflower Oil", "Sea Salt, to taste", "1/4 cups Lemon Juice", "1 whole Onion, Chopped Finely"]
directions: ["Rinse the eggplant. Heat your grill pan. Grill the eggplant on each side; don't forget to turn them over every 10 minutes or so. Grill them until they are covered in a black crust.", "Peel the eggplant, cleaning off the black crust. Put them on a wooden platter and let them drain for at least half an hour. The liquid is bitter. The longer you drain them, the sweeter they'll be.", "Mash the eggplant pulp with a blunt, thick wooden knife on a wooden platter. (This is the secret to a delicious eggplant salad! Do not use a metal knife because it will turn the eggplant black and it will also make it bitter.)", "Add the eggplant mash to a bowl and mix in the sunflower oil, salt, lemon juice and onion, stirring continuously.", "It is best served cold. Enjoy!", "Tips:", "When buying eggplant, choose the thin or small ones because they have less seeds and a sweeter taste.", "If you are not vegan, you can add an egg yolk instead of lemon juice. It has the same effect of whitening the salad.", "Don't store the eggplant salad in metal containers. It will turn black and change its taste."]

title: Oyster Mushrooms, Scallions & Miso
ingredients: ["1 Tablespoon Butter", "1 bunch Scallions, Thickly Sliced, Whites And Greens Separated", "1/2 pints Oyster Mushrooms", "1 Tablespoon Miso Paste", "1 Tablespoon Rice Vinegar", "1 teaspoon Soy Sauce"]
directions: ["Heat the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat while you prep the scallions and separate chunks of the mushrooms. Mix the miso, vinegar, and soy sauce together to form a thick sauce.", "When the butter foams, add the mushrooms to the pan in a single layer. Leave them to brown for 2 minutes, then flip them and add the scallion whites. Stir the scallions and mushrooms for 1 minute.", "Add the scallion greens and miso paste to the pan. Stir to coat everything evenly, then turn off the heat and serve.", "Note: Substitute any mushrooms you like, and of course double or triple the recipe to your liking. This is really variable and delicious!"]

title: Rocky Road Chocolate Bars
ingredients: ["1 bag (10.5 Oz. Bag) Colored Miniature Marshmallows", "2 cups Roughly Chopped Walnuts", "1 can (14 Oz. Can) Sweetened Condensed Milk", "2 Tablespoons Butter, Room Temperature", "2 cups Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["Line a 9x9 square baking pan with wax paper, leaving a 2 inch overhang of paper on opposite sides.", "Mix the marshmallows and walnuts in a large mixing bowl and set aside.", "Combine the condensed milk, butter, and chocolate chips in a large saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until melted and smooth. Remove pan from heat and let the mixture cool 5 minutes.", "Pour the chocolate mixture over the marshmallow mixture and mix until thoroughly combined. Pour the mixture into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a buttered spatula. Put the pan in the refrigerator for 2 hours or until set.", "Using the wax paper overhang as handles, lift the bars out of the pan and place on a cutting board. With a sharp knife, cut it into bars, cleaning the knife blade in between cuts."]

title: Rocky Road Chocolate
ingredients: ["16 ounces, weight Milk Chocolate", "3 cups Mini Marshmallows", "1 cup Walnuts, Rough Chopped"]
directions: ["Prepare an 8x8\" pan by spraying with cooking spray and laying a piece of wax paper inside the pan with the edges hanging out.", "Finely chop the chocolate and place in a large bowl. Melt it in the microwave at 1 minute intervals stirring in between and continuing until almost melted. Stir at the end to finish melting and to make sure it is smooth. Add the marshmallows and nuts and stir to combine.", "Pour into the prepared pan and refrigerate until set. Lift it out of the pan using the wax paper \"handles\". Cut into 1\" squares. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator.", "Adapted from Betty Crocker."]

title: Chocolate Ice Cream Bowls
ingredients: ["1 cup Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["Blow up 6 balloons to about the size of an orange. (This doesn't have to be exact; go for something big or just keep it small if you'd like.)", "Melt chocolate chips over low heat in a saucepan, or microwave for about 40 seconds or until chocolate has melted. Let the chocolate cool off a bit so it's no longer hot to the touch.", "Dip the bottom of the balloon into the chocolate. Use a twist and dip motion to coat the bottom half of the balloon.", "Put a small dollop of melted chocolate onto a lined cookie sheet. Place the balloon on top of each circle of chocolate and let it set for about 15-20 minutes.", "Poke a small hole in the top of the balloon and let the air gently seep out. Carefully pull the balloon from the walls of the chocolate bowl.", "Fill the bowls with ice cream and enjoy!"]

title: Roasted Zucchini Salad With Chickpea And Lemon Zest
ingredients: ["2 whole Medium Size Zucchini, Cut Into 1/2-inch Thick Slices", "1 cup Canned Chickpeas (drained)", "2 Tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil", "1 whole Lemon, Zested", "1/2 whole Lemon, Juiced", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 425 F.", "Meanwhile prep all your ingredients. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper and put the zucchini slices on top of the parchment, spacing them apart evenly (it's best if no slices are touching otherwise they may stick together). Put the pan in the oven and bake for about 10 minutes, until the bottom of the zucchini is caramelized. Turn each slice over and cook for another 10 minutes or so. Take the tray out of the oven and let the zucchini cool.", "When the zucchini is room temperature, add all the ingredients into a bowl and mix well. Season with salt and pepper and serve.", "Side note:", "I like to add a little more salt to this salad, about 1/2 teaspoon of Kosher salt. It adds more punch to the otherwise delicate flavors."]

title: Roasted Young Potatoes
ingredients: ["2 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "2 pounds Young Potatoes", "1/2 teaspoons Dried Thyme", "1/2 teaspoons Dried Rosemary", "Salt And Pepper, to taste", "2 Tablespoons Fresh Parsley Leaves, Finely Diced"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F.", "Spread olive oil all over a large baking pan. Add potatoes and shake the pan to get the potatoes covered in oil. Season with dried herbs, salt and pepper. Shake the pan again.", "Bake at 400\u00b0F for 25 minutes, or until potatoes are fork tender and skins are crispy. Toss with fresh parsley. Serve hot."]

title: Roasted Summer Corn
ingredients: ["12 ears Fresh Corn, Or As Many As You Like", "4 sticks Butter, Melted", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Carefully pull back each layer of husk; don't take them off. Remove all that stringy silk. Care fully fold the husk back up. Soak it in a big bucket of water for at least 45 minutes.", "Tie each ear together with a piece of husk or twine. Grill over medium high flame turning occasionally until corn is bright golden yellow, about 20 or 30 minutes. They will catch on fire and that is perfectly ok.", "Dip or roll in melted butter and season with salt and pepper.", "Tip: If making a whole bunch for a cookout or party, you can make them ahead of time and keep them in a cooler. The cooler serves as an insulator and keeps the corn toasty warm."]

title: Qbc Pink Princess Smoothies
ingredients: ["1 cup Blueberries", "8 whole Strawberries", "1 Tablespoon Campari", "1 Tablespoon Condensed Milk", "6 cubes Ice Cube", "2 slices Lime"]
directions: ["Put all ingredients into a blender and blend till smooth! Simple!"]

title: Strawberries And Whipped Cream With A Crunch
ingredients: ["10 whole Strawberries (Medium Size)", "2 cups Whipped Cream Or Whipped Topping", "1-1/2 cup Unsweetened Corn Flakes"]
directions: ["Slice the strawberries in about 1/2-inch size pieces. Add about 1/3 of the strawberries to the bottom of the serving dish. Next, add 1/2 of the whipped cream on top of the berries. Then add 1/2 of the corn flakes on top of the whipped cream. Add another layer of the strawberries (add about 3/4 of the remaining strawberries, leaving the rest of them for garnish). Next add the remaining whipped cream, top with the corn flakes, and garnish with the remaining strawberries."]

title: Plum Jam
ingredients: ["6 cups Plums, Pitted And Quartered", "4 cups Sugar"]
directions: ["Place plums and sugar in a large pot over medium heat. Bring to a boil, stirring often so mixture won't scorch. Continue stirring while boiling until mixture begins to gel and thicken.", "Place in sterilized jars and process in a hot water bath. Half-pints should be processed for 15 minutes. Adjust times according to your elevation."]

title: Mashed Turnips With Sage Brown Butter
ingredients: ["5 whole Medium To Large Turnips, Scrubbed, Ends Removed, Cut Into 1-inch Chunks", "3 cups Milk, Approximately", "4 Tablespoons Butter", "16 whole Sage Leaves (16 Leaves Is Roughly 1 Small Handful)", "Salt To Taste"]
directions: ["In a saucepan, cover the turnip chunks with milk. Only use as much milk as you need to just cover the turnips. Cover the pan, and turn the heat to medium-high. When the milk boils, reduce to medium low and simmer the turnips for 15-20 minutes until very tender.", "While the turnips are cooking, heat half the butter with the sage leaves in a small pan over medium heat. Toss together for 5 minutes until the sage leaves are dark brown, then remove the sage leaves to a plate and set it aside. Add the remaining butter to the pan and swirl it to mix with any remaining sage butter until foamy. When the butter foams, turn the heat off and swirl the butter until brown bits form on the bottom of the pan. Set aside.", "Drain the turnips and reserve some of the cooking liquid. Add the turnips with a sprinkle of salt to a food processor or blender. Puree until smooth then taste it. Add more salt if you'd like. If the turnips seem thick, add a bit of the cooking liquid.", "Serve the turnips hot, topped with the crispy sage leaves and drizzled with brown butter. Enjoy!"]

title: 65 Calorie “Pancakes”
ingredients: ["1 whole Banana", "1 whole Egg"]
directions: ["Heat a skillet on medium heat and give it a coat of cooking spray. In a bowl, mash up a banana until mush, then add in your egg. Mix together until smooth. Pour mixture into skillet and cook like you would actual pancakes (flip when you see the edges starting to bubble).", "I was able to get 3 medium-sized pancakes with this recipe. I also added chocolate chips and some syrup to mine, but will try it out with fresh berries next!", "Notes:", "These do have a banana taste to them so if you're not a fan of banana, keep that in mind.", "Chocolate chips and pancake syrup are bonuses and not included in the 65-calorie configuration.", "I'm unsure of the original credit for this recipe as its been bouncing around Pinterest by many different users."]

title: Roasted Delicata Squash
ingredients: ["1 pound Delicata Squash", "1 teaspoon Olive Oil", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F.", "Cut off the ends of the squash. Stand the squash up and slice in half right through the middle, vertically. Discard the seeds and slice into 1/2-inch slices.", "Toss everything together on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown.", "Enjoy"]

title: Dad’S Sausage Stuffing
ingredients: ["1 pound Sausage, Ground", "1 whole Yellow Onion", "1 head Celery", "2 cans (14 Oz. Can) Turkey (or Chicken) Broth", "14 ounces, weight Cubed Stuffing"]
directions: ["1. Scramble fry sausage and drain fat. Personally, I use Jimmy Dean's breakfast sausage but any kind will work. If you like sage flavoring, go for the sage kind but I prefer the standard stuff!", "2. Slice onion and clean celery off so that you have long useable bits.", "3. While sausage is cooking and you are slicing away, cook the stuffing according to the package directions, subbing out the water for broth.", "4. (While this step is NOT necessary, it's how Dad always did it and it really does result in the best flavor. I've done with and without the meat grinder and it's lightyears better with the meat grinder!) Set up a meat grinder (I use the old style crank kind but you could also use an attachment for your mixer) and grind up all the elements of the stuffing in layers. I usually do bread, stuffing, onion, celery and repeat. Once everything has gone through, put it through one more time to really blend the mixture. I find it is best to have long pieces of the onion so it grinds the best.", "5. Toss it in the bird (I do and have yet to get sick!) and put the leftovers in a casserole. I prefer my stuffing soft so I cover mine, but if you like yours crispy on top leave the cover off and put it in the oven for 30 minutes at 350\u00b0F.", "6. Enjoy!"]

title: Grandma’S Cream Cheese Frosting
ingredients: ["1 package (8 Oz.) Cream Cheese, Softened", "1/2 cups Butter, Softened", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract", "1 pound Powdered Sugar"]
directions: ["Blend cream cheese and butter. Mix in vanilla and add powdered sugar. Mix well. Serve on Grandma Joan's Carrot Cake!"]

title: Salted Caramel Sauce (For Sweet Potatoes)
ingredients: ["3 Tablespoons Cream", "3 Tablespoons Butter", "1/2 cups Brown Sugar", "1/2 teaspoons Salt"]
directions: ["It's sinfully simple. Add all the ingredients into a small pot and bring to a boil. Cook until it thickens. The longer you boil, the thicker the sauce.", "This sauce is glorious. The secret is in the salt.", "Sweet potatoes are my new favorite vegetable, thanks to this sauce. Just pour the sauce over your cooked sweet potatoes and you are all set."]

title: Chilean Lemon Ice Cream (No Machine Required!)
ingredients: ["1 can (12 Oz. Can) Evaporated Milk", "1 can (14 Oz. Can) Sweetened Condensed Milk", "3/4 cups Fresh Lemon Juice, Strained"]
directions: ["1. Place the can of evaporated milk in the freezer. Two hours later, add the can of sweetened condensed milk to the freezer. Leave them both there for one more hour.", "Note: Shake the cans every thirty minutes or so to prevent crystallization. This is a good job for kiddos.", "2. Remove the two cans from the freezer. Open the evaporated milk and pour into a large bowl. Beat for 5-10 minutes, or until doubled in volume and \"soft peaks\" form.", "3. Add the sweetened condensed milk and lemon juice to the whipped mixture.", "4. Spoon into freezer safe containers and freeze overnight, or for at least three hours.", "5. Serve directly out of the freezer with some tea and laughter. You may want to let the ice cream soften a little before scooping, although I find it softens very quickly.", "P.S. If you have the time, add a few strands of lemon rind. It's like topping your dessert with a little Chilean sunshine."]

title: Grandma Kennedy’S Crisp Toffee Bars
ingredients: ["1 cup Butter Or Margarine", "1 cup Brown Sugar", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract", "2 cups Plus 2 Tablespoons Enriched Four, Sifted", "1 package (6 Oz) Semi-sweet Chocolate Chips", "1 cup Walnuts, Chopped"]
directions: ["Thoroughly cream butter, sugar and vanilla. Add flour and mix well. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts. Press mixture into an ungreased cookie sheet.", "Bake at 35o degrees (F) for 15 minutes or less. Cool and cut into bars."]

title: Roasted Broccoli
ingredients: ["1-1/2 pound Broccoli", "4 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "1 teaspoon Lawry's Garlic Salt"]
directions: ["Spray a cookie sheet with non stick spray. Cut broccoli into 2-inch pieces. Drizzle olive oil over the broccoli, then do the same with the garlic salt. Bake at 350\u00b0F for 20 minutes. You can use your favorite seasoning in place of the garlic salt if you like."]

title: Pear Brandy Butter
ingredients: ["5 whole Ripe Pears, Peeled, Cored And Roughly Chopped", "1/4 cups Sugar", "1/4 cups Orange Juice", "1 Tablespoon Brandy, Generous!", "1 Tablespoon Lemon Juice, Or More As Needed"]
directions: ["Prepare canning jars.", "Combine pears, sugar, orange juice, brandy and lemon juice in a heavy saucepan.", "Bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.", "Reduce heat to a simmer and cook slowly until the pears are very tender, about 30 to 35 minutes.", "Spoon the mixture into a food processor or blender (or use an immersion blender!) and puree it, in batches if necessary, until it is smooth.", "Return the mixture to the heat and simmer over low heat, stirring frequently, until it is very thick, another 25 to 30 minutes.", "Taste, and add up to 1 tablespoon additional lemon juice, if needed. Spoon the mixture into prepared jars, leaving 1/4 inch head space. Process according to manufacturer's directions, usually 10 minutes. Or alternatively, place into an airtight container and store in the refrigerator for up to two weeks."]

title: Rise And Shine Tropical Smoothie
ingredients: ["1-1/4 cup Unsweetened Coconut Milk, From Carton", "1/2 cups Raspberries (Fresh Or Frozen)", "1/2 whole Banana, Peel Removed, Frozen", "3 whole Ice Cubes (if Not Using Frozen Raspberries)", "1 cup Orange Juice", "1 cup Pineapple, Frozen", "1 pinch Stevia (optional)"]
directions: ["In a blender add coconut milk, raspberries and banana. If using fresh raspberries (as opposed to frozen) add 3 ice cubes. Blend until smooth. Evenly pour into two glasses.", "Rinse out your blender and add orange juice and pineapple. Blend until smooth. Carefully pour on top of the raspberry mixture. Top with a straw and umbrella.", "Note: If you find the smoothie not sweet enough, add a pinch of stevia."]

title: Perfect Sweet Tea
ingredients: ["3 whole Family Size Teabags (I Use Lipton)", "1 cup Sugar"]
directions: ["First off, go ahead and buy yourself an electric kettle. You'll be amazed how much you will use and enjoy one.", "Boil a kettle of water. A regular kettle will work too or just a pot of water. Stainless steel pots are better. Other pots may give the water a funky flavor.", "As soon as the water comes to a boil, pour into a china teapot.", "Add the family size tea bags to the water, cover and steep for 5 minutes only. Any longer and it gets bitter.", "Remove tea bags after 5 minutes. Do not squeeze!", "Add the sugar to the hot tea and stir well.", "This is your basic syrup. It doesn't matter how much water you use up to this point.", "Take a gallon pitcher and add some cold water, about 1 quart.", "Now add your hot stirred sweet tea to the cold water and finish filling the gallon pitcher with cold water. Stir and enjoy!", "Best served chilled over ice with lemon slices on the side.", "If any is left, refrigerate for up to a week."]

title: Easy Ranch Potatoes
ingredients: ["4 Russet Potatoes, Washed", "1 package Hidden Valley Buttermilk Ranch Dressing (1 Oz.)", "3 Tablespoons Olive Oil"]
directions: ["1. Preheat oven to 425\u00b0F. Cut potatoes into quarters, then cut each quarter in half. Place in a large bowl.", "2. Add ranch seasoning and olive oil. Stir until potatoes are well coated. Dump mixture onto a large baking sheet.", "3. Bake for about 12 minutes. Using a spatula, turn potatoes over and place back in oven. (This helps both sides get crispy.) Cook for about 13 more minutes or until potatoes are golden brown. Enjoy!"]

title: Reduced Balsamic Vinegar
ingredients: ["16 ounces, fluid Balsamic Vinegar, Any Kind Should Be Fine", "2 Tablespoons Brown Sugar", "1 pinch Salt"]
directions: ["In a heavy gauged saucepan, whisk all the ingredients and bring to boil over medium high heat. Then, turn down heat until you get a rapid simmer. Whisk every now and again and keep an eye on it. In about 15-20 minutes it will start to get all syrupy and resinous-looking.", "Don't let it get too thick on the stove because once you let it cool, it will thicken more. Take it off the heat when it starts to look like the consistency of warm honey.", "I keep mine in a small mason jelly jar ready to drizzle on strawberries, pizza, cheese, etc.!"]

title: Classic Risotto
ingredients: ["4-1/2 cups Reduced-sodium Chicken Stock", "3 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "2 whole Shallots, Finely Diced", "1-1/2 cup Arborio Rice", "3/4 cups Dry White Wine", "1/2 teaspoons Salt", "1/2 cups Grated Parmesan Cheese", "2 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter"]
directions: ["In a small saucepan, bring broth to a simmer then keep warm.", "In a medium saucepan, add oil and turn heat on to medium. Saute shallots until translucent and tender, about 2 to 3 minutes.", "Turn heat down to medium-low and add rice and stir continuously for 1 to 2 minutes. Add wine and stir the rice until the wine is absorbed, about 1 minute. Add the salt and give a gentle stir.", "Add 1 cup of the warm broth and stir until the broth is absorbed. Continue to add 1 cup of broth at a time to the rice until you have used all of the broth and most of the broth has been absorbed, about 20 to 25 minutes. Just make sure the prior cup of broth is absorbed before adding the next.", "Once the rice has a creamy consistency, remove from heat and stir in the Parmesan cheese and butter. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve immediately."]

title: Cherry And Dark Chocolate Chip Frozen Yogurt
ingredients: ["32 ounces, weight Vanilla Greek Yogurt", "1/2 cups Half-and-half", "10 ounces, weight Frozen Dark Cherries, Thawed", "3/4 cups Dark Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["In a large bowl using a whisk or an immersion blender, combine the yogurt with the half-and-half.", "In a small bowl blend half of the thawed cherries with the immersion blender until smooth. Add the puree to the yogurt mixture. Add the rest of the cherries into the same bowl and blend again. This time leave the mixture a little chunky. Then stir in the chocolate chips.", "Stir and pour into your ice cream maker. Process according to manufacturer's instructions until slightly frozen.", "Serve or place in a freezer-safe container and pop it into the freezer until ready to eat.", "I recommend you pull the fro-yo out of the freezer at least 25 minutes ahead of time so it's easier to scoop!", "Yields 6 cups."]

title: Dark Chocolate Cookie Butter Truffles
ingredients: ["1 jar Trader Joe's Speculoos Cookie Butter, 11 Ounce Jar", "1 pound Dark Chocolate, Chopped", "Fine Sea Salt (to Sprinkle)"]
directions: ["Line a baking sheet with waxed paper. Measure a teaspoon of cookie butter and place in the palm of your hands. Roll the cookie butter to make a round shape. Place the ball on the waxed paper lined baking sheet. Continue creating rounded teaspoons of cookie butter until the entire jar is used.", "Put the baking sheet into the freezer for 20 minutes. Near the end of the freezing time, prepare the chocolate.", "Place all of the chopped chocolate in a microwave safe bowl, and heat for 30 second intervals, stirring between each 30 second increment. Stir until smooth.", "Remove truffles from freezer and dunk them one at a time in the chocolate. Using a fork, remove the truffles from the chocolate and tap the fork on the side of the bowl so the extra chocolate drips through and back into the bowl. Double dunk if your heart desires. Slide the truffle from the fork back onto the waxed paper using a sharp knife. Sprinkle with a pinch of fine sea salt before the chocolate sets. Repeat with the remaining truffles.", "Refrigerate truffles and serve them slightly cold or just warmed to room temperature. Devour."]

title: Real Orange Julius
ingredients: ["3/4 cans Concentrated Orange Juice", "1/3 cups Sugar", "1 teaspoon Vanilla", "2 cups Milk", "8 cups Ice (less Or More Depending On Cube Size)"]
directions: ["Combine the concentrate, sugar, vanilla, and milk (see notes below) in a blender. Add the ice (it doesn't have to be exact, but if you add too much, it will water it down) and blend to desired consistency. Pour or spoon into cups and delight!", "Notes:", "My favorite twist on this recipe is to use lemon concentrate (or frozen squeezed lemon juice) instead of the orange. VERY delicious. But really, you can use any concentrate depending on what flavor you're going for. I would suggest that if you're using a really naturally sweet one, like berry juices, to cut down on the sugar.", "You can make this less fattening by substituting half of the milk with water. There's really not too much of a difference, but it's best with all milk."]

title: Real Irish Coffee
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Heavy Cream", "3 Tablespoons Sugar, Divided", "1 Shot Of Irish Whiskey", "6 ounces, fluid Freshly Brewed Coffee"]
directions: ["Place heavy cream in a bowl. Mix with an electric mixer until soft peaks form. Add 1 tablespoon sugar and continue to whip another 15-30 seconds to incorporate sugar. Set aside.", "Place the remaining 2 tablespoons sugar in the bottom of a heated mug. Add desired amount of whiskey and stir until sugar has dissolved. Add hot coffee. Top with 2-3 tablespoons sweetened whipped cream."]

title: Real Fruit Ice Poles
ingredients: ["500 milliliters Apple Juice, Divided", "4 Tablespoons Chopped Pineapple", "4 Tablespoons Raspberries"]
directions: ["Place half the apple juice in a blender with the pineapple. Blitz until smooth. Pour into ice pole packets (I bought some on eBay).", "Place the remaining apple juice and raspberries into the blender. Blitz until smooth and pour into more ice pole packets.", "Place in the freezer until frozen. Enjoy."]

title: Cranberry Casserole
ingredients: ["2 cups Fresh Whole Cranberries", "3 cups Tart Apple, Peeled And Chopped", "1 cup Granulated Sugar", "1-1/2 teaspoon Fresh Lemon Juice", "1/2 cups Butter, Melted", "1/2 cups Packed Brown Sugar", "1-1/2 cup Quick Oats", "1/4 cups Chopped Walnuts"]
directions: ["Heat oven to 325 degrees. Prepare 9x13 casserole pan with cooking spray.", "Mix together cranberries, apples, granulated sugar and lemon juice. I do this step right in the pan. Stir well.", "Mix together butter, brown sugar, oats and walnuts. Sprinkle over the cranberry mixture.", "Bake for 60-70 minutes until golden brown and bubbly.", "I usually make two 8x8 pans of this dish so I have one to take to each of our Thanksgiving dinners. It is very sweet, so it could even be classified as a dessert!"]

title: Raspberry Jam
ingredients: ["1 cup Raspberries", "3/4 cups Sugar"]
directions: ["1.\tPreheat the oven to 350\u00b0 F.", "2.\tPut the raspberries and sugar into two separate shallow bowls.", "Note: I use large glass measuring cups, so the fruit will be spread out rather than pile up, and the liquid is easier to pour.", "3.\tPut the bowls/cups into the oven for 20-25 minutes until they are really hot.", "4.\tTake them out of the oven carefully, and add the sugar to the raspberries.", "5.\tStir the mixture until the fruit turns into liquid.", "6.\tPour this into a cleaned and waiting 8-ounce jar.", "7.\tAllow to cool slightly.", "8.\tScrew the lid on the jar, and leave to cool before storing in the refrigerator.", "Note: Quick and simple...and delicious. Goes well with hot biscuits."]

title: Mocha Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 whole Frozen Banana (or More To Taste)", "1 teaspoon Instant Coffee", "1 cup Chocolate Soy Milk"]
directions: ["Put everything into a blender and blend until smooth! YUM!"]

title: 7 Pound Fudge
ingredients: ["24 ounces, weight Milk Chocolate Hershey Bars, In Small Pieces", "2 bags Milk Chocolate Chips (11.5 Oz Each)", "13 ounces, weight Marshmallow Cream", "4 cups Sugar", "13 ounces, fluid Evaporated Milk", "2 sticks Butter, Softened", "2 teaspoons Vanilla", "1 cup Chopped Nuts- Your Choice"]
directions: ["Mix chocolate bars, chocolate chips and marshmallow cream in a large bowl. Set aside.", "Mix sugar, milk and butter in large saucepan over medium heat. Stir til bubbly. Boil 5 minutes.", "Pour the hot mixture over the chocolate and marshmallow cream and beat til blended and smooth.", "Beat in vanilla and nuts.", "Spread in a greased 9x13 pan.", "Refrigerate til firm. Serve at room temperature."]

title: Quick Orange Rolls
ingredients: ["1 whole Orange, Zest And Juice", "1 cup Sugar", "1 stick Butter", "2 cans (16.3 Oz. Size) Flaky Layers Refrigerated Biscuits"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F and place top rack of oven in the center position.", "In a small saucepan combine the orange zest, orange juice, sugar and butter. Bring to a boil and allow to boil for 1 to 2 minutes. Turn off heat.", "Meanwhile, spray a Bundt/tube pan with nonstick spray. Open cans of biscuits. Place biscuits in pan standing on their sides, pointing outward (should look like a sun when pan is full). You may need to cut the last biscuit or two into halves or quarters and tuck into gaps to make everything fit.", "Pour hot syrup over biscuit dough. Place in oven and bake approximately 30 minutes, until top is golden brown, syrup is bubbling, and biscuits are baked through. Immediately (and carefully) invert onto a serving plate while hot. Rolls are best served warm!"]

title: Banana Chai Shake
ingredients: ["1 whole Banana, Sliced And Frozen", "1 cup Skim Milk", "1 dash Nutmeg", "1 dash Cardamom", "1 dash Cinnamon"]
directions: ["Slice and freeze the banana. (Or, if you are like me and forget, use a fresh very ripe banana and some ice to create a thick, cold consistency.) Place milk, banana, (ice if needed) and spices into a blender. Blend. Pour into a clear glass because it looks pretty like that. Sprinkle a bit of cinnamon on top. Enjoy.", "* I find that if I use a very ripe banana I don't need any extra sweetener. You may, depending on your banana and taste. But either way, enjoy!"]

title: Festive Candy Bark
ingredients: ["1 cup Shelled Pistachios", "1/2 bars (about 16 Oz. Bar) Almond Bark"]
directions: ["In the microwave, melt the almond bark in 30-second increments. As soon as the candy is melted, add the shelled pistachios. Spread on waxed paper and chill in regfridgerator until candy has set. Break into fun-sized pieces and serve!", "This can easily be doubled to accommodate more candy!"]

title: Grasshopper Cake
ingredients: ["1 package Fudge Mint Cookies (10 Ounce Package - You'll Need About 25 Cookies)", "3 Tablespoons Butter", "1 gallon Mint Chocolate Chip Ice Cream", "8 ounces, weight Cool Whip"]
directions: ["Preheat oven 350 degrees F. Scoop butter into a 9x13 pan and place it in the warming oven to melt.", "While that is melting, blitz the 25 cookies in a food processor. When butter is melted pour cookie crumbs into pan, mix to combine and press evenly to make a crust (use a fork). Bake crust for about 8 minutes. Then remove it from the oven and let cool.", "Take ice cream out of freezer and let it soften on the counter as the crust cools. Once the ice cream is soft dump it into a large bowl, add Cool Whip and mix the two together till smooth. Pour the mixture onto the crust and spread evenly then pop it back into the freezer. Let it set for about 8 hours. How simple is that?"]

title: Fluffy 4 Ingredient Peanut Butter Frosting
ingredients: ["1 pound Powdered Sugar", "1 cup Heavy Whipping Cream", "1 cup Natural Peanut Butter", "1 teaspoon Vanilla"]
directions: ["Add all ingredients into the bowl of your stand mixer. Using the whisk attachment, beat on low for 30 seconds and then on medium for 2 minutes or until fluffy and smooth.", "Find whatever you can to frost with this frosting! It will be a hit. At least that has been my experience. This frosting also stores in your refrigerator for a week or so. If refrigerated, leave it out on the counter for 20 minutes to soften before using.", "This recipe will generously frost about 24 cupcakes or one large layer cake."]

title: Festive Potato Leaves
ingredients: ["2 whole Russet Potatoes", "1 teaspoon Cajun Seasoning", "1 teaspoon Chili Powder", "Salt And Pepper", "2 Tablespoons Olive Oil"]
directions: ["Cut potatoes in half vertically. Then carefully slice about 1/4 to 1/2-inch slabs until you have 8 pieces.", "Using your leaf cookie cutter, press down on the potato firmly. Then remove the leaf cutout, discarding the rest of the potato. Liberally rub half of the leaves with Cajun seasoning and the other half with chili powder. Sprinkle all with salt and pepper.", "Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Place potatoes into the hot oil. Cook until golden brown on both sides, about 8 to 10 minutes. Remove from heat and enjoy!"]

title: Grandma’S Naughty Cinnamon Balls
ingredients: ["1/3 cups Brown Sugar", "1/3 cups Sugar", "3 Tablespoons (generous) Cinnamon", "1/2 cups Butter, Melted, Plus A Little Extra For Greasing The Pan", "1 can Refrigerated Buttermilk Biscuits (8 Biscuit Size Can)"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 375 F and butter a square or round baking pan. Set aside.", "Combine brown sugar, sugar and cinnamon in a large Ziplock bag or a small mixing bowl. Place melted butter into a shallow bowl.", "Cut all of the biscuit dough rounds in quarters, to get 32 pieces total. Working in batches, dip a few pieces into the melted butter (I find tongs are helpful here, so your fingers don't get greasy), then toss them in the cinnamon sugar until completely coated.", "Transfer to prepared baking pan, trying to keep the pieces in a single layer. It is OK if they touch, and they don't have to be in neat rows, unless you are nutty like that. Repeat until you've coated all of the dough. When you are done, drizzle any remaining butter over the top, and sprinkle with a bit of the leftover cinnamon sugar.", "Bake for about 20 minutes, until puffed and golden brown. Remove from the oven, cool for 5-10 minutes, then serve."]

title: Fudge
ingredients: ["2/3 cups Evaporated Milk", "1-1/2 cup Sugar", "1/2 teaspoons Salt", "1-1/2 cup Chocolate Chips, Preferably Semi-sweet", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract", "1-1/2 cup Miniature Marshmallows", "1/2 cups Chopped Walnuts (optional)"]
directions: ["1. In a medium saucepan, bring evaporated milk, sugar, and salt to a full boil. Cook 5 minutes, stirring constantly.", "2.
