Remove from heat and add vanilla, chocolate chips, marshmallows, and nuts, if desired. Stir until combined and marshmallows are melted.", "3. Put in an 8x8 pan and set aside to cool until thoroughly set. Cut into squares."]

title: Oven Baked Mushrooms
ingredients: ["2 Tablespoons Salted Butter, Cut In 1/2", "1 pound Mushrooms. My Favorites For This Recipe Are Bunashimeji, Enoki, And/or Portabella (or You Can Substitute Dried Shiitake, See Note)", "1 dash Soy Sauce", "Few Leaves Fresh Parsley", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350 F.", "Wash and dry the fresh mushrooms. For dried shiitake mushrooms, read the note below.", "Use 2 sheets of aluminium foil (make sure each is big enough enough that you can fold the top over) and lay them on top of one another (double layers). Put 2 tablespoons of butter into the center of the foil and lay the mushrooms on top. Fold and close the foil wrap. Put the packet in the oven and cook for about 15 minutes.", "Remove the packet from the oven, open it up and sprinkle fresh parsley leaves and about 1 teaspoon of soy sauce over the top. Season with salt and pepper and serve while still hot.", "* Note regarding dried shiitake mushrooms: Soak them in a little water, just enough to barely cover them. Soaking them in too much water will take away a lot of their flavor. Let them soak for about 10 minutes. Squeeze out the excess water and save water to use in a mushroom risotto, spaghetti, soup, etc."]

title: No Bake Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: ["4-1/2 cups Quick Cook Oatmeal", "1-1/2 cup Peanut Butter ( Creamy Or Chunky, I Prefer Creamy)", "3 cups Sugar", "3/4 cups Butter", "3/4 cups Milk", "1/2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["1. Measure oatmeal and peanut butter into a very large mixing bowl.", "In a saucepan over medium heat, combine sugar, butter and milk. Bring to a rapid boil, one that can't be stirred down, begin timing, boil for one full minute.", "Remove from heat, add vanilla, stir. Pour over contents in bowl, stir until the peanut butter and oatmeal is well blended. Mixture will look a little 'wet'.", "Drop batter by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Mixture begins to cool so quickly that by the time you have a few on the paper, it will get thicker and begin to set up. Let cool until set.", "Do not add more oatmeal to the recipe, trust it and follow the directions, you won't be disappointed. By adding more oatmeal, you will make the cookies dry and crumbly."]

title: Potato Wedges (Wedgies!)
ingredients: ["2 whole Large Russet Potatoes Scrubbed Clean And Dry (keep Skin On)", "2 Tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil", "1 Tablespoon Montreal Steak Spice (or Any Spice Blend You Prefer)"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 450\u00b0F.", "Slice the potatoes into wedges: Cut the potatoes in half, cut the halves in half and then cut the halves into halves and finally, cut each in half one more time. A large russet potato should give you 16 thin wedges.", "In a large bowl, coat the wedges with the oil and then coat with the seasoning. Lay all the potato wedges on one side evenly on a baking sheet and bake for 13 minutes. With a spatula or tongs, flip the potato wedges and bake for 12 more minutes.", "Notes:", "1. It's fun to try this recipe with different seasoning blends. I usually stick to Montreal seasoning but I have used BBQ, cayenne seasoning and a combination of the above.", "2. It's also fun to use rosemary and coarse salt here or any blend of dried herbs you have on hand.", "3. Coarse salt is important for the crunch.", "4. The wedges should be about 1/4 inch in thickness.", "5. Yes, it is half a potato per person. Portion, portion, portion!"]

title: Potato Soup
ingredients: ["FOR THE SOUP:", "1 Tablespoon Butter", "1/2 cups Onion, Diced", "4 whole Large Potatoes, Peeled, Cut Into Bite Size Pieces", "4 cups Chicken Broth", "1 Tablespoon Salt To Taste", "1 Tablespoon Black Pepper To Taste", "1 cup Non-fat Milk", "FOR THE GARNISHES:", "Greek Yogurt", "Cooked Chopped Bacon", "Shredded Cheddar Cheese", "Sliced Scallions"]
directions: ["In a large soup pot over medium heat add butter and onions. Saute until onions are slightly softened, about 5 minutes.", "Add potatoes and chicken broth. Bring to a boil, and simmer uncovered until potatoes are fork tender about 20 minutes.", "With an immersion blender, blend potato soup until creamy. Stir in salt, pepper and milk. On low heat simmer for about 10 minutes.", "Add soup to a bowl and top with additional toppings."]

title: Banana Boats
ingredients: ["1 whole Banana", "15 whole Chocolate Chips", "20 whole Miniature Marshmallows"]
directions: ["1. Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F.", "2. Peel back one side of the banana, while still keeping the peel attached.", "3. Using a knife, cut a slit down the center of the banana to create an opening to place toppings.", "4. Fill the opening of the banana with chocolate chips and marshmallows (and other various toppings if desired-peanut butter, caramel sauce, and walnuts are great additions).", "5. Place the peel back over the banana and wrap in aluminum foil.", "6. Place banana in oven for about 10 minutes, or until banana skin is black. If you are using a campfire, place the banana around the coals of the fire (making sure they don't get in contact with flames) for the same amount of time.", "7. Allow banana boat to cool for 2-3 minutes before removing aluminum foil and eating!"]

title: Pork Floss
ingredients: ["1 whole Fried Egg", "1 cup Cooked Rice", "2 Tablespoons Pork Floss (Found At Asian Grocery Store)"]
directions: ["Start by cooking your egg in a bit of oil. Cook it so that you end up with a sunny side up egg. You want the creaminess of the yolk to pour into your rice, and mix with your pork floss.", "Add the rice into a small bowl, top with the fried egg, and top with pork floss. The rest is pretty self-explanatory. Dig in.", "The creaminess of the egg when mixed into the rice and eaten with the pork floss is, well, pretty great. This is not only great for breakfast, it also makes a good meal any time of the day. So remember, pay a visit to your local Asian market. Look around, and pick up some pork floss!"]

title: Parisienne Potatoes
ingredients: ["2 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "2 Tablespoons Butter", "4 cups Parisienne Potatoes (See Note)", "2 sprigs Rosemary, Chopped", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Note: You can purchase Parisienne potatoes in the fresh produce section in some higher end grocery stores or, with a melon baller, make your own from large peeled potatoes.", "Heat oil and butter over medium heat in a large saute pan until it is hot and just starting to brown. Add the potatoes, let them sit for a moment to brown and then every minute or so give the pan a shake, turning the balls over. This will let them brown evenly. About 10 minutes into cooking, add the rosemary and continue to cook until the potatoes are tender inside, about another 5-10 minutes. Remove from heat and season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately."]

title: Easy Microwave Corn On The Cob
ingredients: ["2 whole Unhusked Corn Cobs"]
directions: ["1. Place corn in the microwave. I switched the turntable off because my corn was so large, it wouldn't rotate.", "2. Microwave on high for 4 minutes. Flip over/rotate, and cook an additional 4 to 5 minutes. Let stand in microwave another minute or two.", "3. Place on a cutting board. Cut off the bottom about 1/2 inch from the bottom of the cob. I like to use a kitchen towel to hold on to the hot cob when I do this.", "4. Grasp the top of the leaves and silk, and gently shake from side to side until the cob slides out.", "5. Season to taste and enjoy your easy corn!"]

title: Chocolate Covered Peanut Butter
ingredients: ["3/4 cups Butter, Softened", "2 pounds Creamy Peanut Butter", "2 teaspoons Vanilla", "2 pounds Powdered Sugar (plus 1 Cup For Coating Cookie Cutter)", "2 bags (12 Oz Each) Semi-sweet Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["1.\tCombine butter and peanut butter in a large pot. Melt over medium heat. Stir semi-frequently so that the peanut butter doesn't burn.", "2.\tTransfer to an extra large bowl and add vanilla.", "3.\tOnce fully incorporated slowly add in the 2 pounds of powdered sugar.", "4.\tCombine until all of the powdered sugar is fully incorporated.", "5.\tSpread out on a parchment lined cookie sheet and top with another piece of parchment paper.", "6.\tUsing pressure and a rolling pin, roll out peanut butter mix (keep top sheet of parchment on when doing this) until even, smooth and compacted.", "7.\tPop in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight.", "8.\tRemove from the refrigerator and remove top sheet of parchment paper.", "9.\tIn a small bowl put the 1 cup of powdered sugar and coat your cookie cutter.", "10.\tUsing medium pressure begin to cut out shapes.", "11.\tPlace shapes on a separate lined cookie sheet. Dust off any excess powdered sugar.", "12.\tPop into freezer for 10-15 minutes.", "13.\tMeanwhile melt chocolate over a double boiler. Stirring until smooth.", "14.\tRemove peanut butter shapes and coat bottom with chocolate using a rubber brush. Pop back into freezer for 10 minutes and then do the same for the top. Add sprinkles if desired.", "15.\tUsing a clean paint brush, paint the sides with the melted chocolate.", "16.\tStore in fridge when not in your mouth.", "**Now a shortcut that I realized after doing my very last one was to dip half of the heart into the chocolate then freeze and then dip the other half.**"]

title: Glazed Pineapple
ingredients: ["1 whole Pineapple", "3 Tablespoons Butter", "1 Tablespoon Honey", "Cayenne Pepper, To Taste (optional)"]
directions: ["1) Trim top and bottom from pineapple and set upright. cut down the sides to remove brown skin.", "2) Turn pineapple on side and slice about 1/4 inch thick, removing core if it is too tough to eat (most of the time it is.)", "3) In a small pan melt your butter and add in honey. You want this to all melt together and form a glaze, but there is no need to cook it at a high temperature or for very long, just need the two to get good and friendly with each other.", "4) Place pineapple slices onto a hot grill (med-hi heat), then rotate 90 degrees if you like the pretty grill pattern. Drizzle some glaze onto each slice and let them cook for 2 or 3 minutes. You want those pretty grill marks and a bit of char (a little bit) around the edges is fine.", "5) Turn slices over, rotate if you like, and drizzle again with remaining glaze and let cook for a couple more minutes.", "6) Serve immediately or put on an upper rack of the grill to keep warm while the rest of dinner finishes. Serve as is for a side dish or with some sweetened whipped cream for a light dessert.", "For a bit of kick to your pineapple, add a bit a good cayenne pepper to your glaze and enjoy the more complex flavors."]

title: Muffin Tin Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients: ["1 Tablespoon Olive Oil", "8 Russet Potaotes", "1 cup Grated Cheddar Cheese", "1 cup Half-and-half", "1 Tablespoon Butter"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 375\u00b0F. Spray olive oil into each muffin cup.", "Wash and pierce potatoes then place in a microwave safe dish, microwave for about 15 minutes or until almost fork tender. Let the potatoes cool for about 5 minutes. Slice the potatoes into thin slices and layer with cheese in each tin. I like to do one slice and then sprinkle some cheese and repeat until the tin is full.", "Heat the half-and-half and butter for about 20 seconds. Distribute the half and half mixture between all the muffin cups. Bake in oven for 20 minutes."]

title: Pomme De Terre Macaire
ingredients: ["4 Large Russet Potatoes", "1 Tablespoon Sour Cream", "1 Tablespoon Shredded Cheddar Cheese", "2 Tablespoons Chopped Scallions", "3 strips Crispy Cooked Bacon, Crumbled", "Salt And Pepper, to taste", "Butter Or Neutral Oil For Frying"]
directions: ["1. Preheat oven to 350 F. Brush skins of potatoes with oil and put them on a baking tray. Bake them in the oven until done (about one hour).", "2. Allow potatoes to cool to room temperature and then slice them in half lengthwise. Scoop out insides, leaving large chunks. Put the potato insides into a bowl and discard the skins", "3. Lightly toss in sour cream, cheese, scallions and bacon. The mixture should be stiff and hold its shape and you should have large chunks of potatoes throughout.", "4. Press potato mixture into ring molds to hold shape. Put them on a tray and refrigerate them until ready to cook.", "5. Pan fry potatoes in a skillet over medium heat with a little bit of butter or a neutral oil. Fry until crispy on both sides and heated through."]

title: Grilled Peaches
ingredients: ["1 cup Brown Sugar", "1 teaspoon Cinnamon", "1 Tablespoon Vanilla Extract", "4 Large Peaches"]
directions: ["Mix brown sugar, cinnamon, and vanilla together.", "Quarter peaches and add to the brown sugar mixture. Stir until all the peaches are coated. Let the peaches sit for 10-15 minutes or until the juices have come out and the sugar mixture is syrupy.", "Place the peaches directly onto the grill (charcoal is best for that great smoky flavor!) Grill for 4-5 minutes (depending on the ripeness and size of your peaches and the hotness of your grill) until the sugar is caramelized and there are grill marks on your peaches.", "Turn peaches and grill for another 4-5 minutes or until the peaches are tender. These are great plain or with vanilla ice cream or over a piece of lightly grilled pound cake."]

title: Plum Storm
ingredients: ["1 slice Fresh Plum", "2 ounces, fluid Dark Rum", "Ginger Beer, For Topping", "Lime Wedge"]
directions: ["Muddle the plum with the rum in a tall glass. (If you don't like the pulpy bits in your drink, you can muddle separately and then strain into your cocktail glass.) Add ice to fill, and top with ginger beer. Finish with a squeeze of lime."]

title: Pizza Spices
ingredients: ["1 Tablespoon Oregano", "2 teaspoons Basil", "1 teaspoon Marjoram", "1 teaspoon Thyme"]
directions: ["Combine all ingredients in a small bowl. You can use as little or as much as you'd like, sprinkling it on top of your pizzas right before they go into the oven or once they've already baked. Enjoy."]

title: Pistachio Ice Cream
ingredients: ["1-1/2 cup Nonfat Milk", "1-1/2 cup Heavy Cream", "1 teaspoon Vanilla", "1 cup Sugar", "1 cup Pistachios"]
directions: ["Simply combine all ingredients except for pistachios into a mixing bowl. Beat until ingredients are completely combined. Add in pistachios.", "Freeze according to manufacturer's directions for your ice cream maker.", "I like to let mine set a few hours before eating it. This ensures it firms up a little more.", "Recipe adapted from Southern Living Magazine.", "Makes about 4 cups."]

title: Calabacitas Mexicanas
ingredients: ["4 whole Calabacitas (Mexican Zucchini)", "1 cup Diced Onion", "1/2 cups Diced Tomato", "2 Tablespoons Jalapeno, Finely Diced", "2 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "1/2 teaspoons Dried Mexican Oregano", "Salt And Pepper"]
directions: ["Wash all the veggies, dice the calabacitas, onion, tomato, and finely dice the jalapeno.", "Heat the oil in a skillet on medium-high heat. Add the onion, tomato, jalapenos and cook for approximately 3 minutes. Add the calabacitas, oregano, salt and pepper to taste. Cook until tender, about 10-15 minutes."]

title: Pink Lemonade Frosting
ingredients: ["1 pound Powdered Sugar", "1 stick Butter", "4 Tablespoons Frozen Pink Lemonade Concentrate, Slightly Thawed", "1 teaspoon Vanilla", "1 whole Lemon, Zested", "3 drops Red Food Coloring"]
directions: ["Combine powdered sugar and butter in a large mixing bowl. Beat until fluffy. Add all other ingredients (except the food coloring) and mix well. Add red food coloring at the end, and stir until well blended.", "Frost cooled cakes and eat any frosting leftovers with a good-sized spatula.", "*Note: This will frost two 9\" round cakes. To frost 10-12\" inch cakes, double the ingredients."]

title: Iced Coffee
ingredients: ["3 cups Strong Brewed Coffee", "1 cup Sugar", "2 teaspoons Vanilla", "1 pint Half-and-half", "1 quart Milk"]
directions: ["Combine hot coffee with sugar; cool. Add vanilla, half-and-half and milk. Stir until combined and pour into small plastic cups. Cover with Saran wrap and freeze until firm. Remove from freezer 10-20 minutes before serving. Serve them when they are slushy. Enjoy!"]

title: Oreo Ice Cream
ingredients: ["1 cup Whole Milk", "1 cup Sugar", "1 pinch Vanilla Or Regular Salt", "2 cups Heavy Cream", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract", "30 Oreo Cookies, Crushed Or Broken"]
directions: ["In a mixer combine the whole milk, sugar and salt. Whisk until sugar dissolves. Add your heavy cream and vanilla extract and whisk again until well combined. Cover the bowl and pop it in your fridge for at least an hour, or overnight. At the same time, put the canister of your ice cream maker in the freezer so it's nice and cold when you make the ice cream.", "Remove the bowl of ice cream mixture from the refrigerator, uncover it and transfer the mixture to your frozen ice cream canister. Place the canister on your machine and turn on. Mix for about 10 minutes, just until it starts to thicken a bit. Add crushed Oreos. Mix again for about another 5 minutes or so.", "You can serve immediately if you like a more soft serve version. Or you can cover it and pop it in the freezer for a couple of hours until it hardens. Just remember to remove it from the freezer a few minutes before serving so it's easier to scoop.", "Serve with a big old Oreo smile!", "*Recipe yields 5 cups."]

title: Café Glacé (Coffee With Ice Cream)
ingredients: ["1 cup Cold Coffee", "3 teaspoons Sugar", "2 Tablespoons Heavy Whipping Cream Or Half-And-Half", "1 pinch Salt", "3 Tablespoons Ice Cream"]
directions: ["Mix all the ingredients except ice cream together. Chill if desired. Place the slightly softened ice cream on the bottom of a glass and pour the coffee mixture on top. Consume immediately."]

title: Pina Colada Soft Serve
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Frozen Pineapple Chunks", "1/2 cups Frozen Cool Whip (I Used Fat Free)", "1/2 cups Milk", "2 Tablespoons Shredded Coconut", "2 teaspoons Honey", "1/2 teaspoons Coconut Extract (optional)"]
directions: ["Place all ingredients in blender and blend for 20-30 seconds. You may enjoy it immediately or put it back in the freezer to firm up to a harder ice cream consistency."]

title: Pina Colada Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 whole Pineapple", "1/2 cups Coconut Milk", "1/2 cups Coconut", "1 cup Ice Cubes"]
directions: ["Add all ingredients to blender and blend until smooth."]

title: Caramelized Cinnamon Kohlrabi
ingredients: ["3 bulbs Kohlrabi", "1 Tablespoon Butter", "1 pinch Salt", "1 teaspoon Sugar", "Cinnamon"]
directions: ["1.) Slice off the outer layers of each bulb until you have 3 rough-looking bulbs.", "2.) In a pan, melt butter on medium-high heat.", "3.) While pan is heating, cut each bulb into 1-inch chunks.", "4.) Add chunks to pan and let cook for 2 minutes. Season with a pinch of salt.", "5.) After chunks heat up, go ahead and sprinkle sugar over the top and let the chunks caramelize for about 6 to 7 minutes. (Note: Chunks will still be a bit crunchy-they won't get soft like a potato.)", "6.) After your kohlrabi has caramelized, sprinkle a pinch of cinnamon on top.", "7.) Enjoy!"]

title: Hot Fudge Sauce
ingredients: ["2 cups Sugar", "4 ounces, weight Unsweetened Chocolate", "1 cup Heavy Cream", "1 teaspoon Vanilla", "4 Tablespoons Butter"]
directions: ["This is one of my all-time favorite recipes. It is from my Aunt Janie and is a family favorite. I remember going to her house as a kid and she always had a pot of this hot fudge sauce on the stove. It made me very happy!", "Combine sugar, chocolate and heavy cream in a double boiler or sauce pan, stirring constantly until all are combined and brought to a slow boil, about 10 minutes. Cool slightly and stir in vanilla and butter.", "That's it! Super simple and quick, the best over ice cream or my favorite - angel food cake and vanilla ice cream. It is a great combination."]

title: Failsafe Homemade Potato Wedges
ingredients: ["4 Potatoes", "3 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "Salt Or Other Preferred Seasonings, To Taste"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 220\u00b0C (425\u00b0F). Fill a large saucepan with water and salt lightly. Wash the potatoes, but leave the skin on.", "Cut them lengthwise in half and then again into quarters (if your potatoes are particularly large you may want to halve them again) or cut them into chips (or use a chipper which is a great invention).", "Put the wedges into the pan of water and turn the hob onto maximum heat. Cook them for 10 minutes. Drain the potatoes. Place the wedges on a baking tray and then drizzle with olive oil and season them to taste (I usually just salt them). Then using a spatula, turn them and do the same to the other side.", "Put the wedges in the oven for about 25 minutes. Turn them every 10 minutes to make sure they cook evenly. When they are crispy and golden on the outside, remove from the oven and serve. Yum, yum!"]

title: Peppermint Twist Hot Chocolate
ingredients: ["10 ounces, weight Dark Chocolate, High Quality", "1 cup Heavy Whipping Cream", "2 Tablespoons Peppermint Schnapps Or 1 Tablespoon Peppermint Extract", "3 cups Milk", "2 Tablespoons Sugar, Heaping", "4 whole Peppermint Sticks"]
directions: ["Place the heavy whipping cream in a saucepan over medium heat. Put the dark chocolate in either another saucepan or a stainless steel bowl. We won't be heating it. Once the cream comes to a boil, pour it directly over the chocolate pieces. Using a wire whisk, stir the mixture until everything is melted and incorporated. Stir in the Peppermint Schnapps. Set the ganache aside.", "In the saucepan that had been used for the cream, heat the milk and sugar over medium-low heat, stirring occasionally. When the milk is warm and starts to froth on top, stir in 1/3 cup of the ganache. Heat until desired temperature is reached. Whip using a mini whisk for froth. Serve with peppermint stick stir sticks to impart more peppermint flavor.", "Kids' version: At the end, top off hot chocolate with 3 tablespoons of cold milk. This will cut the dark chocolate a little bit, but it will also cool it down and make it easier to drink for small mouths.", "21 and older version: Pour a bit of Peppermint Schnapps into the bottom of your mug before filling with hot chocolate. Stir and enjoy.", "Note: allow leftover ganache to cool for several hours on the counter before placing it in an airtight container and storing in the fridge. You can use it to frost cupcakes, to make hot chocolate in the future, or to make my personal favorite, truffles."]

title: Oven Fries
ingredients: ["2 whole Potatoes", "1 teaspoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil", "3 pinches Salt", "2 pinches Pepper"]
directions: ["Preheat the oven to 400\u00b0F.", "Cut the potatoes in strings and place them in an oven safe casserole.", "Add the extra virgin olive oil, salt and pepper, and with your hands, mix them.", "Put them in the oven and bake for about 25 minutes.", "When done baking, broil them for about 5 minutes to make them toasty. (Remember to watch them so that they don't burn.)", "Enjoy!"]

title: Peppermint Almond Iced Cofffee
ingredients: ["1 cup Leftover Morning Brewed Coffee, Chilled", "1/8 teaspoons Pure Mint Extract", "2 Tablespoons Almond Silk Milk", "1 teaspoon Granulated Sugar", "Ice Cubes, As Needed"]
directions: ["In a carafe or pitcher add cold brewed coffee, pure mint extract, almond milk and sugar and stir well. Add to a glass with ice cubes and enjoy!", "This beverage can be served hot if desired."]

title: Broccoli And Blue Cheese Soup
ingredients: ["1 whole Broccoli Head", "4 cups, 3 tablespoons, 1-7/8 teaspoons, 1/4 pinches Chicken Stock", "1-7/8 ounces, weight Gorgonzola Cheese", "1 pinch Salt", "1 pinch Pepper"]
directions: ["Cut the broccoli into equal sized florets and boil in the chicken stock for about 4-5 minutes. Transfer the broccoli to the blender together with half of the stock (using all will be too watery) and give it a quick whiz. Season with salt and pepper and pour into serving bowls. Crumble some Gorgonzola on top and serve with crusty bread (and with some garlic butter if you happen to have some lying around in the fridge).", "This will make a rather thin and watery soup as no ingredients with binders are used. However, adding a potato or two in the pot when boiling will increase the preparation time by approximately 10 minutes and will make a much more creamy soup. A few tablespoons of heavy cream will make it even more velvety, though probably a little less healthy.", "The cheese used in this soup entirely depends on what appeals to you. If the idea of a strong and very flavorsome Roquefort does not seem very attractive then a lighter and softer Gorgonzola will go nicely with it. I prefer to use stronger cheese when potatoes are added to the soup, and Gorgonzola with pure broccoli."]

title: Pear & Watercress Soup
ingredients: ["1 whole Baguette, Thinly Cut On The Bias", "2 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "3 whole Ripe Pears, Cored And Peeled And Sliced", "1 Tablespoon Butter", "3 whole Shallots, Peeled And Thinly Sliced", "2 cups Potatoes, Peeled And Roughly Chopped", "4 cups Chicken Broth", "3 cups Watercress", "1 cup Heavy Cream, Divided", "1 Tablespoon Sea Salt", "1/2 cups Goat Cheese"]
directions: ["1. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F. Diagonally cut six 1/2-inch-thick slices of baguette for thin croutons. Brush the top side of the slices with olive oil and place on a baking tray. Bake for 6 minutes or until toasty and browned.", "2. Meanwhile, peel, core and slice pears. You should have 3 1/2 to 4 cups. Heat butter in a large saucepan over medium heat until bubbly and browning. Add the shallots and cook 5 minutes or until soft. Add potatoes and pears and then pour in the broth.", "3. Bring to a boil. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes. Set aside 6 to 8 watercress sprigs for garnish and add remaining watercress to the soup. Heat over medium heat for 5 minutes or until hot. Puree the soup in batches in a blender until smooth.", "4. Return soup to the saucepan and stir in 1/2 cup of heavy cream. Heat until hot. Season to taste.", "5. Top each crouton with goat cheese. Ladle soup into six bowls and drizzle remaining heavy cream around soup edges. Place a crouton in the middle and garnish with extra crumbles of goat cheese and a watercress sprig."]

title: Peanutty Banana Crunch Oatmeal
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Old Fashioned Oats", "1/2 whole Banana, Mashed", "1 Tablespoon Peanut Butter", "1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar", "1 teaspoon Vanilla", "Cinnamon", "1 Tablespoon Granola"]
directions: ["Cook oats according to package directions. Stir in the banana, peanut butter, brown sugar, and vanilla. Add as much cinnamon as you like. Top with granola."]

title: Cheesy Spicy Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: ["1 pound Potatoes", "4 Tablespoons Sour Cream", "2 Tablespoons Milk", "1-1/2 cup Sharp Cheddar Cheese, Finely Shredded", "1 teaspoon Cayenne Pepper"]
directions: ["Scrub potatoes and peel if desired. Cut into 1\" cubes.", "Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Boil potatoes until soft, about 15 minutes. Drain.", "Start mashing potatoes, going until you have achieved a rough lumpy mash using whatever method you prefer. (I just use a pastry cutter and a fork).", "Thoroughly mix in sour cream. If the potatoes are not creamy enough, add milk and stir to combine.", "Stir in cheese, adding it in batches of 1/4 to 1/2 cup at a time. Keep stirring until completely and evenly combined.", "Add cayenne pepper and stir. (This much pepper will produce a mild level of heat for spice aficionados while still preserving the cheesy flavor, so scale back a bit if this is too much for you.)"]

title: Peanut Butter Pretzel Fudge
ingredients: ["2 bags (11 Oz. Bag) White Chocolate Morsels (good Quality)", "1/2 cups Creamy Peanut Butter", "4 ounces, weight Milk Chocolate (good Quality)", "80 whole Mini-pretzel Twists"]
directions: ["Melt white chocolate and peanut butter together until creamy. I do this in the microwave. Starting at one minute, stir, add 30-second intervals of heating, then continue stirring until smooth.", "Spread on a parchment-lined cookie sheet.", "Melt milk chocolate and drizzle over the white chocolate. Using a knife, you pull the chocolate so that the two blend together.", "Immediately press in the pretzel twists. Allow to cool and set. Cut into squares. Eat and enjoy!"]

title: Peanut Butter Cup Cookies
ingredients: ["24 Mini Peanut Butter Cups, Unwrapped", "1 whole (14 Oz. Size) Roll Peanut Butter Cookie Dough"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350 F. Set the unwrapped peanut butter cups aside.", "Slice the roll of cookie dough into 1 1/2 inch slices. Lay the slices on their side and cut them into quarters. Place each quarter into a hole in a greased 24-count mini-muffin tin.", "Bake the cookie dough in a 350 F oven for just a few minutes, about 6 to 8 at the most. You'll want to take them out just when they start to turn golden. The cookies will be pouf-ey at this point.", "Almost as soon as you pull the warm cookies from the oven, begin lightly pressing one peanut butter cup into each cookie so that the cookie envelops the peanut butter cup. The warmer the cookies, the better. They'll grab onto the pieces of candy and work their magic, making the candy nice and soft and melty. And ridiculous.", "Let them cool slightly, then carefully remove them from the muffin tins with a spoon and serve them on a platter."]

title: Peanut Butter Cookies (Flourless)
ingredients: ["1 cup Peanut Butter", "1 Egg", "1 cup Sugar"]
directions: ["Mix all ingredients till well blended. Place cookie dough in small rounds (teaspoon size is best) on ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 350\u00b0F for 7 to 9 minutes. They should be barely changing color. If you overcook them, they will be too hard. You can decorate them by dipping a fork in sugar and pressing down on the dough in a criss-cross pattern before baking."]

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: ["1 cup Natural Peanut Butter", "1 cup Presweet Tagatose Or Sugar", "1 whole Egg (or Egg Substitute)", "1/3 cups Cashews, Chopped Small"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper; set aside.", "In a large bowl and using a wooden spoon, beat together the peanut butter and sugar until creamy. Beat in the egg. Mix until well combined. Fold in cashews.", "Roll cookies into tight balls and place about 2\" apart on baking sheet. Gently flatten in crisscross pattern with a fork.", "Bake for 7-10 minutes, until lightly golden. Once done, leave on cookie sheet to cool for 2 minutes and place on a cooling rack.", "Recipe from It's Yummy to My Tummy's Blog."]

title: Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: ["1 Large Egg", "1/2 cups Sugar", "1/2 cups Brown Sugar", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract", "1 cup Creamy Peanut Butter"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F. Line baking sheet with parchment paper.", "Beat egg in a large bowl with a mixer until foamy. Add remaining ingredients; beat until well blended. Shape into 1-inch balls. Place 2 inches apart on baking sheet. Flatten gently with a fork.", "Bake 10 minutes or until lightly browned."]

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Pretzel Ice Cream
ingredients: ["1 cup Creamy Peanut Butter", "1-1/4 cup Whole Milk", "2 cups Heavy Cream", "3/4 cups Sugar", "2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract", "1/2 cups Chopped Pretzels", "1/2 cups Semisweet Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["Melt the peanut butter in a saucepan. Try not to eat melted peanut butter. Add the milk and stir until combined. Add the cream, sugar, and vanilla. Stir until combined.", "Chill mixture in the fridge.", "Pour mixture in your beautiful ice cream machine. Meanwhile, chop your pretzels and chocolate chips. Snacking is allowed here (preferably with the reserved melted peanut butter that you had from a few steps back).", "Add toppings after 20 minutes of churning. Pour into an airtight container and freeze for at least 2 hours.", "Makes about 1.5 quarts."]

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Ice Cream
ingredients: ["1 cup Whole Milk", "3/4 cups Sugar", "2 cups Heavy Cream", "1-1/2 cup Creamy Peanut Butter", "3/4 cups Mini Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["Combine milk, sugar, cream and peanut butter using an electric mixer.", "Pour into ice cream maker, turn on for 15 minutes.", "Add chocolate chips, and allow ice cream maker to continue for 5 more minutes.", "Makes about 1 1/4 quarts."]

title: Mulled Wine (Glühwein) – Original Alcoholic Version
ingredients: ["1 bottle (750ml Bottle) Medium Red Wine", "3 ounces, fluid Brandy", "1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar", "1 whole Orange Thinly Sliced (rind And All)", "1 whole Lemon, Thinly Sliced (rind And All)", "3 whole Cinnamon Sticks", "6 whole Cloves"]
directions: ["Heat all the ingredients in a saucepan and simmer for 30 minutes. DO NOT BOIL!", "Strain and serve hot!"]

title: Homemade Caramel Sauce
ingredients: ["16 Tablespoons Salted Butter", "2 cups Packed Brown Sugar", "1/2 cups Milk", "2 teaspoons Vanilla"]
directions: ["In a large pot melt butter over medium heat.", "Once butter is completely melted, add in the brown sugar and bring to a boil, stirring continuously until brown sugar is completely dissolved, about 2-3 minutes.", "Mix milk into pan, making sure to pour it in slowly and constantly stirring. The mixture will bubble and make noises (this is normal). Bring mixture back to a boil for 2 minutes on low heat and continue to constantly stir caramel sauce.", "Remove from heat and add vanilla.", "Set aside and let cool for 30-40 minutes or until it is cool enough to work with.", "Store unused caramel sauce in refrigerator in an airtight container. When ready to use, take out and take the lid off and microwave for 45 seconds. Stir and serve."]

title: Peanut Butter And Chocolate Ice Cream Shell
ingredients: ["1 cup Chocolate Chips", "1/2 cups Coconut Oil", "1 cup Peanut Butter"]
directions: ["In a saucepan, melt chocolate chips over medium heat. Add coconut oil and stir to combine. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter and continue stirring until peanut butter is melted.", "Serve over ice cream."]

title: Peach Preserves
ingredients: ["2 cans 29 Oz Each Peaches In Heavy Syrup", "2 cups Sugar"]
directions: ["Pour peaches and syrup into a medium-sized pot. Heat over medium-low for half an hour, stirring occasionally. Gently stir in sugar. Raise heat to medium and continue cooking for an hour and a half to two hours, or until the peaches have cooked down to 1/3 or 1/4 of their original volume and have the consistency of jam or preserves. Remove from heat. Store in refrigerator or in pantry if canned properly. This recipe yields 3 half-pint jars."]

title: Crushed Potatoes With Chive Sour Cream
ingredients: ["8 whole Small Potatoes, About 2\" In Diameter (I Used Yukon Golds)", "Olive Oil, For Drizzling On Your Baking Sheet And Potatoes", "Sea Salt And Black Pepper, Freshly Ground - To Taste", "1 cup Shredded Cheddar Cheese (I Used New Zealand White)", "1/2 cups Sour Cream", "2 Tablespoons Finely Chopped/snipped Chives"]

title: Beurre Noisette – The Best One Ingredient Sauce In The World
ingredients: ["2 sticks Butter, Unsalted"]
directions: ["Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat and and leave it over medium-low heat for about 30 minutes. You will soon see bubbles coming up to the surface. title: Blackberry Jam Without Added Pectin
ingredients: ["7 cups Blackberries, Ripe But Not Overly Ripe, Divided", "5-1/2 cups Sugar ( I Use Organic To Make Organic Jam)"]
directions: ["Wash and rinse all canning jars, lids and bands in hot soapy water. Rinse well.", "Wash berries well and remove any debris.", "In a large canner or a very large pot, fill with water and bring to a boil. Water will need to be able to cover glass jars by 2 inches when sealed. Add clean jars to the pot.", "In a small pot, bring water to a boil.", "Place a small plate in the freezer to check consistency of jam.", "Remove 3 cups of the berries and place in a sieve with a pestle to remove the seeds. Smash until juice has been removed. Alternately, you could smash the 3 cups berries with a potato masher and run that through a fine strainer to remove seeds, or if you like the seeds, smash the fruit well with the potato masher and use like you would the 3 cups berries with seeds removed. Do not blend your berries, it will destroy the natural pectin.", "Place the juice from the berries into a large stock pot and add all of the sugar. Mix together and bring to a boil over medium heat. Once the mixture boils, add remaining 4 cups of berries and smash half or more with a potato masher, depending on how chunky you like your jam. The more berries you smash, the smoother the jam. Return berries to a boil and cook for about 13 minutes. Jam is about done when foaming has subsided and jam becomes a rich glossy red color. Take the plate from the freezer and place a large dollop of jam on the plate and place back into the freezer for 1 minute. After a minute, run a finger through the jam. Jam is ready to be canned when juices from the berries stay separated and don't run. Jam will still be a bit thin but not runny. If jam is still runny, continue to cook checking every minute for set with plate from the freezer.", "In the small pot with boiling water, remove from heat and add lids.", "Remove a jar from the canner and place on a clean work surface. Fill the jar using a canning funnel. Leave 1/4 inch head space from the top of the jar. Clean the edge of the jar to remove any jam with a clean damp cloth. Cover with a lid from the small pot and seal with a rim, until finger tight. Place back into the canning pot and repeat with all the remaining jars. Make sure the water in the canning pot is boiling and there is enough water to cover jars by at least 2 inches.", "When all the jars are back into the canning pot, process for 10 minutes covered.", "Removed jars to an area they can rest for 24 hours undisturbed.", "Tip: If I don't have enough jam to fill a jar all the way, I place that jar in the fridge and it is the first jar to be eaten. Jar lids will make a popping noise as the jars seal, do not be alarmed. Never double this recipe or it might not set correctly. Work in single batches."]

title: 3 Ingredient Homemade Butterfingers
ingredients: ["16 ounces, weight Candy Corn", "16 ounces, weight Creamy Peanut Butter", "3 cups Milk Or Dark Chocolate"]
directions: ["Line an 8x8 or 9x9 inch pan with wax paper.", "Melt the candy corn in the microwave in a medium bowl, stirring every 30 seconds. Continue heating for 30 seconds at a time, stirring in between, until melted and smooth. Stir in the peanut butter until equally distributed and smooth. Pour into prepared pan and smooth. Place in the freezer for 10-20 minutes until firm.", "In the meantime line a large baking sheet with wax paper.", "Take the chilled bars out of the pan and cut them into mini Butterfinger size bars (I just eyeballed it - you can too!).", "Melt the chocolate in a clean medium bowl in the microwave stirring every 30 seconds and continuing to heat for additional 30 second bursts until smooth.", "Using a fork, dip each Butterfinger into the chocolate, turning to cover completely. Take the bar out of chocolate with fork and tap lightly on the side of the bowl so that excess chocolate falls off. Place on the wax paper lined baking sheet. Continue with Butterfingers until all are dipped. (If at any point your chocolate becomes too hard to dip, simply return it to the microwave and heat for another 10-15 seconds and stir. Do this throughout the process as needed.)", "When all bars have been dipped, place them in the freezer for an additional 5-10 minutes. Enjoy."]

title: Meyer Lemon Martini
ingredients: ["4 ounces, fluid Good Vodka", "2 ounces, fluid Meyer Lemon Juice", "1/2 cups Fine Sugar, On A Small Plate To Line The Rim Of The Glass", "2 slices Meyer Lemon, For Garnish"]
directions: ["In martini shaker combine vodka and lemon juice with a generous amount of ice. Shake vigorously for a few seconds. Rub the rim of a glass with a lemon slice and dip the rim in sugar. Strain the lemon vodka mixture into the glass and garnish with lemon slices."]

title: Chocolate Nut Bark
ingredients: ["3-5/8 ounces, weight Dark Chocolate", "5-1/3 ounces, weight Milk Chocolate", "1 cup Mixed Nuts (hazel Nuts, Pistachios, Cashew Nuts, Pecans, Almonds, Walnuts)"]
directions: ["Line a baking tray with baking paper. Roughly chop the chocolate and melt in a double boiler or in the microwave. Stir to combine and spread the melted chocolate over the baking paper to your desired thickness. Sprinkle the nuts over the melted chocolate (I chopped the slightly larger ones like cashew nuts and walnuts in half before doing so). Put in the fridge to set. Once set, break or cut into pieces. Can be stored in the refrigerator for at least a week, if not more."]

title: 3-Ingredient Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: ["18 ounces, weight Heavy Whipped Cream (Not Whipping Cream), Homemade Or Store-bought", "15 ounces, weight Condensed Milk", "2 Tablespoons Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["Pour whipped heavy cream into a large bowl. Add condensed milk and vanilla extract. Fold until uniform, about 3 minutes.", "Pour creamed mixture into a cooled ice cream container. Refrigerate for at least 6 hours before serving, for best results."]

title: 3-Ingredient Simple Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: ["2 cups Heavy Cream", "1 can (14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk", "1 Tablespoon Vanilla"]
directions: ["Whip heavy cream until peaks form. Don't go too far or else you'll end up with butter! Add sweetened condensed milk and vanilla, and beat until fully combined.", "Pour mixture into a large container and cover tightly with it's lid. Freeze for 2 hours. Take mixture out of freezer, and if it is still soft and runny as when you started, stir well and place back into the freezer until frozen (overnight is best). Stirring it prevents ice crystals from forming, so you will end up with smooth and creamy ice cream!"]

title: Grape Jam
ingredients: ["4 pounds Seedless Grapes", "3 cups Sugar", "3 Tablespoons Fresh Lemon Juice"]
directions: ["Prepare canning jars.", "Add grapes, sugar and lemon juice into a large pot. Over medium heat, stir to combine. Insert immersion blender below surface and blend to desired consistency. Stir often, skimming off foam when needed. Boil until mixture reaches 220\u00b0F and/or passes the freezer test.", "Ladle jam into jars, leaving 1/4 inch headspace. Wipe off rims with a clean damp cloth. Top with lids and process for 10 minutes. Transfer to towels to cool.", "Label and date."]

title: Maple Whipped Cream
ingredients: ["1 pint Heavy Whipping Cream", "3 Tablespoons Real Maple Syrup"]
directions: ["Pour whipping cream in a cold mixer bowl and whip until cream starts to thicken up.", "Then add maple syrup and continue to whip until soft peaks start to form.", "Spoon into a pretty dish and serve on the side of any pie or crisp; also delicious in coffee.", "*Note this can be made several hours ahead of time. Store covered in plastic wrap in refrigerator."]

title: Zucchini Bread In A Bowl
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Old Fashioned Oats", "2 Tablespoons Shredded Zucchini", "1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar", "1/2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract", "1 pinch Cinnamon", "1 pinch Allspice", "1 Tablespoon Chopped Pecans"]
directions: ["1. Prepare oatmeal according to the package instructions.", "2. After the oats have cooked, stir in the zucchini, brown sugar, and vanilla. Add a few shakes of cinnamon and allspice. Top with chopped pecans."]

title: Crockpot Baked Potatoes
ingredients: ["6 whole Russet Potatoes"]
directions: ["Wash potatoes and cut out any bruised spots. Wrap each potato in foil. Cook in covered crock pot on low for 6-8 hours or until tender.", "Top with desired toppings, such as cheese, sour cream, onions, bacon, etc."]

title: Melted Christmas Candy Ornaments
ingredients: ["1 bag Old Fashioned Hard Candy (like Brach's, 10 Ounce Bag)"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350 F. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper. Arrange candy in desired designs, patterns and shapes (the size that you want your ornaments to be). See the related link for photos. Place in the oven and heat for approximately 9 or 10 minutes, until candy is melted. Remove from the oven and allow to cool before removing from baking sheet."]

title: Almond Roca
ingredients: ["6 ounces, weight Slivered Almonds", "1 cup Butter", "1 cup Granulated Sugar", "2 cups Chocolate Chips", "3 ounces, weight Sliced Almonds"]
directions: ["Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil. Lightly butter the foil and set aside.", "Place the slivered almonds in a single layer on a baking sheet and toast in the oven at 300 degrees (F) for about 5-6 minutes, checking often, until the almonds are golden brown and toasted. Remove from the oven and set aside to cool.", "In a medium saucepan over low heat, combine the butter and sugar and cook, stirring constantly with a heatproof spatula until the butter is completely melted and the sugar is dissolved. Don't rush this step! It may take up to five or six minutes for the sugar to dissolve but you don't want the heat too high during this part of the process. Once the sugar is dissolved and butter melted, turn the heat up to medium and stir gently as the mixture comes to a boil. Again, this may take a few minutes. Once it comes to a boil, clip a candy thermometer to the side of the pan and continue stirring gently as it cooks. The mixture will gradually turn to darker shades of brown until it reaches the hard crack stage and should register 300 degrees on your candy thermometer. As you stir during this process, don't scrape the sides of the pan, just gently stir in a figure eight motion.", "Immediately take the roca off the stove once it hits 300 degrees and stir in the toasted, slivered almonds. Pour the candy onto the prepared baking sheet, taking care not to scrape the bottom of the pot as you pour it out. Using an offset spatula, quickly spread the toffee into an even layer on the baking sheet - it will cool quickly making it hard to spread.", "Sprinkle the chocolate chips over the hot toffee and tent with foil. Let the chocolate melt for 2-3 minutes, remove the tented foil and spread the chocolate chips into an even layer. Sprinkle the remaining sliced almonds over the top of the roca and set the candy aside to let the chocolate set and to let the roca cool completely. (You can refrigerate it to let the chocolate set up but sometimes the quick cooling from the refrigerator can cause the chocolate to bloom - which means it develops white streaks and blotches while it cools. It doesn't affect the taste but it doesn't look as pretty as smooth, shiny chocolate.)", "Once cool and the chocolate is set, break into pieces."]

title: Blood Orange And Strawberry Daiquiri
ingredients: ["1/3 cups Blood Orange Juice (for 1/3 Cup You'll Need 3 Blood Oranges)", "1-1/2 cup Strawberries, Froen", "1/2 Tablespoons Lime Juice", "1 ounce, fluid White Rum", "1 teaspoon Sugar (more To Taste)", "1 cup Ice Cubes"]
directions: ["Add all ingredients into a blender and process until smooth. Pour into a glass and serve."]

title: German Buttercream
ingredients: ["2 packages (1.3 Oz. Size) Vanilla Cook & Serve Pudding", "4 cups Milk", "1/2 cups Sugar, Plus Extra To Sprinkle On Top Of Pudding If Needed", "4 sticks Butter", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract", "2 Tablespoons Rum Or Other Liquor, Or Less As Needed (optional)"]
directions: ["It is important that the butter and all of the other ingredients have the same temperature to prevent the buttercream from splitting, so take the butter out of the fridge right away.", "In a medium saucepan, prepare the pudding with the milk and sugar, according to the package instructions. Place the saucepan in a cold water bath and sprinkle the pudding's surface with sugar to prevent a skin from forming (alternatively, press some cling film lightly against the pudding's surface). Once cooled, stir the pudding until smooth. If there are any lumps, force it through a sieve.", "When the butter and the pudding are both at room temperature, whip the butter for about 15 minutes. Once it has become white and fluffy, switch to the paddle attachment and add the pudding, about two tablespoons at a time, at low speed. Once all the pudding has been incorporated, stir in the vanilla extract and any liquor you'd like to add (up to 2 tablespoons).", "Makes enough to cover and fill one 9-inch cake.", "Tips:", "If the buttercream should split, you can try heating (but not browning) a tablespoon of butter and quickly mixing it through the split buttercream.", "To flavor the buttercream, you can use chocolate or fruit-flavored pudding mix, or you can add flavoring liquids to the finished buttercream. It holds up well to freshly squeezed fruit juice, cold coffe, and all kinds of liquor (rum is good). Add the liquids to taste but make sure you don't use too much or the buttercream will not firm up enough."]

title: Ham ‘N Arugula Mason Jar Lunch Salad
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Diced Deli Cooked Ham", "2 teaspoons Sweet Pickle Relish", "1/2 teaspoons Black Pepper", "2 Tablespoons Mayonnaise", "4 leaves Fresh Arugula (rinsed, Dried, Coarsely Chopped)", "2 Tablespoons Pineapple Chunks"]
directions: ["In a bowl, add diced ham, relish, black pepper, and mayonnaise. Stir well to combine.", "Using a sterilized Mason jar, layer bottom with half the coarsely chopped arugula. Add several spoonfuls of ham salad. Add pineapple chunks. Repeat one more layer of each. Seal with a lid or cover with plastic wrap, and refrigerate until ready to serve. Or take to work in the morning, keeping it refrigerated until ready to eat.", "Delicious lunch on the go! Enjoy."]

title: Captain Morgan Blackberry Ginger Ale
ingredients: ["1 ounce, fluid Captain Morgan Spiced Rum", "2 ounces, fluid Canada Dry Blackberry Ginger Ale", "5 whole Blackberries", "1 slice Fresh Lime"]
directions: ["Pour rum and ginger ale over ice. Toss in a handful of fresh blackberries and garnish with lime slice."]

title: White Chocolate Candy Corn M&M And Peanut Butter Oat Balls
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Peanut Butter", "3/4 cups White Chocolate Candy Corn M&Ms, Divided", "1 cup Old Fashioned Oats"]
directions: ["Microwave peanut butter 45 seconds. Stir and set aside.", "In a separate bowl, microwave 1/2 cup M&Ms for 30 seconds. Stir and microwave 30 seconds more. Crush M&Ms with the back of a spoon and stir.", "Add melted M&Ms to the melted peanut butter and stir to combine.", "Add peanut butter mixture and remaining 1/4 cup chopped M&Ms to the oats in a large bowl and stir until well combined.", "Form into balls and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving."]

title: Chicken And Black Bean Tostadas
ingredients: ["1 cup Refried Black Beans", "6 whole Store-bought Corn Tostadas (or Stale Tortillas, Toasted Until Crisp)", "2 cups Leftover Cooked Chicken, Shredded With A Fork", "1 whole Avocado, diced", "1/2 cups Crumbled Feta Cheese", "Fresh Cilantro Leaves, Lime Wedges And Fresh Salsa, For Serving (optional)"]
directions: ["Warm refried beans on the stove in a small pot over medium heat; set aside.", "Spread each tostada with equal amounts of refried beans. Top each with equal amounts of chicken, avocado and feta. If desired, top with cilantro, a squeeze of lime, salsa and shredded lettuce. Serve immediately."]

title: Maple Olive Oil Granola
ingredients: ["3 cups Old Fashioned Oats", "1 cup Pepitas", "1 cup Unsweetened Shredded Coconut", "1 cup Almonds", "1-1/4 cup Walnuts", "3/4 cups Maple Syrup", "1/2 cups Olive Oil", "1/2 cups Brown Sugar"]
directions: ["1. Heat oven to 300\u00b0F.", "2. Place all ingredients in a bowl and stir. Transfer to a 9x13 pan. Cook for 45 minutes, stirring every 15 minutes.", "3. Allow to cool completely before storing.", "Adapted from Non-Reactive Pan."]

title: Goul-Tini
ingredients: ["1 package (about 1/3 Oz. Packet) Pop Rocks", "1-1/2 ounce, fluid Cold Vodka", "1-1/2 ounce, fluid 7-up"]
directions: ["Chill a martini glass.", "Empty the poprocks into the bottom of the glass", "In a martini shaker filled with ice, shake the vodka.", "Strain it onto the poprocks.", "Top it with a shot glass of 7-up.", "Serve immediately while still \"crackling!\""]

title: Maple Cinnamon Almond Butter
ingredients: ["1-1/2 cup Raw Almonds", "3 Tablespoons Maple Syrup, Divided", "1/2 teaspoons Salt", "3/4 teaspoons Cinnamon", "1/2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.", "Toss almonds with 2 tablespoons of maple syrup in a medium bowl. Spread out onto baking sheet. Roast almonds for 10-15 minutes, tossing a couple of times.", "Remove almonds and let cool 3-5 minutes.", "Place almonds in food processor and process for 8-10 minutes, scraping down the sides when needed until it becomes creamy. Add remaining ingredients, including the remaining tablespoon of maple syrup and process again until combined and creamy."]

title: Herb-Paired Roasted Fall Veggies
ingredients: ["1 whole Zucchini, Cut Into 2 Inch Slices", "1 whole Onion, Cut Into Wedges", "1 whole Sweet Potato, Peeled And Cut Into Cubes", "2 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "Fresh Parsley", "1 sprig Tarragon", "1 teaspoon Cinnamon", "Fresh Thyme Stems", "2 teaspoons Trader Joe's 21 Seasoning Salute Seasoning", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 425\u00b0F.", "Place each of the cut veggies in a separate Ziploc baggie.", "Toss the zucchini with some olive oil and fresh whole parsley stems.", "Toss the onion with the remaining olive oil and a large tarragon stem.", "Toss the sweet potato with cinnamon and fresh thyme stems.", "Add Trader Joe's 21 Seasoning Salute to each of the veggie bags. Season with salt and pepper.", "Arrange the veggies in separate rows on a cookie sheet with the fresh herbs tucked under them. They'll blacken while cooking, but that's okay. You'll remove them before serving.", "Roast for 20-25 minutes until tender. Spoon veggies onto a white platter and serve warm or room temperature."]

title: Make-Ahead Cinnamon Toast Spread
ingredients: ["1/4 cups Sugar", "1 Tablespoon Cinnamon", "1/2 cups Butter, Softened", "1/4 teaspoons Mexican Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["Combine ingredients in a small bowl. Mix it together with your hand mixer, until it's well combined. Scrape down the sides of the bowl. Cover the bowl.", "Store on the counter until you're ready for some wonderfully scrumptious cinnamon toast, with just the right amount of cinnamon and sugar and melty butter."]

title: Lemon Parsley Butter
ingredients: ["1 whole Lemon, Washed Well, Zest And Juice", "1 stick Lightly Salted Butter, Softened", "2 Tablespoons Fresh Parsley Chopped Finely"]
directions: ["Put the lemon zest and juice into a mixing bowl. Add the butter and parsley and whip together with a sturdy spatula. Pack in an airtight container and refrigerate until ready to use. Enjoy! I just used some of this on a bowl of cooked egg noodles and it was delicious!"]

title: Pineapple-Banana Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 Banana, Peeled", "1 cup Chopped Pineapple", "1/2 cups Yogurt", "4 Ice Cubes"]
directions: ["Place all the ingredients in a blender and blend until fully incorporated. Pour into two glasses and enjoy!"]

title: Cinnamon Sugared Bacon
ingredients: ["1/2 Tablespoons Cinnamon", "3 Tablespoons Brown Sugar", "8 slices Applewood Smoked Bacon"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 375\u00b0F. Lay a wire rack on top of a baking sheet.", "On a large plate, mix sugar and cinnamon. Dredge bacon slices through the mix, lightly patting the sugar on top. Lay strips on the wire rack and bake for 20-25 minutes, flipping the bacon once. Remove and drain on paper towels for 1 minute."]

title: Linguica Hash
ingredients: ["5 whole Potatoes", "2 whole Linguica Links", "1 whole Onion", "1 whole Bell Pepper", "1 Tablespoon Olive Oil", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Peel and dice the potatoes and linguica into a quarter inch dice. Dice onion and pepper.", "In a large skillet add potatoes and linguica in enough water to cover. Bring to a boil and cook until potatoes are fork tender. Drain and add back to skillet with olive oil, onions and peppers. Cook over medium heat, letting the hash get nicely browned and veggies tender. Season with salt and pepper to taste."]

title: Pineapple & Watermelon Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 cup Pineapple Chunks", "1 cup Seedless Watermelon Chunks", "1/2 cups Almond Silk Milk", "1/2 cups 1% Low-fat Milk"]
directions: ["In a blender add pineapple and watermelon chunks and pulse several times. Add almond milk and 1% milk and run blender on high for 4 minutes. Pour into 2 glasses and enjoy. This smoothie is so delicious and refreshing! Enjoy."]

title: Cherry Vanilla Protein Shake
ingredients: ["1 cup Cherries, Frozen", "1 cup Coconut Milk From Carton Or Non-fat Milk", "1 whole Scoop (30g Size) Vanilla Protein Powder"]
directions: ["Add all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth."]

title: Guilt-Free French Fries
ingredients: ["5 whole Waxy Potatoes (Medium-sized)", "2/3 cups Olive Oil", "1 Tablespoon Seasoned Salt (I Use Lawry's)"]
directions: ["Note: I have also used both chicken bouillon powder and chicken/beef seasoning packets in the past in place of seasoned salt and they worked splendidly. Feel free to jazz up the potatoes any way you like!", "Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F.", "Peel potatoes and slice lengthwise into 1/4\" thick matchsticks.", "Transfer potato matchsticks into a microwave-safe bowl and fill with water just until they cover the potatoes. Microwave on high for about 4 minutes.", "Remove from the microwave and pour cold water into the bowl to stop the potatoes from cooking. Drain the water from the bowl.", "Pour the olive oil in the bowl and toss the potatoes till completely coated in olive oil.", "Cover a cookie sheet with aluminum foil and transfer the potatoes to the cookie sheet with a slotted spoon. Try not to let the potatoes overlap one another. Drizzle VERY lightly some of the olive oil from the bowl onto the potatoes. Sprinkle with the seasoned salt and bake for 20 minutes or until light golden brown in color."]

title: Caramel Vodka Root Beer Float Shooter
ingredients: ["2 ounces, weight Edy's Caramel Delight Ice Cream Or Similar", "1 ounce, fluid Caramel Flavored Vodka", "3 ounces, fluid Root Beer", "1 Tablespoon (generous) Whipped Cream"]
directions: ["Note: Adjust quantity to the size of your shooter glass, using a ratio of 1 part vodka to 3 parts root beer. This recipe is for a 5-ounce shooter glass.", "Place two leveled scoops of ice cream into a shooter glass using a 1-ounce scoop. Add vodka. Slowly pour in root beer, waiting for bubbles to subside before adding more. Top with a dollop of whipped cream."]

title: Lemony Quinoa And Kale Salad
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Dry Quinoa", "1/2 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "1/3 cups Chopped Onion", "1 cup Kale", "3 Tablespoons Lemon Juice"]
directions: ["Rinse quinoa in a strainer under cold water, then follow cooking instructions on package. Fluff and set aside.", "Heat olive oil in a saucepan on medium heat, then add chopped onion. Saute until onions are cooked and browning a little. Turn off heat and add in kale. Toss to combine and allow heat to wilt kale.", "Transfer vegetables to quinoa, then toss with lemon juice. Garnish with a lemon slice if desired and enjoy!"]

title: Lime Creamsicles

directions: ["Pour milk, lime juice and sweetened condensed milk into a large bowl; stir until well combined.", "Pour mixture into 12 3-ounce popsicle molds; place a popsicle stick in the center of each mold.", "Cover and freeze at least 8 hours or overnight. To easily remove popsicles from the mold, dip the mold in a bowl or container of warm water for 10 to 15 seconds."]

title: Easy Iced Coffee
ingredients: ["1 cup Leftover Coffee, Room Temperature", "1 Tablespoon Cream (optional)", "Ice Cube Tray, For Freezing The Coffee (6 Cube Size)", "Hot Brewed Coffee, For Serving"]
directions: ["Pour the room temperature coffee into the ice cube tray and freeze. When you are ready, place a couple of frozen coffee cubes into your coffee mug or pour it over your cream or milk. I actually pour a bit of hot coffee over the cubes as well to begin the melting process.", "What's great about this, is you typically have frozen cubes after you end your drink. This is great, because as they continue to melt you still get more coffee, and who doesn't love that, right?"]

title: Apple Pie Protein Shake

directions: ["Place all ingredients into blender and blend until smooth. Sprinkle more cinnamon on top if you like.", "Enjoy this yummy dessert-like goodness!"]

title: Blueberry Cream Smoothie
ingredients: ["5-1/3 ounces, weight Vanilla Greek Yogurt", "1/2 cups Blueberries, Frozen", "1 cup Non-fat Milk, Plain", "1 teaspoon Honey (optional)"]
directions: ["Add all ingredients to a blender and process until smooth."]

title: Lemon Truffles
ingredients: ["1 cup White Chocolate, Coarsely Chopped", "5 Tablespoons Butter, Unsalted", "3 Tablespoons Half-and-Half (or Heavy Cream)", "1 pinch Salt", "1 teaspoon Lemon Extract", "2-1/2 cups White Chocolate (for Coating; You Could Also Use Dark)"]
directions: ["Place the 1 cup of white chocolate, butter, and half-and-half in a microwave safe bowl and melt for 20-30 seconds at a time, stirring in between (you could also do this in a double boiler over boiling water). Once melted, stir in salt and lemon extract. Place in the fridge for at least two hours.", "The mix will still be rather soft after its time in the fridge. With a melon baller or measuring spoon, plop small (truffle-sized) balls of the mix on a cookie sheet covered with cling film and freeze for about half an hour.", "Melt white chocolate for coating in the microwave, again, 20-30 seconds at a time, stirring occasionally (again, you could use a double boiler). Stop heating the chocolate when there are still a few lumps visible. Stir until these, too, have melted. This is an easy way of tempering your chocolate and will give the finished coating a nice shine and a little crunch. Let the melted chocolate cool a little. It should still be creamy but not too hot.", "Take the truffle balls out of the freezer a few at a time, dunk them in the melted chocolate one by one and make sure to coat them completely. Let the excess chocolate drip off and quickly place your truffles in the fridge or freezer until the chocolate is hardened.", "If you would like to add sprinkles or decorating sugar, sprinkle these on quickly before returning to the fridge/freezer.", "You can store these for quite some time in the freezer. Otherwise, keep them in the fridge. They will be nice and refreshing right out of the cold!", "Notes:", "*Heavy cream will probably (I haven't tried it with this recipe yet) result in a firmer truffle, so if you would like to omit the chocolate coating, use heavy cream instead of half-and-half and simply roll the truffle balls and don't coat them in chocolate. You could roll them in (white) sprinkles (leave out the step of freezing them in this case).", "*Don't forget to keep chocolate in an airtight container when stored in the fridge so it doesn't take on the taste and smell of other food in the fridge.", "*Cook time is time in the fridge and freezer*"]

title: Basil Watermelon Lemonade
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Pureed Watermelon", "1/3 cups Lemon Juice", "6 Basil Leaves", "1/8 cups Sugar"]
directions: ["Puree watermelon in blender. Place strainer over a bowl, pour pureed watermelon through strainer.", "Add lemon juice through strainer. Add basil leaves to juice. Stir in sugar.", "Chill for 1 hour."]

title: Good Morning Sunshine Smoothie

directions: ["Add all ingredients into a blender, put the lid on and process until smooth."]

title: Vegan Berry & Mango Mousse
ingredients: ["1 package Soft Tofu (14-ounce Package)", "1-1/2 cup Strawberries, Fresh Or Frozen", "1/2 cups Raspberries (Fresh Or Frozen)", "1/2 cups Mango Chunks (fresh Or Frozen)", "1-1/2 Tablespoon Maple Syrup", "1 teaspoon Vanilla"]
directions: ["Drain water out of the tofu package and give the tofu a quick rinse. Place the tofu in a blender. Add the fruit into the blender. Use frozen fruit if you want a colder treat. Add the maple syrup and vanilla extract, put the lid on and blend until everything is well incorporated.", "Serve the mousse in bowls or large cups. Enjoy the mousse on its own or with your favorite toppings."]

title: Strawberry Mango Lassi
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Milk (skim, Almond, Soy, Or Coconut All Work)", "1/2 cups Plain, Non-fat Greek Yogurt", "1 Mango, Diced (I Used A Champagne Mango)", "1/2 cups Strawberries (frozen Or Fresh)", "1 Tablespoon Honey", "Pinch Of Cinnamon", "Pinch Of Cardamom"]
directions: ["Place all of the ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. Serve immediately."]

title: Irish Mudslide Sauce

directions: ["Melt the sugar in a pot over a low to medium flame. Keep an eye on it and do not walk away. When the sugar has completely melted, remove it from the heat and add the heavy cream. The mixture will bubble up. Return to a low heat and stir vigorously until all of the lumps are gone and the sauce is a light golden brown. Remove from the heat and immediately stir in the salt, coffee liqueur and Irish cream liqueur."]

title: Blueberry Surprise Monkey Bread
ingredients: ["2/3 cups Sugar", "4 teaspoons Cinnamon", "3 cans 7.5 Oz Cans, Refrigerated Buttermilk Biscuits", "1/2 cups To 3/4 Cups Dried Blueberries", "6 Tablespoons Butter, Melted"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 375 degrees F. Spray a Bundt pan with non-stick cooking spray and set aside.", "In a small bowl combine sugar and cinnamon.", "Remove biscuits from the cans and cut each in half. Place dough balls around Bundt pan - in layers.", "Repeat with remaining ingredients.", "I had a little butter and a little sugar left, which I drizzled over the top.", "Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until biscuits are fully cooked. Allow to cool in the pan a few minutes.", "Place a large plate or platter upside down over the pan, turn over and remove the Bundt pan from the monkey bread. Serve warm or at room temperature.", "Enjoy!", "Miss"]

title: Vanilla Coffee Creamer
ingredients: ["1 cup Half-and-half", "1-1/2 cup Non-fat Milk", "2 Tablespoons Sugar Or Maple Syrup Or Honey", "1 Tablespoon Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["In a medium-sized saucepan over low heat, add half-and-half, milk and sugar. Whisk until sugar is dissolved and bubbles start to appear on the sides of the pan, about 10 minutes.", "Take pan off of heat and whisk in vanilla extract. Let the mixture cool then transfer it into an airtight container and store in the refrigerator. This will last about a week or more.", "Adjust sweetness to taste."]

title: Homemade Hot Fudge Sauce
ingredients: ["12 ounces, fluid Evaporated Milk", "2 cups Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips", "1/2 cups Granulated Sugar", "1 Tablespoon Butter", "1-1/2 teaspoon Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["1.\tIn a medium saucepan, over medium heat, heat milk, chocolate chips, and sugar until boiling, stirring constantly.", "2.\tRemove from heat, and stir in butter and vanilla until blended.", "3.\tServe warm, or transfer to a storage container to cool completely.", "4.\tCover and refrigerate.", "5.\tTo serve, uncover sauce and reheat in the microwave for 30-60 seconds on high, or until warm and pourable.", "6.\tServe over ice cream, brownies, cheesecake, chocolate sheet cake. Or eat with a spoon right out of the fridge. (I'm only kidding. Kind of.)", "Variation: For a Mayan-style fudge sauce, stir in 1/8 teaspoon ground cinnamon, and a hefty pinch of chipotle chili powder. Seriously good stuff."]

title: Quinoa Pilaf
ingredients: ["1 Tablespoon Olive Oil", "1 whole Onion, Chopped", "1 whole Celery Stalk, Chopped", "1 whole Carrot, Chopped", "1 cup Quinoa", "2 cups Chicken Or Vegetable Stock"]

Soak the hair in TTO and cover with a cap and sleep on it. Put a towel down on the pillowcase or around their area bcz the oil will stain. As a preventative, we add just a few drops to her shampoo to repel and discourage those nasty little blood suckers. I swear by this and I feel the need to share anytime I can. I struggled SO much, was overcome with frustration and at my wits and when I discovered this. TTO can be found in WALMART vitamin/mineral aisle or at any health food store. Please pass this on as I'm sure you know someone who could use this info. Kate."]

title: Butter
ingredients: ["1 quart heavy cream (not ultra-pasteurized, no extra ingredients)", "13 cup buttermilk, with live cultures"]
directions: ["Pour the cream and buttermilk together into a spotlessly clean glass or metal bowl with a cover.", "Stir gently to mix.", "Cover the bowl and put in a warm place overnight.", "(the author's last batch took 18 hours) By warm, I mean 70-80F", "As the time approaches, it should smell good not like rotting milk, but like delicious creme fraiche.", "Which is what you are making at this point.", "When its ready, it will thicken to something like sour cream thickness (of course!).", "It will smell like heaven and taste just as good.", "Now bring the cream to a temperature of around 60F.", "At this point, put the cream into the bowl of a stand mixer, and stir at medium low speed with the paddle attachment.", "Do not use high speed, because if you do, when the cream turns to butter, you will have a mess all over your walls.", "The slow stirring will do the trick.", "Watch it.", "If you have 60F cream, and its ripened nicely, it may become butter in as quickly as five minutes.", "But it could take quite a bit longer, too.", "Watch and you will see it become creamier, creamier, a bit grainy...", "Butter grains floating in buttermilk.", "When the grains are about rice-sized, drain the buttermilk (you can cook with it, or use it as starter for another batch).", "Rinse the butter under cold running water, working the butter by kneading it, squeezing and pressing and folding, and rinsing until the water runs clear.", "If you dont do this, your butter will go rancid quickly.", "Then keep working the butter to get as much water out of it as you can.", "This is when you can add salt, which helps it to keep longer.", "You should have about a pound of butter after you are done working it.", "I divide it into fourths and freeze all but one, which is the one we will use right away.", "The cultured butter will have a stronger butter flavor than you are used to, and you will want to spread it on everything.", "Be warned."]

Enjoy!", "Note: A cube of sugar is roughly equivalent to a teaspoon."]

title: Baked Fries
ingredients: ["2 whole Yukon Gold Potatoes", "2 teaspoons Olive Oil", "3 dashes Salt", "3 dashes Pepper", "3 dashes Seasoning Salt"]
directions: ["1. Preheat oven to 375\u00b0F.", "2. Cut up potatoes into slices with skin on and then cut each slice into strips.", "3. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray.", "4. Place potatoes in bowl, drizzle with oil, and sprinkle salt, pepper, and seasoning salt.", "5. Toss together and place potatoes on baking sheet in single layer.", "6. Bake for 15 minutes, turn, and bake for another 15 minutes.", "7. Plate up and enjoy!", "Recipe from Extra Lean: The Fat-Burning Plan That Changes the Way You Eat for Life."]

title: Crockpot Caramel (Dulce De Leche)
ingredients: ["1 can (11 Or 14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk"]
directions: ["1. Peel paper wrapper off condensed milk can.", "2. Place in slow cooker and fill it with water. Submerge can under 1 inch of water.", "3. Cook on Low for 8 hours.", "4. Remove from slow cooker (yes the can will look a bit rusty-don't worry).", "5. Place unopened can in the fridge for at least 2 hours. Overnight is best.", "6. Open can up and taste some amazing caramel! Use on desserts or just spoon it in your mouth. So good!"]

title: How To Cook Bacon In The Oven
ingredients: ["8 slices Thick Cut Bacon"]
directions: ["Lay the raw bacon out on a sheet pan. Place in the middle of the oven and turn the oven on to 400\u00b0F.", "Cook bacon until crisp, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven and drain bacon on a plate lined with paper towels."]

title: Lime Ice Cream Bars
ingredients: ["1 can (14 Oz. Can) Sweetened Condensed Milk", "1/2 cups Fresh Lime Juice", "1 teaspoon Lime Zest (from 1 Lime)", "2 cups Heavy Whipping Cream"]
directions: ["Add sweetened condensed milk, lime juice and zest into a large bowl and whisk to combine. Add cream and whisk until thoroughly combined.", "Pour into popsicle molds, Dixie cups or into an ice cream freezer. If using Popsicle molds, add bottoms; if using Dixie cups, use a Popsicle stick or a wooden skewer. Freeze for at least 4 hours.", "For the ice cream maker, follow manufacturer's directions, cover and freeze until ready to serve.", "Enjoy!"]

title: Cinnamon Citrus Roasted Parsnips
ingredients: ["1 Tablespoon Olive Oil", "1/2 teaspoons Cinnamon", "1 Tablespoon Orange Juice", "Salt And Pepper, to taste", "6 whole Parsnips, Washed And Peeled"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 425\u00b0F.", "In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, cinnamon, orange juice, salt and pepper. Slice the parsnips into quarters lengthwise, and then cut in half (each parsnip will make about 8 slices). Toss in the olive oil mixture and then spread onto a making sheet sprayed with nonstick spray.", "Roast at 425\u00b0F for 15 minutes, toss, and then roast another 15 minutes until all liquid is evaporated and the parsnips are golden and crisp. Serve hot or at room temperature!"]

title: Honey Nut Butter
ingredients: ["8 Tablespoons Butter, Preferably Grass-fed", "1 Tablespoon Honey", "2 Tablespoons Walnuts, Toasted And Coarsely Chopped", "Sea Salt"]
directions: ["Combine everything in a medium bowl and mix until everything incorporates.", "Serve as is, or place in plastic wrap and roll into a log and pop into the refrigerator until hard.", "Keeps for 2-3 weeks in the fridge, not that it'll last that long.", "Enjoy!"]

title: Honey Coconut Granola
ingredients: ["3 cups Old Fashioned Oats", "1 cup Sliced Almonds", "1 cup Sweetened Shredded Coconut", "1/2 teaspoons Salt", "1/2 cups Honey", "1/2 cups Brown Sugar", "1 teaspoon Vanilla", "2 ounces, weight Semi-sweet Chocolate, Shaved (optional)"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F.", "In a large bowl, add the oats, almonds, coconut and salt. Mix together all ingredients.", "In a small pot over low heat, add the honey, brown sugar and vanilla. Heat until all ingredients have melted together, stirring often, 3-5 minutes.", "Add honey mixture to oat mixture and stir well to combine. Spread granola onto a nonstick sheet pan.", "Bake 30 minutes or until light brown and crunchy. Every 10 minutes, turn and stir granola for better browning.", "Remove from heat and let cool 15-30 minutes. Serve with shaved chocolate sprinkled on top (optional)."]

title: Honey Butter
ingredients: ["1 stick Butter, Room Temperature", "1/2 cups Honey", "1 whole Orange, Zested"]
directions: ["Stir together butter and honey. Then zest 1 whole orange and add to the honey and butter mixture. Let it sit for about 30 minutes so all the flavors can be absorbed before serving.", "Top warm biscuits with the honey butter and enjoy!", "Feel free to add other ingredients, such as chopped pecans or raisins."]

title: Brown Butter Peaches
ingredients: ["4 whole Fresh Peaches", "4 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter", "4 Tablespoons Brown Sugar"]
directions: ["Remove the skin and pit and slice the peaches into 8 even wedges. Set aside.", "In a saucepan melt the butter over medium heat and, stirring constantly, let it simmer until it starts to brown. Once it starts to brown quickly add the sugar and peaches, reduce the heat to low, and cook for 2-3 minutes stirring to coat the peaches. Remove from heat immediately and serve over biscuits, ice cream, pancakes/waffles, or whatever else your heart desires!"]

title: Candy Corn Gooey Cake Bars
ingredients: ["1 box (18 Oz. Size) Chocolate Cake Mix", "1/2 cups Butter", "1 whole Egg", "1 teaspoon Vanilla", "1 cup Honey Roasted Peanuts", "1 cup Candy Corn M&M Candies", "2 cups Candy Corn Oreo Cookie Chunks", "1 can (14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk"]
directions: ["Mix together the cake mix, butter, egg, and vanilla until blended. Press into the bottom of greased 9x13 pan.", "Sprinkle the peanuts and M&Ms on the cake mix. Place the cookie chunks on top. Drizzle the condensed milk all over everything.", "Bake at 350\u00b0F for 30-35 minutes. Let cool before cutting into the bars.", "Note: These bars can be made with any flavor of Oreo and M&M candy."]

title: Homemade Shamrock Shakes
ingredients: ["3 cups Vanilla Bean Ice Cream", "1-1/2 cup Whole Milk", "1-1/2 teaspoon Mint Extract", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract", "Whipped Cream, Cherries, And Fresh Mint, For Garnish"]
directions: ["Add the ice cream, milk, extracts and food coloring to a blender and blend until thick and cream. Pour into glasses and top with whipped cream, cherries and fresh mint!"]

title: Chocolate Tort
ingredients: ["2 packages (14.4 Oz. Size) Chocolate Graham Crackers", "1 stick Butter", "3/4 cups Skim Milk", "3/4 cups Half-and-half", "1/2 cups Honey", "18 ounces, weight Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["Take chocolate graham crackers and crush in a mixer. Once well crushed, mix in butter in tabs. Take graham cracker mixture and pack tightly into a springform pan (I used my hands first then I covered the crust with wax paper and used a ramekin to pack even more tightly).", "For the chocolate, heat the skim milk and half-and-half until scalding (the edges bubbling). Next, mix in honey.", "Pour the heated milk mixture over the semi-sweet chocolate chips and mix until the chips are fully melted. Pour on top of the graham cracker crust and put in the fridge for at least 2 hours.", "Cut as big of a piece as you dare and eat."]

title: Grandma Amy’S Secret Fruit Salad Dressing
ingredients: ["2 Tablespoons Lime Juice", "1-1/2 Tablespoon Honey", "1/8 teaspoons Freshly Grated Ginger", "1/2 teaspoons Vanilla"]
directions: ["Whisk all ingredients together in a bowl.", "Pour over fruit."]

title: Homemade Kahlua
ingredients: ["1-1/2 cup Rum", "1-1/8 cup Coffee", "2 cups Sugar", "1 Tablespoon Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["Add rum, coffee, and sugar to large saucepan. Put on low heat and stir until all sugar is incorporated into mixture. Allow to warm for 5 minutes.", "Place into separate storage container (I use a quart jar). Add vanilla. Wait for at least a week..", "Serve!"]

title: Homemade Ice Pops
ingredients: ["1 whole Medium Sugar Kiss Melon, Cubed (approximately 4 Cups)"]
directions: ["Add the cubed melon to a kitchen blender. Blend until completely liquid. If necessary, you can add a little water to loosen.", "Carefully pour the liquid into each ice pop bag. Using a funnel will help make this process easier. Fill all the way to the max line, and then seal tightly.", "Place in the freezer and freeze until solid, about 2-4 hours.", "Note: If you don't have access to Sugar Kiss Melons from H-E-B, you can also use other melons, like honeydew or cantaloupe."]

title: Homemade Honey Roasted Peanut Butter
ingredients: ["2 cups Roasted Peanuts, Dry And Salted", "2 Tablespoons Honey", "1 dash Sea Salt"]
directions: ["Simply combine all ingredients into a food processor. Grind for 2-4 minutes depending on your processor. Once you get the consistency you like, throw in a few more peanuts to make it crunchy. Adjust salt to your liking.", "Store in a clean Mason jar in the refrigerator."]

title: Bacon Wrapped Twice Baked Potatoes
