ingredients: ["3 whole Yukon Gold Potatoes, Washed And Dried", "3 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "6 strips Uncooked Bacon", "1/2 cups Sour Cream", "4 ounces, weight Soft Goat Cheese", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.", "On a nonstick baking sheet, place the potatoes, prick each potato with a fork all over, drizzle each potato with olive oil and season with salt. Bake for 35 minutes and then place the strips of bacon on the same baking sheet if you have room, or a separate baking sheet if you don't. Continue to bake for another 10 minutes or so until the potatoes are cooked through.", "Remove the potatoes from the oven and allow to cool for a few moments so you can handle them. Cut each potato in half and then use a spoon to scoop out most of the insides of the potato into a bowl, leaving a little bit around the edges so the skin keeps its shape.", "Mash the scooped potato until all of the large pieces are broken up. Add the sour cream and goat cheese and mash again until smooth, then season with salt and pepper. Scoop the mixture back into the potato skins.", "By this time the bacon should be cooked but not crispy. Remove the bacon from the oven and allow to cool enough so you can handle it. Wrap one piece of bacon around each potato half, making sure the ends of the bacon are tucked underneath the bottom of the potato.", "Place bacon wrapped potatoes back on the baking sheet and bake for another 10-15 minutes until heated through and the tops of the potatoes are beginning to brown."]

title: Homemade Clove Honey
ingredients: ["1 jar (8 Oz. Size) Pure Honey", "4 whole Cloves", "2 pinches Nutmeg"]
directions: ["Empty jar of honey into a bowl (yes it is very sticky). Add the whole cloves and nutmeg. Stir with a spatula (I wet the spatula with hot water first) then transfer back into the jar.", "You can refrigerate if you wish or keep in a cool dry pantry/cabinet.", "We love this clove honey in a cup of hot tea (one teaspoon per cup). Or spread on top of fresh-baked corn muffins or biscuits! Enjoy."]

title: Maple And Shallot Spaghetti Squash
ingredients: ["1 Small Spaghetti Squash", "1/2 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "1/2 Tablespoons Butter", "2 Shallots", "2 Tablespoons Maple Syrup"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F. Using a fork, pierce squash several times and place on a baking sheet. Bake for about 45 minutes or until a fork can be inserted easily. Remove from oven and let cool while you prepare the sauce.", "Heat olive oil and butter in a small pan. Saute shallots until tender and add maple syrup. Simmer for about 30 seconds.", "Slice the squash in half and remove seeds. Using a fork, scrape along the inside of the skin and remove the stringy squash.", "Toss sauce and squash in a bowl and serve warm."]

title: Homemade Chunky Monkey Ice Cream
ingredients: ["2/3 cups Sugar", "2/3 cups Whole Milk", "1-1/2 cup Heavy Whipping Cream", "1 teaspoon Vanilla", "2/3 cups Banana, Mashed", "1 pinch Salt", "1/2 cups Walnuts, Chopped", "1/2 cups Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["Yields 1 1/2 quarts.", "Combine sugar, milk, cream, vanilla, banana and salt in blender and blend until smooth. Pour into ice cream freezer and churn for 30 minutes. Pour in walnuts and chocolate chips and churn for another 5 minutes. Serve immediately or freeze to desired consistency."]

title: Roasted Spring Veggies
ingredients: ["10 spears Asparagus", "1/2 Onion, Sliced", "2 Yellow Squashes", "1 Tablespoon Olive Oil", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Wash and slice, chop veggies. Dry them and toss in a bowl with olive oil, add salt and pepper, or whatever seasonings you wish. Cook in the oven at 400\u00b0F (I put mine on a cookie sheet covered in foil sprayed with cooking spray). Larger veggies should be on the outside edges and smaller ones more to the middle.", "Cook until veggies are crisp (a little brown is okay), about 20 minutes."]

title: Homemade Butter
ingredients: ["1 pint Heavy Cream", "1/2 teaspoons Salt"]
directions: ["Pour cream and salt into the bowl of a stand-mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. Tent the mixer with a large kitchen towel and turn the mixer on medium high for 8-12 minutes. At first, you will have whipped cream, but continue beating the cream until the mixture separates into butter solids and buttermilk (you can reserve the buttermilk and refrigerate for other uses).", "Remove the butter solids from the mixer. Squeeze the butter firmly by hand over the bowl in the sink while periodically running the butter under cold water. When there is very little liquid left and when any liquid remaining in the butter runs clear when squeezed, the butter is ready. Form the butter into a ball or stick. Store butter, covered, at room temperature up to three days or refrigerated up to a week. It also keeps nicely in the freezer.", "Notes: To use your homemade butter for baking, weigh it on a kitchen scale in ounces. A standard store-bought (1/2 cup) stick of butter weighs 4 ounces.", "Adapted from The Homemade Pantry by Alana Chernila."]

title: Homemade Balsamic Glaze
ingredients: ["16 ounces, fluid Good Balsamic Vinegar", "1/2 cups Sugar", "Salt"]
directions: ["Pour balsamic vinegar into a saucepot. Add regular granulated sugar and a couple pinches of salt. Stir to combine.", "Place the saucepot over medium heat. Once the balsamic vinegar comes to a boil, stir again, and casually watch it. You don't have to babysit the pot, but stick around so you don't forget about it.", "When the balsamic glaze is thick and syrupy and has reduced by half (about 20 to 30 minutes), remove the pot from the burner and allow it to cool.", "Store your balsamic glaze in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 weeks."]

title: Breakfast Quinoa
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Dry Quinoa, Rinsed", "3/4 cups Lite Canned Coconut Milk, Plus More For Drizzling", "1/2 teaspoons Cinnamon, Plus More For Sprinkling", "2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract", "Pinch Of Salt", "1 whole Banana, Chopped", "1/2 cups Toasted Pecans, Chopped"]
directions: ["Combine quinoa, coconut milk, cinnamon, vanilla, and salt in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. Reduce to a simmer, cover, and let cook for 15 minutes until quinoa can be fluffed with a fork.", "Divide quinoa into 2 bowls then cover with bananas, pecans, and a few extra drizzles of coconut milk.", "Note: You can definitely use full-fat coconut milk. I use Trader Joe's lite coconut milk which is insanely creamy and resembles full-fat coconut milk. If I used another brand, I'd probably use full-fat. Additionally, feel free to add sugar or sweetener if needed. I (shockingly) find it sweet enough with the coconut milk and fruit. Different fruits are delicious, too."]

title: Salted Caramel No Bake Cookies
ingredients: ["1 cup Granulated Sugar", "1 cup Packed Brown Sugar", "1/2 cups Butter", "1/2 cups Evaporated Milk", "1/2 cups Peanut Butter", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract", "3 cups Oats, Either Old Fashioned Or Quick Cooking", "2 Tablespoons Sea Salt"]
directions: ["Combine the sugars, butter and milk in a saucepan. Cook on medium-high heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil. Boil for 1 minute. Remove from heat. Add peanut butter, vanilla and oats. Stir well. Working quickly, drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper. Sprinkle a pinch of sea salt on each cookie before it starts to harden. Cool completely.", "Makes about 50 cookies."]

title: Heath Pretzel Sticks
ingredients: ["8 ounces, weight Semi-sweet Chocolate Pieces", "8 ounces, weight Bag Heath Candy Bits", "56 whole 4\" Pretzel Sticks"]
directions: ["Melt the chocolate pieces in a glass bowl in the microwave. Heat it for 30 second increments, stirring it with a fork in between each increment, and stopping once it's smooth.", "Line 2 cookie trays with wax paper. Pour the Heath candy bits out on a flat plate.", "Coat 3\" of a pretzel stick on all sides with the melted chocolate. Roll the pretzel in the candy bits to coat. Set pretzel on the prepared tray and when the tray is full put it in the fridge to cool completely."]

title: Eggs Nestled In Bacon
ingredients: ["1 strip Bacon", "1 whole Egg"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F. Lightly spray your muffin pan with cooking spray. Cut your slice of bacon in half. Take the first half and lay the bacon across the middle. Take the second half and wrap it around the inside of the muffin tin. Cook for 6 minutes, until slightly crispy.", "Crack your egg into the center of your bacon. If the bacon has slid, just gently tap it back into place. Cook your egg for about 12 minutes, with the egg yolk just past runny. Gently use the edge of a knife and go around the edge of the muffin pan. The egg and bacon will neatly pop out. Season your egg as you normally would and enjoy!"]

title: Autumn Hugs
ingredients: ["24 whole Mini Pretzels", "24 whole Hershey's Hugs Candies, Unwrapped", "24 whole Corn Candies"]
directions: ["1. Preheat your oven to 200\u00b0F.", "2. Place mini pretzels on a large baking sheet. Top each pretzel with a Hug Candy. Place in the oven for 5 minutes, or until the Hugs get soft, check them at 3 minutes. (Don't melt them all the way, they should still look \"normal\")", "3. Remove pan from oven and lightly press a corn candy into the middle top of each Hug.", "4. Let cool before serving or transferring to a Tupperware container for storage.", "So easy and so yummy!"]

title: Hasselback Potatoes With Thyme
ingredients: ["2 whole Medium Russet Or Yukon Gold Potatoes, Scrubbed & Dried", "1 Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Or As Needed", "2 Tablespoons Butter, Sliced Very Thin, Plus More For Drizzling (omit If Vegan)", "1 sprig Thyme"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F. Lay potatoes flat and slice 1/8 to 1/4-inch thick slits across the potato, about 3/4 of the way through. Lightly coat in olive oil. Season with salt on the outside and between each slit.", "Wedge a sliver of butter between every few slices of the potato, and a small piece of thyme (stem intake) between the alternate slices. If omitting butter, make sure to coat well with oil between each slice.", "Bake in the center rack of the oven for about 1 hour or until potatoes are fork tender and crispy on the outside. Discard thyme stems. Drizzle with melted butter or olive oil, and sprinkle with chunky salt. Enjoy."]

title: Harvest Rice With Apples And Pecans
ingredients: ["2-1/4 cups Chicken Broth", "1 cup Brown Rice", "1/8 cups Wild Rice", "2 Tablespoons Butter", "1/2 cups Roughtly Chopped Pecans", "1 Tablespoon Olive Oil", "1 cup Chopped Onion", "1 cup Chopped Apple", "1/8 teaspoons Nutmeg", "Salt And Pepper"]
directions: ["In a large pot, bring chicken broth to a boil. Add both kinds of rice and 1/2 teaspoon salt and simmer for 40-45 minutes, or until done.", "In a nonstick skillet, melt the butter, then saute the pecans in the butter until the pecans are golden brown. Remove pecans from the pan and set aside.", "In the same pan, add the olive oil and saute the chopped onion and apple until the onions are translucent. Sprinkle with nutmeg, salt and pepper.", "When the rice is done, stir in the apple/onion mixture as well as the pecans."]

title: Grilled Pineapple, Coconut And Lime
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Unsweetened Flaked Coconut", "1 whole Lime, Juiced", "2 Tablespoons Brown Sugar Or Coconut Sugar", "1 whole Pineapple, Peeled And Cut Into 1/2 Inch Wedges (See Note)", "1 whole Lime, Zested"]
directions: ["Note: A 15-ounce can of pineapple rings can be substituted for the fresh pineapple.", "Preheat grill to medium high.", "Heat a stove top skillet over medium heat on the stove. Once skillet is warm, place coconut in pan. Stir frequently until the coconut becomes lightly toasted and browned. Remove from heat, and pour coconut into a bowl. Set aside for later use.", "In a separate bowl, place the lime juice and sugar and stir together.", "Place pineapple wedges on an oiled grill and cook, turning only once until pineapple softens and becomes browned. Cooking time will vary between canned and fresh pineapple, but fresh pineapple will take approximately 7-8 minutes total cooking time while canned will require about 4-5 minutes of cooking time.", "Once cooked, transfer the pineapple to a large bowl. Sprinkle with lime juice and sugar mixture, coconut and lime zest. Serve if using as a side dish.", "To serve as a dessert, scoop 1/2 cup of plain vanilla Greek or regular yogurt into a serving cup. Divide the pineapple mixture up evenly between 6 cups. Serve."]

title: Blueberry Quick Jam
ingredients: ["6 cups Blueberries, Fresh Or Frozen", "1 Tablespoon Lemon Juice, Fresh", "1 teaspoon Stevia Or 1/4 Cup Sugar"]
directions: ["In a large skillet add blueberries, lemon juice and stevia.", "Cook blueberries, stirring constantly until thick, about 15 -20 minutes.", "Place blueberries in a jar and let it sit on your counter until cool.", "Store in the refrigerator."]

title: Cinnamon Apple Oatmeal
ingredients: ["2 cups Milk Or Water", "1/2 teaspoons Cinnamon", "1 cup Old Fashioned Oats", "1 pinch Salt", "1 Apple, Diced", "3 Tablespoons Brown Sugar"]
directions: ["1. Bring water to a boil in a medium saucepan; add the cinnamon. Add the oats and salt and cook according to the directions on the package.", "2. Chop the apple into bite-sized pieces.", "3. Once the oatmeal has thickened and is gently boiling, stir in the apples and brown sugar. Cook for a few more minutes. If you like softer apples, then cook for about 3-4 minutes.", "4. Serve.", "I like to top mine with some chopped pecans and extra brown sugar."]

title: Hot Caramel
ingredients: ["2 cups Milk", "3 Tablespoons Caramel"]
directions: ["Heat milk and caramel in a small saucepan, stirring until fully incorporated. Heat until just shy of a boil. Pour in mugs, sit back and enjoy the creamy goodness!", "You can use store bought caramel if you like. For a wonderful and easy caramel sauce, I use Ina Garten's recipe. I add a bit extra vanilla since this household is crazy for it! You can store extra caramel in your fridge. For desserts, just heat it up a bit to easily drizzle and for additional hot caramel, use as is."]

title: Avocado Chip Ice Cream
ingredients: ["2 cups Heavy Whipping Cream", "1 whole Avocado, Peeled And Pitted", "1 can Sweetened Condensed Milk (14 Oz. Can)", "1 cup Miniature Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["Note: Chill your mixing bowl and beater blade for 30 minutes before making the ice cream. It will speed up your whipping time.", "In a well chilled mixing bowl, beat the whipping cream until stiff peaks form. Set aside.", "In another larger bowl smash the avocado, add the condensed milk and stir to combine. Fold the whipped cream in. Gently stir the chocolate chips into the mixture. Spoon into a freezer safe container and freeze until solid or overnight."]

title: Concord Grape Juice
ingredients: ["4 pounds Concord Grapes (Weighed Without Stems)"]
directions: ["Put the grapes in a heavy-bottomed, lidded 5-quart pot and mash them with a potato masher. Cover the pot and bring to a boil over medium heat, then turn heat down slightly and simmer 10 minutes.", "Turn heat off and cool to room temperature (this will take a couple hours). Strain the juice through a cheesecloth-lined sieve fitted over a bowl to catch the liquid; gently wring the cheesecloth to extract as much liquid as possible (wear food-safe gloves if possible, as grape juice will stain your hands and take a few days to wear off-and yes, I'm speaking from experience!).", "Transfer to glass bottles and store in the fridge; shake before serving.", "This will make about 5 to 6 cups.", "*Wash the grapes before you de-stem them, but weigh them after.", "Adapted from Simply Recipes."]

title: Breakfast Plantains
ingredients: ["1 Plantain Banana, Very Ripe (almost Black Is Best)", "1 Tablespoon Butter Or Coconut Oil", "Cinnamon, To Serve (optional)", "Cream Cheese, To Serve (optional)"]
directions: ["Slice the plantain into 1/4- to 1/2-inch slices, diagonally. Heat butter or coconut oil in pan, lay plantain slices in a single layer, and let fry until golden. Flip and fry other side. Sprinkle with cinnamon, or slather on a dollop of cream cheese.", "Serve with rice and beans (gallo pinto) for a complete meal."]

title: Green Protein Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 cup Unsweetened Or Regular Coconut Milk", "1 Banana (preferably Frozen)", "1 Tablespoon Peanut Butter", "1-1/2 cup Fresh Baby Spinach, Lightly Packed", "1 Scoop Vanilla Protein Powder", "Ice"]
directions: ["Starting with unsweetened coconut milk, place all ingredients into a blender except for ice. You could also use almond or rice milk, if you prefer. Chop and/or blend until fully pureed. This may take a little extra time to get all the spinach leaves fully broken down.", "Once all other ingredients are mixed together, slowly add the ice, mix and then test. Continue to add more ice cubes until desired consistency is met. I usually add about 1 cup of ice per serving because I like my smoothies pretty thick and not runny. If it happens to get too thick, you can add some more coconut milk, little by little."]

title: Green Orange Julius Smoothie
ingredients: ["1-1/2 cup Milk (whole, 2%, 1%, Or Skim)", "1 cup 100% Orange Juice Concentrate", "1 cup Fresh Baby Spinach", "1 whole Peeled Large Banana, Frozen And Broken Into Chunks", "1 teaspoon Real Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["Pour milk into a blender carafe first and then add the remaining ingredients. Fix the blender lid in place and blend on high until smooth.", "Note: If you have a less high-octane blender, you may want to stop the blender and move things around with a wooden spoon or spatula a couple of times."]

title: Ambrosia Salad
ingredients: ["3 ounces, weight Fruit Punch-flavored Jell-o Gelatin Mix", "20 ounces, weight Pineapple Tidbits With Juice", "1 cup To 1-1/2 Cups Shredded Coconut, I Use Sweetened", "8 ounces, weight Cool Whip", "1/4 cups Sour Cream"]
directions: ["These are super simple directions! Place all ingredients in a medium to large bowl and mix well.", "I'd never heard of the fruit punch-flavored Jell-O before. It sure is yummy!", "After it's all mixed together and you've had several bites just to be sure it's mixed well enough, place the bowl in the fridge for a few hours (at least 2 or up to overnight) to get it super cold and set.", "Great as a summer side dish to any meal or all by itself for, breakfast, lunch, or a snack.", "Serves 8 - 12 but can easily be doubled.", "Enjoy!", "Recipe inspired by Kelly at thegrantlife.com.", "Some additional add ins you could use (I recommend to 1 cup total), but not all at the same time:", "Mandarin oranges", "Grapes", "Mini marshmallows", "Fruit cocktail", "Different flavors of Jell-O"]

title: Skinny Vanilla Latte – Real Food Style
ingredients: ["1 cup Strong Brewed Coffee", "1 cup Whole Milk", "2 Tablespoons Honey", "1/2 teaspoons Good Quality Pure Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["Put all ingredients in a small saucepan. Warm on the stove at Medium heat until desired temperature. Transfer to a blender and blend until foamy or if you have an emersion blender you can use that.", "Enjoy!"]

title: Baked Sweet Potato
ingredients: ["1 whole Sweet Potato", "Optional Garnishes: Sour Cream And Chipotle Chili Powder To Taste"]
directions: ["Pierce the whole sweet potato with a fork. Place on a baking tray. Bake at 400F for 45-50 minutes. Serve with a mixture of sour cream and chipotle chili powder."]

title: Grandma’S No Frills Potato Soup
ingredients: ["6 whole Potatoes", "1 whole Onion, Sliced", "1 stick Butter", "1-1/2 cup Milk", "Salt And Pepper, To Taste"]
directions: ["Combine peeled and cubed potatoes with sliced onion. Add water to cover and boil.", "When potatoes are done mash with a potato masher. Add salt to taste. Add butter and milk. Simmer till done.", "Note: When I want a creamier soup or to use less butter I puree half of the soup in a blender."]

title: Apple Parsley Pilaf
ingredients: ["2 Tablespoons Butter", "1-1/4 cup Long Grain White Rice", "2-1/2 cups Chicken Broth", "1 whole Apple, Cored And Diced", "1 teaspoon Dried Parsley"]
directions: ["In a large saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, melt the butter over medium heat until it's a little brown. Add the rice and toast it, stirring it around in the butter, until the rice is brown on the edges. Add chicken broth and bring to a boil, then lower the heat, cover the pan and simmer for 10 minutes. Add the apple and simmer for 8 minutes longer. Add in parsley and serve."]

title: Crack Potatoes
ingredients: ["3 pounds Potatoes, Washed And Cubed", "4 Tablespoons Butter, Cubed", "1/4 cups Real Bacon Bits", "1/4 cups Ranch Dressing", "1/2 cups Cheddar Cheese, Shredded"]
directions: ["1. Put potatoes in an 8x8 in glass dish. Put butter on top of potatoes. Sprinkle bacon bits on top. Cover with aluminim foil and bake at 400\u00b0F for 1 hour.", "2. Take potatoes out of oven and top with ranch dressing and cheese. Stir. Put back in oven until cheese is melted."]

title: Glazed Pecans
ingredients: ["2 cups Pecans", "2 Tablespoons Butter", "2 Tablespoons Packed Brown Sugar", "2 Tablespoons Maple Syrup (can Use Maple Flavored)"]
directions: ["Heat oven to 350 degrees F. Line cookie sheet with cooking parchment paper. In 12-inch skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add brown sugar and syrup, mix well. Cook until bubbly, stirring constantly.", "2. Add pecans, cook 2-3 minutes, stirring constantly, until coated. Spread mixture onto parchment lined cookie sheet.", "Bake 6-8 minutes or until golden brown. Cool completely, about 30 minutes. Store in tightly covered container for up to 2 weeks.", "Makes 16 Servings (2 tablespoons each)."]

title: Glazed Pecans
ingredients: ["2 Tablespoons Butter", "2 Tablespoons Brown Sugar", "2 Tablespoons Maple Syrup", "2 cups Pecans"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350 degrees.", "Over medium heat melt butter, brown sugar, and maple syrup until bubbling. Stir in pecans and stir constantly for 2-3 minutes.", "Place pecans on a 13x9 baking sheet covered with parchment paper. Bake for 8-9 minutes.", "Let cool completely for 30 minutes before placing in an air tight container."]

title: Fudge For Dummies
ingredients: ["1-1/2 bag Semi-sweet Chocolate Chips (15 Ounce Bag)", "1 can (15 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk", "1/2 cups Chopped Nuts (optional)"]
directions: ["In a microwave safe bowl, place chocolate chips and condensed milk. Microwave on high for 2-3 minutes (time varies depending on microwave strength). Remove and stir until well combined. Add nuts at this point if desired.", "Pour into a 9x9 in pan. Refrigerate for 10-15 minutes to allow to set.", "Remove and cut into 24 pieces. Enjoy."]

title: Pfannkuchensuppe (Pancake Soup)
ingredients: ["1-1/2 cup Beef Or Other Broth Or Stock", "2 whole Leftover Pancakes"]
directions: ["Heat broth to a boil.", "Slice pancakes into thin strips. Place pancake strips into the bottom of a serving bowl. Pour broth over strips.", "Enjoy!", "Notes: I use a German recipe for an unraised pancake, but any pancake that isn't very sweet will do. Pancakes may be frozen to make this soup later. I usually use Knorr bouillon cubes to make this. Vegetables or leftover meat, even shrimp, work well in Pfannkuchensuppe."]

title: Peanut Butter Mousse Cups
ingredients: ["1 cup 2% Vanilla Chocolate Chunk Chobani Greek Yogurt", "1/3 cups Sugar", "2 teaspoons Honey", "1/2 cups Creamy Peanut Butter", "1 package Cool Whip, 8 Ounce Package", "12 whole Standard Size Reese's Cups (paper Removed And Chopped Up)"]
directions: ["1. In a large bowl blend your yogurt and sugar using a mixer. Add in the honey while it is blending.", "2. Place peanut butter in a microwave safe container and heat for 30 seconds until it's warm. Add the peanut butter to the yogurt mixture and mix until all well combined.", "3. Take the Cool Whip and slowly fold it into the peanut butter yogurt mixture.", "4. Chop up the peanut butter cups (I prefer them cut small with each cup cut into 8 parts).", "5. Spoon half the yogurt mixture into four jars, cups or ramekins. Top with half of the chopped Reese's cups. Then add a second yogurt layer, topping with the remainder of the peanut butter cups.", "6. Store in fridge until ready to eat!", "*Note: If you do not like Greek yogurt, substitute 4 tablespoons of cream cheese. You can taste the Greek yogurt in the final product, so if you are not a fan of this, it is best to use the substitution.", "This recipe is adapted from Erin (at the spiffy cookie) blog!"]

title: Fruity Smoothie With Greek Honey
ingredients: ["1 Banana, Sliced (Use 2 If Small)", "1 slice Melon, Peeled", "1 Peach, Halved, Stone Removed", "7 whole Walnuts", "1/2 cups Milk", "1 teaspoon Honey"]
directions: ["Put all fruits in a blender. Add whole walnuts. Add milk. Lastly, add the honey-sometimes it sticks on the sides of the blender and you want to keep things easy. Blend it all together and enjoy your breakfast!"]

title: Fruit Salad Champagne Cocktail
ingredients: ["1 package 1lb Package Of Mixed Fruits (I Used Strawberries, Watermelon, Cantaloupe And Kiwi Cubes)", "1 whole Lemon, Juiced", "1 bottle (750ml Size) Prosecco Champagne"]
directions: ["Add your fruits and lemon juice to a food processor or blender and process on high until well blended. Spoon 2-3 tablespoons of fruit puree into a glass chilled with ice, then pour champagne over it."]

title: Frozen Fruit Salad
ingredients: ["1 package (8 Oz. Size) Cream Cheese, Softened", "3/4 cups Granulated Sugar", "16 ounces, weight Frozen, Sliced Strawberries (thawed)", "1 can (20 Oz. Size) Crushed Pineapple, Drained", "1 whole Banana, Peeled And Sliced (medium To Large Size)", "1 cup Chopped Walnuts Or Pecans", "1 container (8 Oz. Size) Whipped Topping, Thawed To Soften It"]
directions: ["In a large bowl beat together the softened cream cheese and sugar until smooth. Add the fruit and nuts. Fold in the whipped topping. Spoon into a 9 x 13\" container. Cover and freeze.", "Take it out of the freezer a few minutes before serving (approximately 10 minutes).", "This, of course, can be made ahead of time. Keeps in the freezer for a long time.", "Note: Try spooning this into a graham cracker pie shell. (I told you it could be a dessert as well!)"]

title: Frozen Fruit Mix
ingredients: ["6 cups Peeled And Sliced Peaches", "1 pound Grapes", "1 can Crushed Pineapple, 20 Oz", "2 cups Sugar", "1/2 cups Lemon Juice", "3/4 cups Orange Juice"]
directions: ["Mix all ingredients together. Freeze in containers, in sizes according to your needs. Thaw partially to serve.", "Serve with ginger ale, if desired."]

title: Frozen Cream Corn
ingredients: ["36 ears Corn", "1 quart Half-and-half", "1 pound Salted Butter"]
directions: ["Blanch corn and cut from cobs.", "Put in a large roasting pan and add half-and-half and cubed butter.", "Bake for one hour at 325 F. Stir every 15 minutes.", "Let cool and freeze in freezer containers."]

title: Cinnamon Cider
ingredients: ["1 gallon Apple Juice Or Apple Cider", "14 ounces, weight Cinnamon Imperials"]
directions: ["In a crockpot set to low, pour in apple juice or cider and the cinnamon candy. Heat for 4 hours, stirring once at the 2-hour mark and again before serving, turning your crock pot to the warm setting.", "Simple and delicious!"]

title: Butter Mints (Wedding Mints)
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Butter, Slightly Colder Then Room Temperature", "2 Tablespoons Heavy Cream", "3/4 teaspoons Peppermint Extract (or More To Taste)", "1 pinch Sea Salt", "1 pound Powdered Sugar, Plus More For Hands"]
directions: ["In a mixer fitted with a whisk attachment, beat butter on high speed until light and fluffy. Scrape sides of bowl and add heavy cream, peppermint extract and sea salt. Beat until thoroughly combined.", "Add powdered sugar about 1 1/2 cups at a time, mixing on low until thoroughly combined. Repeat until all powdered sugar has been added. Turn speed up to high and beat for approximately 4 minutes or until very light and fluffy.", "At this point you can taste the mint mixture and add additional mint flavor if not strong enough.", "To shape mints: Roll dough between hands into a snake about the size of your pinkie for small mints, or the size of your thumb for larger mints. Cut into desired length. Tip: If dough sticks to hands, coat hands in additional powdered sugar.", "Place mints on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper and allow to dry at room temperature for 12 hours.", "Store mints in a airtight container in the refrigerator."]

title: French Fry Sauce
ingredients: ["1 cup Mayonnaise", "1 cup Ketchup", "1/2 cups Mustard", "1 teaspoon Seasoned Salt"]
directions: ["Mix everything together in a bowl until well combined.", "Best served with hot fries! Goes well with homemade chicken fingers too!", "Keeps in the refrigerator for a month or so."]

title: Strawberry Pistachio White Chocolate Bark
ingredients: ["30 grams Pistachios (weighed In Shell)", "10 grams Freeze-dried Strawberries", "100 grams White Chocolate"]
directions: ["1. Remove the shells from the pistachios. Chop pistachios and strawberries (if necessary).", "2. Break chocolate into small squares or cut into chunks and melt in the top of a double-boiler or heat it in a microwave safe bowl in the microwave. If you heat it in the microwave, only heat it for 30 seconds at a time, stirring in between each heating. Stop once it's almost smooth.", "3. Stir in pistachios and strawberries (reserving some of each for topping) and pour mixture into a parchment paper lined pan. Spread it out and flatten with a spatula. Sprinkle remaining pistachios and strawberries on top.", "4. Keep in fridge until thoroughly chilled, then break or cut into pieces."]

title: Crockpot Oatmeal
ingredients: ["1 cup Steel Cut Oats", "4 cups Milk Or Water", "1 pinch Salt", "Vanilla, To Taste"]
directions: ["Combine ingredients in a casserole dish that fits inside of your crock pot and place in the crock pot. Pour enough water in the crock pot to come about halfway up the sides of the casserole dish. Cover with the crock pot lid and cook overnight on low. Use any combination of water, soy, almond or regular milk that you prefer and flavor as desired.", "Oatmeal can be refrigerated for a week."]

title: Cool Cucumber Coconut Salad
ingredients: ["2 whole Medium Sized Cucumber", "1 cup Fresh, Grated Coconut", "1 cup Yogurt", "1/2 teaspoons Salt", "1/2 teaspoons Cumin Seed Powder, Roasted And Ground"]
directions: ["Wash and peel the cucumber and grate it. Mix fresh, grated coconut along with it. Add the remaining ingredients. Keep in a serving dish in the refrigerator. Serve cold."]

title: Country Rice Cereal
ingredients: ["3 cups Cooked Rice", "2 cups Whole Milk", "3 Tablespoons Butter", "1 teaspoon Cinnamon", "1/2 teaspoons Salt", "1/2 cups Dried Blueberries"]
directions: ["In a medium saucepan, combine the cooked rice, milk, butter, cinnamon, and salt. Bring to a boil, stirring often. Reduce heat. Cover and simmer for 6-8 minutes until thickened, adding blueberries after 4 minutes and stirring as needed. If desired, top with honey or brown sugar.", "Makes 6 servings."]

title: Tahini
ingredients: ["5 cups Sesame Seeds", "1-1/2 cup Olive Oil, Vegetable Oil, Or A Combination Of The Two, Plus More If Needed"]
directions: ["Heat your oven to 350\u00b0F. Spread the sesame seeds on a sheet tray, and roast them for 10 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally. You do not want them to brown, you just want them to develop that lovely nutty smell. Set tray aside and allow seeds to cool for 30 minutes.", "Pour your seeds into a blender and add 1 cup of the oil to get it going. Once it is mixing, add the remaining 1/2 cup of oil, or more if you like. The mixture should pour easily. Blend until it is smooth, a couple minutes. Pour into a jar or tight-lidded container and store in your fridge for up to 3 months.", "Makes 4 cups.", "Note: I tried using my food processor to puree the seeds, and even after 5 minutes, the mix still wasn't smooth. The blender is the way to go for this recipe, in my opinion."]

title: Chocolate Covered Strawberries
ingredients: ["21 whole Strawberries", "6 ounces, weight Dark Or Milk Chocolate", "2 Tablespoons White Chocolate (optional)"]
directions: ["Wash and dry your strawberries thoroughly. Be sure they are completely dried and at room temperature. If any water touches the chocolate, it will seize the chocolate.", "Line a baking sheet or plate with parchment or wax paper; set aside.", "Create a double boiler if you do not have one. Do this by filling a pot partially with water and placing a glass heat proof bowl the over top the pot, making sure that the bowl doesn't touch the water. I used a Pyrex bowl. Just be sure the bowl does not touch the water.", "Bring the water to a simmer. Place dark chocolate in bowl, and stir occasionally until melted. Grab the strawberries by the stem, and dip into the chocolate. Allow excess to chocolate to drip off, then turn the berry upside down for a few seconds to set.", "Place berries onto the prepared parchment paper. Once all of your strawberries are dipped, place in the refrigerator for 15 minutes, until chocolate hardens.", "To create a white chocolate drizzle, melt the white chocolate the same way as the dark. Once it's melted, carefully scoop the chocolate into a sandwich baggie. Cut off a small corner of the baggie and drizzle over chocolate strawberries. Note: Make sure no water gets into the baggie, otherwise your chocolate will seize up. (I did that when I was scooping the white chocolate!)"]

title: English Toffee With Dark Chocolate And Almond
ingredients: ["1 cup Unsalted Butter", "1 cup Granulated Sugar", "1 teaspoon Salt", "1 cup Good Quality Dark Chocolate Chip", "1/2 cups Sliced Almonds"]
directions: ["Prepare a large baking sheet lined with parchment paper.", "In a deep, heavy-bottomed pan, heat the butter, sugar and salt over medium heat. Stir frequently until the butter is melted and the ingredients combine. Slowly bring the mixture to a boil.", "Let it simmer over medium heat. Stir occasionally with a wooden spatula until the color of the mixture changes to amber, around 20 minutes.", "Remove toffee from heat, carefully spread it evenly over the baking sheet with a spatula.", "Sprinkle the chocolate chips over the hot toffee and allow to sit for a few minutes to soften. Gently spread the chocolate to thinly coat the top of the toffee.", "Sprinkle the almonds over the chocolate layer. Use a sheet of clean parchment paper to gently pat the almonds into the chocolate.", "Place the toffee into the refrigerator for at least 1 hour to harden. Once chilled, carefully remove the toffee from the pan by lifting the hangs of the parchment paper, and break into pieces."]

title: English Toffee
ingredients: ["1 cup Salted Butter", "1 cup Sugar", "2/3 cups Chopped Pecans", "1/2 cups Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["1. Put butter and sugar in a heavy saucepan and stir CONSTANTLY until golden brown (or the color of peanut butter). This should take anywhere from 10 to 25 minutes depending on what type of pan/skillet you use. Keep it on medium to medium-high heat.", "2. Pour over chopped pecans in a 9 x 9 pan. DO NOT BUTTER THE PAN.", "3. Put chocolate chips on top, while hot. Melt chips and spread.", "4. Let it sit for 1/2 hour, then refrigerate for 1 hour. Cut (or break) into pieces."]

title: English Toffee
ingredients: ["2 cups Sugar", "2 sticks Butter Or Margarine", "1 cup Sliced Almonds (very Generous)", "2 cups Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["Cook the sugar and butter on a saucepan over the stove until it develops an amber colour. Add the sliced almonds and stir; pour onto a greased cookie sheet. Immediately sprinkle chocolate chips on top; spread all over the toffee. Allow it to cool, and you're done!"]

title: Eggless Vanilla Ice Cream
ingredients: ["1 cup Whole Milk", "1 cup Heavy Cream", "1/2 cups Sugar", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["Combine ingredients and stir briskly for about 2 minutes until sugar is dissolved. Freeze in your ice cream maker according to the manufacturer's directions.", "Makes 2 quarts."]

title: Almond-Honey Cooler
ingredients: ["8 ounces, fluid Unsweetened Almond Milk", "1 Tablespoon Honey, Or More To Taste", "1 cup Ice Cubes"]
directions: ["Combine ingredients in blender. Blend to combine."]

title: Easy Homemade Oreo Ice Cream Sandwiches
ingredients: ["1 tub Ice Cream (1/2 Gallon Size)", "1 package (15 Oz. Size) Oreo Cookies"]
directions: ["1. Take ice cream out of the freezer to soften up for 10 minutes. Twist Oreo cookies apart, place one scoop of ice cream on one cookie and top the sandwich with the other half.", "2. Place Oreo ice cream sandwiches on a tray while you repeat making the rest of the sandwiches. Place tray in the freezer to set up for 1 hour."]

title: Easy Peasy Tuna Pasta
ingredients: ["1/2 bulbs Onion", "1 can Tuna", "1 dash Olive Oil", "1 pinch Salt", "Pasta"]
directions: ["1. Cook pasta according to packet instructions, and drain.", "2. Dice onion and tomato.", "3. Chuck into a bowl with a generous amount of salt, a splash of oil, parmesan, and the can of tuna.", "4. Throw on the hot pasta, stir, and eat."]

title: Chocolate Hazelnuts
ingredients: ["1 cup Extra Dark Chocolate", "1 cup Toasted Hazelnuts"]
directions: ["In a double sauce pan, melt the chocolate. Dump in the hazelnuts and with a spoon coat them well in the melted chocolate until they are all covered.", "Drop 4-5 chocolate hazelnuts in small paper cups. Let the chocolate dry and serve, or wrap them up in nice see-through paper and give them out as cute presents."]

title: Easy Homemade Turtles
ingredients: ["54 whole Pretzel Snaps, The Square Ones", "1 cup Crushed Pecans", "1/2 Tablespoons Coarse Salt, Optional", "12 ounces, weight Rolo Candies, Unwrapped"]
directions: ["Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and preheat your oven to 300 F.", "During this time, add the pretzels onto the baking sheet in a single layer. Top each pretzel with a Rolo. This is the only time consuming part.", "Place tray in the oven, and cook for about 3-5 minutes. Keep an eye on these as you only want the Rolo to slightly soften, not completely melt. Once they begin to soften, remove them from the oven and sprinkle a bit of coarse salt onto each piece of chocolate. Next, shower the baking sheet with the crushed pecans, making sure you lightly coat all of the chocolate.", "I placed mine in my cold garage for about 20 minutes to let the Rolos harden up. Once hardened, place on a serving dish and dig in.", "Everyone went nuts for these. It's a perfect bite with the crunch of the pretzel, and that awesome salted chocolate caramel. They were all devoured in one day! Merry Christmas everyone!"]

title: Banilla Breeze Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 whole Banana, Frozen", "1 cup Unsweetened Coconut Milk", "1/2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract", "2 Tablespoons French Vanilla Protein Powder", "1 dash Stevia (optional)", "1/2 cups Ice"]
directions: ["Place all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth."]

title: Easy Chocolate Fudge
ingredients: ["3 cups Chocolate Chips, Any Blend That You Like", "14 ounces, fluid Sweetened, Condensed Milk", "1/2 sticks Butter", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["Add all ingredients to a skillet or sauce pan turned to medium-low. Let the ingredients gently melt, stirring often and vigorously, like you would risotto.", "Line an 8x8 pan with parchment, wax paper, or foil allowing the paper/foil to hang over the edges of the pan. Then spray it liberally with cooking spray.", "When the chocolate mixture is entirely combined, smooth, and glossy, pour it into the prepared dish. Let chill for 3 hours or overnight, then remove from the pan. Peel off the parchment paper and cut into cubes.", "Adapted from Real Mom Kitchen."]

title: Simple Pork Marinade
ingredients: ["1/2 whole Lime, Juiced", "1 cup Mustard", "2 Tablespoons Soy Sauce", "1 Tablespoon Honey"]
directions: ["Mix the lime juice with all other ingredients. You can add more honey or lime if you want.", "Marinate the pork/chicken and put it on the grill, or just bake it in the oven or throw it into a skillet."]

title: Quick And Easy Chicken Marinade
ingredients: ["2 Tablespoons Soy Sauce", "4 Tablespoons Mustard"]
directions: ["Mix the ingredients in a bowl. Take a brush and brush the marinade on the chicken (preferrably with skin). I like to put as much sauce as possible on it, but that depends on taste. If you need more marinade, just add more soy sauce and mustard."]

title: Chocolate Chip And Peanut Butter Ice Cream
ingredients: ["1 cup Whole Milk, Cold", "3/4 cups Sugar", "2 cups Heavy Cream, Cold", "3/4 cups Peanut Butter", "1/2 cups Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["This recipe will make approximately 1 1/2 quarts of ice cream.", "Begin by freezing your ice cream maker canister. It is very important that it is completely frozen. Otherwise follow your ice cream maker instructions. If you do not have an ice cream maker, get one, seriously, get one.", "Once the ice cream canister is frozen, add the milk and sugar to a mixing bowl. Mix with a whisk until all of the sugar dissolves. Add in the vanilla extract and the heavy cream.", "Remove the canister from the freezer. Assemble your ice cream maker, turn it on, and add your ice cream mixture. Let the mixer spin for at least 30 minutes or according to manufacturer's instructions. You will begin to see the ice cream coming together.", "After 30 minutes of churning, add the peanut butter and chocolate chips into a bowl. Place in the microwave for about 30 seconds, just to slightly soften and melt the chips. Use a spoon and begin drizzling the mixture into the ice cream, using about half of the mixture. Let this spin for about five minutes. Stop the ice cream maker, then remove the paddle from the ice cream maker, and fold in the remaining chocolate chips and peanut butter.", "Take a bite, then back away quickly as you will be tempted to eat the whole bowl!", "Next, spoon the mixture into an airtight container and place in the freezer until you are ready to serve. I bought some pint size ice cream containers in the past, just to add a bit more excitement when the kids open the freezer looking for a treat.", "The flavor is great. You get the classic vanilla flavor, and hardened chunks of chocolate and peanut butter that are just perfect for chewing on, or sucking on; much like sucking on a spoon of peanut butter. And what kid does not like that?"]

title: Bakers Classic Chocolate Fudge
ingredients: ["2 packages (8 Ounces Or 8 Squares Each) Semi-sweet Chocolate", "1 can (14 Oz. Can) Sweetened Condensed Milk", "1 cup Chopped Walnuts", "2 teaspoons Vanilla"]
directions: ["Line an 8-inch square pan with foil, with the ends of the foil extending over the sides. Microwave the chocolate and milk on high for 2-3 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted, stirring after 2 minutes. Stir until completely melted. Add nuts and vanilla; mix well.", "Spread into the pan. Refrigerate for hours or until firm. Use the foil to lift the fudge from the pan before cutting to serve."]

title: Best Caramel Sauce Ever
ingredients: ["1 cup Sugar", "3/4 cups Heavy Cream", "6 ounces, weight Butter", "2 teaspoons Vanilla", "2 pinches Salt"]
directions: ["Pour sugar into a heavy saucier pan and place over medium heat. Allow sugar to melt without stirring. Once the sugar starts to melt (it will be a light brown color around the edges) start to stir it until all the sugar is completely melted and liquid. Then add the cream all at once. Mixture will bubble up and look lumpy. Stir vigorously to combine then add butter and whisk until butter is completely melted. Cook for 5 minutes until the sauce starts to thicken.", "Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla. Add the sea salt and mix to combine.", "Allow the mixture to cool in a wide mouth glass jar (or another glass container if you don't have a jar). Then cover it and place in the refrigerator.", "Sauce will keep for months in the refrigerator, if it lasts that long.", "You can use the sauce as a topping for ice cream, in brownies or cupcakes, or eat it one teaspoon at a time right out of the jar.", "Enjoy"]

title: Banana Walnut Breakfast Shake
ingredients: ["1 whole Banana", "1/2 cups Milk", "1/2 cups Walnuts", "1/2 cups Yogurt"]
directions: ["Add above ingredients into a blender. Blend till all are combined and the shake is nice and smooth. Enjoy!"]

title: Creamy Dill Potatoes
ingredients: ["1 bag Baby Potatoes (2lb)", "1/4 cups Onion, Chopped", "1 cup Milk", "1/4 cups Cream", "1/2 sticks Butter", "2 Tablespoons Dill (Fresh Or Dried)", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Start by rinsing your potatoes and slice them in half. Add water to cover and bring to a boil. Continue boiling for about 15-20 minutes or until just barely fork tender.", "Drain and return to pot.", "Add Onion, Milk and Cream and bring to a boil again.", "Reduce heat to low/medium and add Butter and Dill.", "Sprinkle with Salt and Pepper to taste.", "Continue simmering for another 15-20 minutes. They're ready when the sauce thickens and nicely coats the potatoes."]

title: Cole Slaw For Kids
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Crushed Pineapple, Juice Reserved (use The Small Tin)", "2 cups Shredded Cabbage", "1/2 cups Mini Marshmallows (I Used The Colored Ones)", "1/2 cups Sliced Almonds (optional)", "1/2 cups Coconut (shredded Or Flaked, Doesn't Matter)", "1/2 cups Mayonnaise"]
directions: ["Drain the pineapple well, reserving juice (you need it for the dressing).", "In a large bowl, place all the ingredients except the pineapple juice and mayo; stir well to combine.", "In a small bowl or measuring cup, add a wee bit of pineapple juice to the mayo, just to thin it out a bit (to salad dressing consistency). Pour a small amount over cabbage mixture and toss; add more dressing as you see fit.", "Refrigerate until serving."]

title: Cranberry Almond Chicken Salad
ingredients: ["3 cups Cooked Chicken Shredded", "3/4 cups Mayonnaise", "1 Tablespoon Lemon Juice", "1/3 cups Dried Cranberries, Chopped", "1/2 cups Slivered Almonds", "1 stalk Celery, Diced", "Salt And Pepper, to taste", "6 Low Carb Tortillas (optional)"]
directions: ["Add all ingredients in a bowl and mix until combined thoroughly. Wrap in a low carb tortilla and enjoy!"]

title: Caribbean Twist Smoothie
ingredients: ["6 ounces, weight Greek Yogurt, Plain", "1/2 whole Banana, Frozen", "1/2 cups Strawberries, Frozen", "1/2 cups Pineapple, Frozen", "1/2 cups Coconut Milk Or Milk Of Choice"]
directions: ["Add all ingredients into a blender and process until smooth."]

title: Honey-Almond Ice Cream
ingredients: ["2 cups Heavy Whipping Cream", "1 can (14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk", "1 Tablespoon Vanilla Extract", "3/4 cups Honey", "1/2 cups Lightly Salted, Roasted Almonds, Chopped"]
directions: ["1. In a large bowl, beat heavy cream until thick peaks begin to form.", "2. Fold in condensed milk, vanilla, honey, and almonds. Store in a covered container and place in the freezer for ten hours."]

title: Cool Cucumber Juice
ingredients: ["1 Cucumber", "2 Pears", "1 Lime"]
directions: ["Give all the fruit and vegetables a good scrub and cut them small enough to fit into your juicer. Be sure to cut the rinds off the lime because it can be quite bitter.", "Simply run the fruit and vegetables through your juicer and enjoy!"]

title: Coconut Oil Roasted Potatoes
ingredients: ["6 Medium Russet Potatoes", "1/3 cups To 1/2 Cup Coconut Oil", "Unrefined Sea Salt, To Taste"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 425\u00b0 F.", "Wash and scrub potatoes to remove dirt. Remove any blemishes or eyes with a pairing knife. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise.", "Spread coconut oil into the bottom of a 13x9-inch pan. You can melt the coconut oil first if you prefer. Sprinkle the salt on top of the coconut oil. Place the potatoes, cut side down, in the bottom of the pan. Sprinkle the tops of the potatoes with salt as well.", "Bake in preheated oven for about 45-60 minutes, or until potatoes are soft and the underside of the potatoes are browned and crispy.", "To serve, cut the potato open through the skin and spread on a little (or a lot of) butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper."]

title: Blueberry Key Lime Pie Smoothie
ingredients: ["6 ounces, weight Key Lime Pie Flavored Yogurt (I Used Yoplait)", "1/2 cups Blueberries, Frozen", "1 cup Coconut Milk, Unsweetened From Carton", "2 whole Ice Cubes"]
directions: ["Add all ingredients into a blender, put the lid on and process until smooth. Serve!"]

title: Grilled Chipotle Lime Sweet Potato Fries
ingredients: ["1 whole Large Sweet Potato (12 Ounce Size)", "1 teaspoon Olive Oil", "3 Tablespoons Lime Juice", "1 teaspoon Minced Canned Chipotle In Adobo Sauce", "1 dash Salt", "1 dash Pepper"]
directions: ["Wash potato and pierce it several times with a fork. Wrap potato in a damp paper towel. Microwave in 2 minute increments until fork tender (about 4 minutes depending on size of potato). Once cooked remove it from the microwave and set aside to cool; about 15 minutes.", "Once the potato is cooled, cut it into thick slices.", "Meanwhile, spray the grill with cooking spray or brush the grates with olive oil. Preheat the grill to medium low heat.", "In a bowl, add olive oil, lime juice, chipotle pepper, salt and pepper. Mix until combined. Brush over sweet potatoe slices.", "Add sweet potatoes to the grill and cook each side for about 3 minutes, until lightly charred. Be careful not to burn.", "Note: You will have leftover chipotle lime sauce leftover."]

title: Orange Apple Banana Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 Banana", "1 Orange", "1 Apple", "1/2 cups Yogurt"]
directions: ["Peel all of the fruit, remove the core from the apple and remove the seeds from the orange. Put ingredients into a blender, put the lid on and whiz to combine."]

title: Cinnamon-Sugar Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: ["1 Tablespoon Butter (vegan Butter)", "1/2 teaspoons Sugar", "1 pinch Sea Salt", "1/2 teaspoons Cinnamon", "1 Sweet Potato"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F.", "In a small dish, combine butter, sugar, salt and cinnamon.", "Slice sweet potato into 1-inch slices. Spread butter mixture over each side of each slice.", "Place on a pan and roast for 15 minutes. Turn over and roast 10 additional minutes. Poke with a fork to see if soft enough. If needed, cook longer.", "Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly before serving."]

title: Cinnamon Bourbon
ingredients: ["3 whole Cinnamon Sticks", "1-1/2 cup Bourbon"]
directions: ["1. Place the cinnamon sticks in a 500mL mason jar. Or you can do what I did and put the cinnamon sticks in the bottle of bourbon.", "2. If using a mason jar, pour the bourbon over the cinnamon sticks. Seal the jar and let it steep for 2-3 weeks, then strain out the cinnamon.", "3. Use this bourbon to spike apple cider, or add it to cocktails.", "When our parents took us on a trip to Sri Lanka, we visited a cinnamon plantation. We were given a small piece of the fresh bark of the cinnamon tree to taste, and not only did it taste like delicious cinnamon, it was surprisingly sweet! I was able to take a large, sturdy branch of the cinnamon tree back to Riyadh. I used it as a walking stick and even though it was stripped of its bark, it still faintly smelled of cinnamon for months afterward.", "The farmer on the plantation told us that while he grew true cinnamon, most of what the rest of the world gets, either in ground cinnamon or cinnamon stick form, is really cassia. I could taste the difference between his cinnamon and the so-called cinnamon I had tried in the past, and this was much superior. Alas, most of the cassia is labeled 'Cinnamon,' so it is extremely difficult to tell if you're getting the real deal. No matter, this recipe works well with cassia, too. Try a splash of this in a cup of apple cider and enjoy either hot or cold!"]

title: Christmas Eve Hot Chocolate
ingredients: ["3 cups Whole Milk", "2 cups Heavy Cream", "1 can (14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk", "2 cups Semi-sweet Chocolate Chips, Melted", "1/2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract", "Pinch Of Salt"]
directions: ["Whisk milk, cream, and sweetened condensed milk in a saucepan. Heat over medium heat until tiny bubbles just begin to form along the edges.", "Whisk in melted chocolate chips, vanilla extract, and pinch of salt until evenly distributed.", "Serve warm with whipped cream, marshmallows, or your topping of choice!", "Note: To melt the chocolate chips, you can either melt them over a double boiler or in the microwave. To microwave, heat in 30-second intervals, mixing each time, until chocolate chips are melted."]

title: Chopped Kale, Quinoa And Avocado Salad
ingredients: ["1-1/2 cup Chopped Kale", "3/4 cups Cooked Quinoa", "3 Tablespoons Avocado, diced", "4 Tablespoons Mushrooms, Diced", "1 Tablespoon Extra Virgin Olive Oil", "2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice", "1/2 teaspoons Parsley, Chopped", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Add kale, quinoa, avocado and mushrooms to a bowl. Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and lemon juice. Sprinkle with parsley, salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately as is or with your favorite dressing."]

title: Chocolate-Dipped Strawberries
ingredients: ["3 ounces, weight Dark Chocolate, At Least 72% Cacao", "12 Large Strawberries"]
directions: ["With a serrated bread knife, finely chop chocolate and place in a small bowl. Place bowl over simmering water and allow to slowly melt. Stir until smooth.", "Using a sturdy toothpick through stem end of berry, dip in chocolate, turning to coat about 2/3 the way up the strawberry.", "Place dipped berries on parchment-lined tray. Refrigerate until the chocolate has set."]

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cup
ingredients: ["16 ounces, weight Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips", "1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil", "1/2 cups Creamy Peanut Butter"]
directions: ["Melt chocolate in double boiler (place a heat proof bowl over boiling water). Add coconut oil and mix until the chocolate has completely melted and is creamy and smooth.", "Pour a layer of the melted chocolate into a silicone mold (paper muffin cups will work just fine!). Place it in freezer for about 15 minutes.", "Remove the chocolate from freezer, add about 1/2 tablespoon of peanut butter. Keep refrigerated."]

title: Salt & Vinegar Grilled Potato Wedges
ingredients: ["4 whole Russet Potatoes", "3 cups White Distilled Vinegar", "2 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "1 teaspoon Salt", "Coarse Sea Salt", "Chopped Chives For Garnish, If Desired"]
directions: ["1. Cup potatoes into large wedges. Place potato wedges into a medium sized pot. Pour in the vinegar and then fill it the rest of the way with water (for a large pot this will probably be about 7 cups of water). Just make sure all of the potato wedges are covered with liquid.", "2. Bring water to a boil, reduce to a simmer and simmer for 35-40 minutes until potatoes are fork tender, but not falling apart.", "3. Drain potatoes and place them into a large bowl. Let them cool for a few minutes. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt. Toss to coat potato wedges.", "4. Heat the grill to medium heat and place potato wedges on the grill. Grill for about 10 - 15 minutes, flipping occasionally. Remove from grill to a platter.", "5. Sprinkle with coarse sea salt and garnish with chopped chives, if desired."]

title: Aloha Cake
ingredients: ["1 can (20 Ounces) Cherry Pie Filling", "1 can (20 Ounces) Crushed Pineapple, Do Not Drain", "1 box (18 Ounces) Yellow Cake Mix", "1 cup Shredded Coconut", "1 cup Chopped Pecans", "3/4 cups Melted Butter"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350 degrees.", "Layer ingredients in the order listed in a (Pam) sprayed 9x13 pan. End by drizzling the butter over the whole cake. DO NOT STIR OR MIX! Bake for 1 hour."]

title: 10 Minutes “Baked” Potatoes
ingredients: ["2 whole Potatoes (any Kind Work)", "1/2 teaspoons Salt", "1/2 teaspoons Black Pepper"]
directions: ["Wash, scrub, and pat dry potatoes. Lay them out in a single layer on a microwavable-safe dish, and poke holes in each using a fork. This will allow steam to escape so potatoes don't explode.", "Microwave for 10 minutes on high. There should be no resistance when poked with a fork. Allow to cool for a couple of minutes then slice down the middle with a knife. Sprinkle each potato with salt and pepper to taste and enjoy!"]

title: Chocolate Buttercream Frosting
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Salted Butter, Cut Into 1 Tablespoon Pieces", "6 ounces, weight 77% Dark Chocolate, Chopped"]
directions: ["In a small pan over very low heat, melt chocolate and butter, stirring constantly. Place mixture in refrigerator for 20-30 minutes to chill.", "Remove from refrigerator and whip with a hand blender until thick and fluffy. Frost over Paleo Birthday Cake (see my blog or TK recipe box)."]

title: 2-Ingredient Hot Fudge
ingredients: ["1 can (14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk", "1-1/2 cup Semisweet Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["Pour the chocolate chips into a microwave-safe bowl. Pour the sweetened condensed milk over the top of the chocolate chips. Microwave for 2 minutes on high. Then stir briskly to melt the chocolate chips into the sweetened condensed milk. If there are still lumps, microwave for 1 more minute, and stir briskly again.", "Serve the hot fudge warm over ice cream, pound cake, fresh berries, fingers ...", "Note: This method can also be done on the stovetop."]

title: Avocado Hummus Toast
ingredients: ["2 slices Whole-grain Toast", "1/2 whole Medium Avocado", "1/2 whole Roma Tomato, Chopped", "2 Tablespoons Hummus", "1 pinch Za'atar"]
directions: ["Toast the bread. While the bread is toasting, mash the avocado in a small bowl, and mix in the tomatoes.", "Spread a tablespoon of hummus on each slice of bread. Then, top it with the avocado and tomato mixture. Sprinkle some za'atar for additional spice."]

title: Pineapple Orange Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 cup Orange Juice", "3/4 cups Pineapple, Frozen", "1/2 cups Ice Cubes"]
directions: ["Add all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth."]

title: Cheesy Cauliflower Soup
ingredients: ["2 cups Chicken Broth", "2 packages Frozen Cauliflower Florets, 8 Ounces Each", "1 stalk Celery, Chopped", "1 Carrot, Chopped", "1/2 cups Chopped Onion", "1/2 teaspoons Thyme", "1 dash Freshly Grated Nutmeg", "Sea Salt And Freshly-ground Black Pepper, To Taste", "1 cup Whole Or 2% Milk Or Half-and-Half", "1-1/2 cup Shredded Cheddar Cheese"]
directions: ["Throw all of the ingredients except the milk and cheese into a slow cooker and cook on low until vegetables are very tender, about 4-6 hours. Or put all of the ingredients except the milk and cheese into a stock pot, bring to boil and then lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes.", "Carefully pour mixture into the work bowl of a food processor fitted with a steel blade or into your blender container. Put the lid on and process until smooth. Or just keep the soup on the pot as is and blend with a handheld immersion blender. Or, if you like more texture like I do, use a potato masher and mash the soup in the pot until you reach your desired texture.", "Place your cauliflower mixture into a saucepan or leave it in the same pot if didn't use your crock pot. Stir in milk and cheese. Heat over medium heat, stirring constantly, until cheese is melted and mixture is hot.", "I usually double this recipe for the 3 of us so that we have leftovers.", "Serve with warm rolls and butter."]

title: Caramel Brownies
ingredients: ["1 box (15 1/4 Oz. Size) Chocolate Cake Mix", "1/2 cups Melted Butter", "5 ounces, fluid Evaporated Milk, Divided Use", "37 whole Brach's Caramel Squares", "1 cup Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["Combine dry cake mix with melted butter and 1/2 cup evaporated milk. Mixture will be thick.", "Press a little over half into a sprayed 9x13 glass pan. Bake at 350\u00b0F for 6-8 minutes.", "Unwrap caramel squares and combine them with 1/3 cup evaporated milk in a small saucepan. Heat over low heat and stir to melt and combine.", "Sprinkle chocolate chips over par-baked brownies, then pour caramel over top. Drop remaining batter in tablespoonfuls over the surface.", "Return to oven and bake for 15 more minutes, or until toothpick comes out clean. Cut while warm, but not piping hot, for best results."]

title: Chinese Sesame Peanut Brittle
ingredients: ["16 ounces, weight Shelled Raw Peanuts Or Shelled Raw Walnuts", "1 Tablespoon Oil For Brushing", "10 ounces, weight Rock Sugar", "1/3 cups Sesame Seeds"]
directions: ["Use a flat pan over medium heat to dry-roast the peanuts and/or walnuts (if using). Stir constantly (so they don't burn) until the peanuts are fragrant, about 10 minutes. Remove pan from heat and allow the nuts to cool completely.", "Once the peanuts are completely cool, use your hands to loosen the skins from the peanuts. Now, the next part is a little tricky. Grasp the pan with both hands, and toss the peanuts up and down, while angling the pan slightly downward. If all goes right, the peanuts should flip up in the air and land back into the pan while the skins fly out over the sides. It's a good idea to do this over the sink. Of course, you can also buy shelled, already skinned peanuts. You can also buy plain roasted peanuts of course, but roasting them at home will make the peanut brittle taste a lot fresher.", "Next, crush the peanuts into smaller pieces by laying them on a large cutting board or clean kitchen surface and rolling with a rolling pin. Set the peanuts aside.", "Now brush the surface of your cutting board and rolling pin with a very light layer of oil to prevent sticking when you pour the brittle on it later.", "Using the same pan from earlier, melt the rock sugar by stirring constantly over medium low heat. It will take about 5 minutes to melt the rock sugar completely. Add the peanuts and sesame seeds to the melted sugar and mix well.", "Quickly pour the hot peanut and sugar mixture onto the greased, flat surface of your cutting board and immediately roll it out to about 1/3-inch thick. Cut into desired size and shape. Enjoy!"]

title: Apricot & Banana Super Smoothie
ingredients: ["4 whole Fresh Apricots, Diced Small", "1 whole Fresh Or Frozen Banana, Cut Into Chunks", "1/2 cups 1% Milk", "2 Tablespoons Maple Syrup", "1 Tablespoon Whey Protein Powder", "1/8 teaspoons Nutmeg"]
directions: ["Add apricot and banana to a blender and pulse several times. Add remaining ingredients and blend on high for 2 minutes.", "Serve in a chilled glass and enjoy!"]

title: Individual Strawberry Shortcake Trifle
ingredients: ["1 pint Heavy Whipping Cream", "3 Tablespoons Sugar", "2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract", "4 cups Pound Cake, Diced", "2 cups Strawberries, Sliced"]
directions: ["Add heavy cream, sugar and vanilla extract to a stand mixer with the whisk attachment. Whisk on high until cream forms soft peaks.", "To assemble the trifle, start by adding pound cake into the bottom of the glasses. (I divide it between 4-6 jars, depending on size; you can always add this to a large bowl to serve a crowd.) Next, layer on whipped cream and strawberries evenly among jars. Repeat.", "Serve immediately or store in the fridge until ready to serve."]

title: Slow Cooker Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: ["3 pounds Russet Potatoes, Peeled And Cut Into Small Chunks", "1 cup Chicken Broth (see Note)", "4 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter; Cut Into Pats", "1-1/2 teaspoon Salt", "1/2 cups Sour Cream", "Chives Or Scallions, For Garnish", "Heavy Cream Or Milk, To Taste (optional)"]
directions: ["Combine potatoes, chicken broth (see note below), butter, and salt in a slow cooker. Stir together, then cover and cook on high for 3-4 hours, until potatoes are tender and fluffy-looking. Mash with a potato masher or fork (or put them through a potato ricer, for super smooth potatoes), then add sour cream, chives or scallions, heavy cream or milk, or whatever ingredients you'd like. Season to taste, then serve and enjoy!", "Note: I used unsalted chicken broth. If you use full salt, reduce the salt to 1 teaspoon, then season to taste at the end. If you wish to skip the chicken broth, substitute water instead."]

title: Peach Nice Cream
ingredients: ["1 whole Banana, Previously Frozen", "1-1/2 cup Sliced Peaches, Previously Frozen", "1/2 cups Coconut Milk", "1 teaspoon Vanilla"]
directions: ["Pour all ingredients in the bowl of a food processor. Blend until smooth.", "Transfer half of the mixture to a Zoku Ice Cream Maker and follow instruction manual until nice cream forms. Repeat with the remaining mixture. Serve with desired toppings.", "Alternatively, pour the ingredients into an airtight container and freeze until the nice cream reaches a frozen yogurt texture."]

title: Baby Spinach, Blueberry And Wheatgrass Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 whole Small Apple", "1 cup Baby Spinach", "1 whole Large Banana", "1 cup Blueberries", "1 teaspoon Wheat Grass Powder"]
directions: ["Blend all the ingredients together with as much water and ice as you like and serve."]

title: Smashed Potatoes
ingredients: ["4 whole Leftover Baked Potatoes From Fridge", "4 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "1 Tablespoon Sea Salt"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 500 degrees F. Take a baking sheet and line it with foil.", "Remove your leftover baked potatoes from fridge. Place potatoes on baking sheet, spread out evenly. Take the bottom of a small plate or glass and press it on top of each potato until it is flat or smashed. Then drizzle the potato with olive oil. Grind the sea salt on top of all the potatoes. Place potatoes in oven for about 15 to 20 minutes just until they start to crisp.", "Very good and a fast side dish. My husband tops it with butter, sour cream, and cheese. Me, I just eat it the way it comes out of the oven!!"]

title: Orange Sunrise Morning Smoothie
ingredients: ["2 cups Trop50 Orange Juice, Divided", "1 cup Frozen Mango", "1 Small Beet, Chunks", "6 Ice Cubes"]
directions: ["Blend the frozen mango with 1 cup of orange juice until smooth. Pour into a large glass and set aside.", "Using the same blender cup, add the beet, remaining cup of juice, and ice cubes. Blend until smooth.", "Pour beet juice into glasses, equally divided. Complete each glass with the orange/mango smoothie. The two juices will stay separated but you can mix it a little for a delicious combination of flavors or drink as-is."]

title: Black And Blue Jam
ingredients: ["32 ounces, weight Frozen Blueberries, Thawed", "12 ounces, weight Frozen Blackberries, Thawed", "2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice", "1 package (1.75 Oz.) Powdered Pectin (Sure-Jell)", "5 cups Sugar", "1 teaspoon Butter"]
directions: ["Jars: Sterilize 8 half-pint jars according to package directions. Sterilize all tools that will come in contact with your jam. That's very important when canning.", "Crush most of the berries and place them in a large, heavy duty pot. Add the lemon juice and the box of pectin, stirring constantly over medium-high heat. Bring mixture to a boil and add in the sugar, continuing to stir. Bring back up to a boil and continue to stir for 2 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the butter. Skim the foam off the top if there is any.", "Ladle the jam into the hot jars and place the tops and lids on. Process in hot water according to canning directions. There are roughly 8 servings per jar. Keep them all or give them as gifts. I haven't bought a jar of jam since I started making my own. There is nothing better than homemade. Enjoy!"]

title: Banana And Kiwi Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 Banana", "1/3 cups Spinach", "1 Kiwi", "200 milliliters Apple Juice", "1/2 cups Ice"]
directions: ["Place everything in a blender and blitz until smooth. Enjoy immediately."]

title: Big Batch O’ Bacon
ingredients: ["1 pound Thick Cut Bacon"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350 degrees.", "Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil. Place slices of bacon in a single layer on the baking sheet with the edges just touching.", "Bake in the oven until bacon achieves desired level of crispness, roughly 10-15 minutes. Carefully remove tray from oven and drain off excess grease. Remove bacon to paper towel-covered platter to finish draining.", "Tips:", "You can sprinkle some brown sugar on in the last 5 minutes of baking - yum!", "For extra large batches, use 2 baking sheets and swap shelf location halfway through.", "If you want to use thinner bacon, keep a close eye on it and shorten bake time if necessary.", "If you have an ovenproof wire cooling rack, you can place it in your baking sheet, thereby letting the grease drain off of the bacon as it cooks."]

title: Snowday Peppermint Hot Chocolate
ingredients: ["1 quart Half-and-half", "1 package (12 Oz. Package) Semi-sweet Chocolate Pieces", "1/2 teaspoons Peppermint Extract", "Crushed Peppermint Pieces, For Garnish", "Miniature Marshmallows, Or Garnish"]
directions: ["In a medium saucepan, heat the half-and-half and chocolate chips over medium heat, stirring constantly, until chocolate is melted and well-mixed (about 3-5 minutes). Add the peppermint extract. Serve while warm with miniature marshmallows and peppermint pieces."]

title: Brandy Alexander
ingredients: ["1 ounce, fluid Brandy", "1 ounce, fluid Dark Creme De Cacao", "1 ounce, fluid Fresh Cream (half-and-half)", "Nutmeg (for Garnish)"]
directions: ["Pour the brandy, creme de cacao and cream into a mixing glass with cracked ice. Shake and pour into a chilled martini glass. Garnish with a sprinkle of nutmeg on top.", "Bartender's notes to jazz it up:", "Leave out the cream and ice, and instead blend the alcohol with vanilla ice cream. Oh yeah.", "Serve it over crushed ice to make it a frappe.", "Add fruit! Serve with strawberries or any other kind of berry. You can also try out oranges and peaches. If you really want to get exotic go for any fruit dipped in chocolate, take a bite and sip the drink-the flavor combinations in your mouth are just heavenly.", "Drink responsibly!"]

title: Fun And Easy Lemon Coolers
ingredients: ["1 whole Lemon", "1 whole 5 Inch Candy Stick, Pink Lemonade Or Raspberry Flavor Is Best"]
directions: ["Roll your lemon back and forth on the counter to get the juices flowing. Cut a small hole near the stem end of the lemon. Insert your candy stick into the hole. Suck on the candy stick like a straw. It takes a few minutes to get the juices flowing. Enjoy on a hot and lazy summer afternoon.", "To make the lemon stand, slightly trim the bottom of the lemon."]

title: Cheesy Potato Heaven
ingredients: ["6 Potatoes, Whatever Kind You Like", "1 teaspoon Dry Oregano", "1 cup Mozzarella Cheese", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Turn oven on 400\u00b0F. Spray the baking sheet with nonstick spray.", "Wash and slice the potatoes to your preferred thickness. Place one layer of potatoes on the baking sheet, sprinkle with the dried oregano, salt and pepper, and place in the oven. Cook until tender, about 20 minutes, depending on the thickness of the slices. Take the potatoes out of the oven and sprinkle with mozzarella cheese and return to the oven until cheese is melted, about 5 minutes more. Serve the delicious goodness to your family!!"]

title: Blueberry Sauce
ingredients: ["2 cups Blueberries", "1-1/2 Tablespoon Sugar, Divided", "1/2 whole Lemon, Juiced"]
directions: ["Place blueberries in a small saucepan with 1 tablespoon of sugar and cook over low heat. Stir in the sugar and mash 3/4 of the blueberries with the back of a fork. Simmer for 3-4 minutes. Next stir in the lemon juice and add the remaining 1/2 tablespoon of additional sugar. Remove from heat and let cool for at least 10 minutes. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.", "(Inspired by Lobster Rolls & Blueberry Pie by Rebecca Charles and Deborah Di Clementi.)"]

title: Pudge
ingredients: ["1 cup Peanut Butter", "1-1/2 cup Chocolate Chips", "4 cups Miniature Marshmallows"]
directions: ["1. Grease a 9x9 or 8x8 pan.", "2. In a medium-sized saucepan, melt peanut butter and chocolate chips. When melted, fold in marshmallows.", "3. Put into greased pan and refrigerate until set. Cut into bars."]

title: Peach Coconut Ice Cream
ingredients: ["2 cans Coconut Milk (full-fat Recommended), 13.6 Ounces Each", "1 cup Half-and-half Or Cream", "1/2 cups Cane Sugar", "6 whole Ripe Peaches, Pitted And Quartered With The Peel On"]
directions: ["Note: Depending on the size of your peaches, this makes between 7 and 8 cups of ice cream base. Makes 2 to 3 batches of ice cream if you're using a standard-sized ice cream maker.", "Heat coconut milk and cream in a saucepan over medium high until hot and barely bubbling (bring to a low boil). Add sugar and mix to dissolve. Remove pan from heat.", "Pour mixture into a blender along with the chopped peaches. Be careful it will be hot so if the blender is too full you should do this in two batches. Blend until fully pureed. Allow the mixture to cool about 10 minutes before pouring mixture into a large container. Refrigerate a few hours until cold.", "If using an ice cream maker, follow the instructions on your ice cream maker and churn the ice cream accordingly.", "You can also try this without an ice cream maker by putting the ice cream mixture in a freezer-safe container, placing it in the freezer and stirring with a spoon every hour for roughly 8-10 hours. If you try this without an ice cream maker the consistency will not be as creamy as you'd get when using an ice cream maker, but the ice cream will still be great!", "If you have leftovers in the freezer, thaw the ice cream at least 10 minutes before attempting to dig in because it will be much stiffer than store-bought ice cream."]

title: Easy Peasy Peach Cobbler
ingredients: ["1 stick Melted Butter", "1/2 boxes (18 Oz. Size) Butter Pecan Cake Mix", "1 can (29 Oz. Size) Sliced Peaches"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F.", "Melt butter. Pour canned peaches into your cobbler baking dish, juice and all. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over the top of the peaches. Pour on the melted butter, trying to cover as much of the dry mix as possible. Don't worry if some mix is dry; it will absorb the moisture as it cooks. Do not stir.", "Place in the oven and bake 35-45 minutes until top has browned! Allow to cool and rest 5 minutes or more, if you can-it smells so good."]

title: Cookies N Cream Shake
ingredients: ["2 cups Cookies N' Cream Ice Cream", "2 cups Milk"]
directions: ["Put your ingredients in a blender and blend it up."]

title: Chocolate Dipped Pears
ingredients: ["4 ounces, weight Dark Chocolate", "3 whole Pears, Sliced"]
directions: ["Melt chocolate in a heatproof bowl set over a pan of simmering water, stirring until smooth. Let cool slightly.", "Dip the bottom quarter of each pear slice into the chocolate, using a spoon or knife to smooth it out. Set each slice onto parchment paper and refrigerate until chocolate has set, at least 15 minutes.", "(Recipe adapted from Power Foods cookbook.)"]

title: Heavenly And Refreshing Mango Lassi
ingredients: ["1 whole Ripe Mango", "2 cups Plain Yogurt", "1 Tablespoon Honey", "8 whole Ice Cubes"]
directions: ["Peel and cut mangoes roughly. Place in a mixer or food processor along with yogurt, honey and ice cubes. Mix till smooth and even. Pour in glasses and serve. Garnish with mango cubes.", "Note: You may use homemade curds instead of yogurt."]

title: 3-Ingredient Biscoff Cookies
ingredients: ["1 cup Biscoff Spread", "1 whole Egg", "1 cup Sugar"]
directions: ["Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0F. Line a cookie sheet with a Silpat or parchment paper.", "In a medium bowl, mix the Biscoff, egg and sugar until smooth and blended.", "Drop spoonfuls of the dough onto the cookie sheet, 2 inches apart (these cookies spread a lot). Bake 8-10 minutes for soft cookies (or 12 minutes for crispy cookies)."]

title: High-Fat Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: ["3 pounds Potatoes", "8 Tablespoons Butter", "2/3 cups Cream (I Add More, If Necessary, When Mashing The Potatoes)", "Salt And Pepper"]
directions: ["Peel and cube the potatoes. Put in a large sauce pan (or smaller stock pot). Fill with enough cold water to cover by about 1 inch. Add approximately 1 tablespoon salt (I use sea salt). Bring to a boil over high heat. Turn down to medium or medium-high. Boil for 15 to 20 minutes, until potatoes are tender. (I check with a butter knife swiped through the water, and when I see it easily cut through a potato, it's done :D. These are very high-tech methods I employ.) Drain potatoes and return to the pot.", "While potatoes are cooking, prepare the butter and cream. Put your butter in a small sauce pan and pour the cream over it. Sprinkle pepper to taste. Generously sprinkle salt. Simmer on low heat until butter is completely melted into the cream.", "When potatoes are drained, add about half of the butter and cream mixture. Start mashing with your potato masher. (Mixers? Mixers are for wimps! Of course, I am still coveting a Bosch mixer, so I'll get back to you on this when I have one.) As you mash, add the rest of your cream as you see fit. I usually add all of it, since I put a sparing amount of cream in with the butter and add more if necessary. Fluffy, but not soupy. Not dry or crumbly, either.", "Once you have the cream/potato ratio right, whip it into airy fluffiness. Taste a small amount (don't burn your mouth!) and adjust the salt and pepper, if necessary. By adjust, I mean add more if you want it, of course. I am a big fan of butter, so if you like butter, feel free to dollop this with small pats of butter before serving. Or not, if you're suspicious of butter ;). Easy and super good. Enjoy!"]

title: Cherry Lemon Granita
ingredients: ["2 cups Cherries, Pitted (fresh Or Frozen)", "1 whole Lemon, Juiced", "1 Tablespoon Agave", "2 Tablespoons Vodka (2-4 Tablespoons Depending On How Boozy You Want It, Or Omit Altogether)"]
directions: ["Place cherries in a food processor and pulse until almost pureed. A few chunks is ok.", "In a small bowl combine lemon, agave and vodka, if using, with a whisk. Add pureed cherries to the bowl and stir together.", "Pour mixture into a shallow metal dish or pan. Freeze for 1 1/2 hours, scraping with a fork every 15-20 minutes."]

title: Cream Cheese Icing
ingredients: ["1 pound Cream Cheese", "1/2 pounds Butter", "1-1/2 teaspoon Vanilla Extract", "1 pound Icing Sugar"]
directions: ["1. Cream the cream cheese, butter, and vanilla in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment.", "2. Slowly add the sugar and beat until smooth. Perfectly paired with carrot cake cupcakes. Top your dessert with this icing, and enjoy!"]

title: Chocolate Cake Shake
ingredients: ["6 whole Scoops Chocolate Ice Cream", "1 slice (BIG) Chocolate Cake With Chocolate Frosting, Prepared", "2 Tablespoons Milk (just A Splash)"]
directions: ["In a blender, combine ice cream with chocolate cake (broken in chunks). Add milk and blend.", "Enjoy!"]

title: Coconut Rice
ingredients: ["1 cup Jasmine Rice", "3 cups Milk", "1/3 cups Flaked Coconut", "2 Tablespoons Granulated Sugar"]
directions: ["Place the rice and milk in a rice cooker and once it gets hot and starts to boil, add the coconut and sugar. Serve warm.", "If you don't have a rice cooker, in a medium pot, bring rice and milk to a boil. Once it boils, stir in the coconut and sugar and turn heat to low. Cover and simmer until the liquid has been absorbed, about 15-20 minutes."]

title: Basil Salad Dressing
ingredients: ["2 ounces, weight Fresh Picked Basil", "3/4 cups Olive Oil", "1/2 teaspoons Celtic Sea Salt", "1/2 teaspoons Pepper", "1 teaspoon Lemon Juice"]
directions: ["1. Combine all ingredients in a high-speed blender.", "2. Blend on high speed until smooth.", "3. Serve over greens or kelp noodles."]

title: Spring Couscous Salad
