ingredients: ["1 cup Israeli Couscous", "2 teaspoons Olive Oil", "2 cups Chicken Stock", "3 strips Bacon", "1 bunch Asparagus, Ends Trimmed Off Then Cut Spears Into 1-inch Pieces", "1/2 cups Fresh English Peas", "1 whole Lemon, Zest And Juice", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Combine the olive oil and couscous in a large skillet over medium high heat. Toast the couscous until just golden brown and then add the chicken stock. Stir occasionally and let cook until all the liquid is gone. Transfer the cooked couscous to a bowl and set aside.", "Place another skillet over medium heat. Add the strips of bacon and cook until crisp on both sides. Remove bacon from the skillet and set it aside. Add the trimmed asparagus into the skillet with the drippings. Saute for 4-5 minutes and season with salt and pepper as needed. Add the asparagus into the bowl with the cooked couscous. Keep the bacon drippings if you'd like to add them to the salad later.", "Bring a small pot of water to a boil. Add the peas and blanch them for about 3 minutes. Drain the peas and shock them by putting them into an ice bath. Add peas to the couscous mixture.", "Crumble the bacon. Toss together the couscous, bacon and vegetables with the lemon juice and zest. Taste and adjust salt and pepper if desired. Also, feel free to add a teaspoon or so of the bacon drippings if desired. Serve warm or at room temperature."]

title: Flourless Speculoos Cookies
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Sugar", "1/2 cups Brown Sugar", "1 cup Speculoos Cookie Butter (you Can Find This At Trader Joe's Or On Amazon.com)", "1 whole Egg", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 325 F.", "In a medium bowl, using a spoon, mix together all ingredients until just blended. Take about a tablespoon of dough and roll into ball, place onto a parchment lined baking sheet and press a crisscross pattern into the top of each drop with a fork.", "Bake 10 to 15 minutes, or until light golden. Cool before removing from baking sheet."]

title: Cinnamon Peach Ice Cream
ingredients: ["2 pounds (about 6) Whole Peaches, Peeled And Sliced, Or 2 Cups Peaches, Frozen Or Canned", "1/2 cups Granulated Sugar", "1/4 cups Brown Sugar", "1/2 teaspoons Cinnamon", "2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice", "2 cups Heavy Cream", "1 cup Buttermilk", "1 teaspoon Vanilla"]
directions: ["If using fresh peaches, place peaches into a pot of boiling water for NO MORE than 30 seconds. Remove from boiling water and transfer to a bowl filled with ice water; this prevents them from cooking. Remove from the ice water and the peach skins should rub right off.", "Slice peaches and put in a bowl. Combine with both granulated and brown sugar, cinnamon, and lemon juice. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2-3 hours or overnight if possible. (If using canned or frozen peaches, use less sugar if they are preserved in a syrup or sugar.)", "Once peaches have been macerated, put about 1 1/2 cups of the peaches in a food processor and puree. (The rest are used at the end.) In a large bowl, combine the heavy cream, buttermilk, vanilla and pureed peaches. Freeze according to your ice cream maker's directions.", "Once ice cream has been formed, add in the remaining non-pureed peach mixture and stir. For a variation, add crumbled shortbread cookies for a peach cobbler ice cream.", "Makes about 1.5 quarts."]

title: Cabbage Slaw With Radishes, Cilantro, And Scallions
ingredients: ["1 pound Shredded Cabbage Or Packaged Coleslaw Mix", "8 Radishes, Trimmed And Sliced Thin", "3 Scallions, Trimmed And Sliced Thin", "6 Tablespoons To 8 Tablespoons Pure Olive Oil", "Salt And Ground Black Pepper", "1-1/2 Tablespoon To 2 Tablespoons Lime Juice"]
directions: ["Place slaw ingredients in a large bowl, and when ready to serve, toss with the smaller amount of olive oil and a generous sprinkling of salt and pepper. Taste, adding more oil, salt, or pepper, if necessary. Add the smaller amount of lime juice; toss to coat. Taste, adding more, if necessary."]

title: Honey-Mint Yogurt Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 container (5 Oz. Size) Plain Yogurt", "1/2 cups Pure Honey", "1/2 cups Low-fat (1%) Milk", "2 leaves Fresh Chopped Mint"]
directions: ["Place all ingredients into a blender and blend for 3 minutes on high speed.", "Serve in chilled glasses and enjoy the sweetness and creamiest smoothie we Southern gals love!"]

title: Cheesy Bacon Biscuit Pull-Aparts
ingredients: ["1 can (16.3 Oz. Size) Refrigerated Grands Biscuits", "4 slices Swiss Cheese", "1 package (2 Oz. Size) Pre-Cooked Bacon", "1/2 cups Shredded Colby-jack Cheese"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 325\u00b0F. Line a 9\" pan with foil (for easy cleanup). Spray with nonstick cooking spray.", "Place biscuits in pan. Top each biscuit with half a slice of Swiss cheese.", "Chop bacon into bite size pieces and sprinkle over Swiss cheese. Top bacon with shredded cheese.", "Bake for 15-20 minutes or until cheese is melted and biscuits are cooked through. Serve immediately."]

title: Orange, Banana And Pear Smoothie
ingredients: ["2 cups Orange Juice", "1 whole Pear, Peeled And Seeded", "1 whole Banana, Peeled", "6 Ice Cubes"]
directions: ["Dump everything into the blender. Blend away. Drink immediately.", "Note: You can also add fresh mint."]

title: Spring Cleaning Chocolate & Peanut Butter Lover’S Bark
ingredients: ["6 ounces, weight Semi-sweet Chocolate, Roughly Chopped", "1/2 cups M&Ms", "1/2 cups Reese's Pieces", "1/2 cups Peanut Butter Cups, Roughly Chopped (about 8 Small)"]
directions: ["Line a jelly roll pan or cookie sheet with parchment paper and set aside.", "Melt semi-sweet chocolate: Place chocolate in a microwave-safe bowl and microwave in 30-second increments, stirring in between, until melted. Use a spatula to spread melted chocolate onto parchment paper in the shape of a rectangle so that chocolate is 1/8 - 1/4 inch thick.", "Immediately sprinkle M&Ms, Reese's Pieces and peanut butter cups over melted chocolate. Set aside to cool for 1- 2 hours or until firm.", "Once bark is firm, cut into pieces and enjoy. Store in an airtight container in a cool place."]

title: Hot Mulled Apple
ingredients: ["1 liter Apple Juice Or 8 Apples Juiced", "2 Tablespoons Maple Syrup", "4 sticks Cinnamon", "4 Cloves", "2 slices Orange, Cut Into Quarters", "2 slices Lemon Cut Into Quarters"]
directions: ["Place apple juice, maple syrup, cinnamon sticks, cloves, oranges and lemons in a large saucepan. Heat gently for about 10 minutes", "Discard cinnamon sticks, cloves, oranges and lemons. Pour carefully into mugs and enjoy."]

title: 5 Minute Roasted Broccoli
ingredients: ["2 heads Broccoli", "1 Tablespoon Olive Oil", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350 F.", "Chop the broccoli into bite-sized florets. Toss the broccoli into a pan. I use a loaf pan. Sprinkle with salt and pepper. Add in the olive oil and mix to distribute the oil and seasoning.", "Bake in the oven at 350 F for about 5-7 minutes. Stir it halfway through to ensure even cooking."]

title: 3-Ingredient Strawberry Ice Cream
ingredients: ["2 cups Heavy Cream", "1 can (14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk (Low-fat Or Nonfat Works, Too)", "2 cups Chopped Strawberries (measured Out, Then Finely Chop Or Puree Them)"]
directions: ["In a large bowl, using a hand mixer, whip the heavy cream until it starts to form soft peaks (just until it starts to get a tiny bit stiff). Add in the sweetened condensed milk and continuing whipping for about 1 minute. Fold in chopped/pureed strawberries and pour into freezer containers (Mason jars, Tupperware, whatever you want).", "Freeze for 6-8 hours (or overnight). Remove from the freezer and enjoy!", "Note: if the ice cream is really hard when you remove it from the freezer, just let it sit at room temperature for a few minutes to thaw a bit."]

title: Shine Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 Avocado, Halved, Peeled, And Pitted", "1 Lime, Juiced", "1/2 cups Coconut Milk", "16 ounces, weight Frozen Chopped Mango, Thawed", "16 ounces, weight Frozen Strawberries, Thawed"]
directions: ["Place all ingredients in a food processor. Puree until smooth and creamy. Serve."]

title: Easy Whipped Cream
ingredients: ["1 cup Heavy Whipping Cream", "4 Tablespoons Sugar", "2-1/2 teaspoons Vanilla"]
directions: ["1. Pour all ingredients in a bowl.", "2. Blend using a stand or electric mixer until peaks form.", "3. Use as a garnish for your favorite foods!"]

title: Homemade Coffee Creamer
ingredients: ["2 cups Ultra-pasteurized Milk (2% Or Whole)", "2 Tablespoons Honey", "1-1/2 teaspoon Real Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["Bring milk and honey to a simmer over medium heat, stirring occasionally. Once it comes to a simmer, remove from heat and add vanilla. Cool and pour into a refrigerator-friendly container. My favorite is a mason jar.", "Enjoy with your coffee.", "If you want your creamer to be creamier, substitute half of the milk for half-and-half for only an additional 6 calories and 0.5 gram of fat per 2-tablespoon serving."]

title: Mixed Berry Compote
ingredients: ["2-1/2 cups Frozen Or Fresh Mixed Berries", "3 Tablespoons Sugar", "1-1/2 Tablespoon Honey", "1 dash Cinnamon", "1/2 whole Lemon, Zested"]
directions: ["Add all ingredients except the lemon zest to a skillet and cook over medium-low heat for about 10 minutes, carefully moving the mixture around.", "Once heated through and juices have been extracted from fruit, remove from heat and stir in the lemon zest."]

title: Honey Peanut Butter Spread
ingredients: ["5 Tablespoons Natural Peanut Butter", "5 Tablespoons Good Quality Honey"]
directions: ["Measure peanut butter into small Mason jar and microwave for 30 seconds (or heat it on the stove top just until it softens). Measure honey into the same container. Stir well."]

title: Homemade Coconut Butter
ingredients: ["2-2/3 cups Unsweetened Shredded Coconut"]
directions: ["Pour the coconut into the bowl of a food processor and process until smooth, approximately 10 minutes. (If using a Vitamix, blend for approximately 3-5 minutes.)", "Transfer to an airtight container and store at room temperature for a couple months. Do not refrigerate.", "Note: If your butter doesn't get as smooth as a nut butter, you can add 1-2 teaspoons of coconut oil to help it along."]

title: Kicked Up Creamed Corn From Scratch
ingredients: ["6 slices Bacon, Chopped", "1 whole Poblano Pepper, Chopped", "8 whole Ears Of Fresh Corn", "1-1/2 cup Heavy Cream", "1-1/2 teaspoon Salt", "1/2 teaspoons Pepper"]
directions: ["Over medium heat, saute bacon until crisp about 10 minutes, stirring frequently. Drain all but a little of the grease (About 1 Tablespoon). Add in poblano pieces and stir and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.", "Cut corn off cob with knife into a bowl. Using the back of the knife, scrape down the cobs on all sides to remove as much pulp and corn \"milk\" and pulp as possible into same bowl. Add all of this into the pan with bacon, fat and peppers. Saute about 5 minutes more. Add in cream, salt and pepper and let corn cook in bubbling cream another 5-7 minutes (on low simmer). Serve warm."]

title: Fall Mix
ingredients: ["1 jar 16 Oz Jar Dry Roasted Peanuts", "1 bag 12 Oz Bag Classic M&Ms", "1 bag 21 Oz Bag Candy Corn"]
directions: ["Mix everything together in a large bowl and try not to eat it all in one day! Also a great gift to package up and take to your neighbors or friends."]

title: Cake Mix Peach Cobbler
ingredients: ["2 cans (15 Oz. Size) Sliced Peaches", "1 box (18.25 Oz. Size) Yellow Cake Mix", "1/2 cups Butter Or Margarine", "1 dash Cinnamon, To Taste"]
directions: ["Preheat the oven to 350\u00b0F.", "Drain the juice from 1 can of peaches into a bowl and set it aside.", "Arrange the peaches in a 9\" by 13\" pan.", "Cover the peaches with cake mix, using a spoon to distribute evenly.", "Slice butter into about 18 pats. Distribute them randomly across the surface of the cobbler.", "Sprinkle with cinnamon, then drizzle peach juice over the top.", "Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, or until the cobbler has a golden brown color."]

title: Bircher Muesli
ingredients: ["200 grams Jumbo Rolled Oats", "375 grams Apple Juice", "Optional For Serving: Dried Fruits, Fresh Fruits, Nuts, Seeds And/or Yoghurt"]
directions: ["In a medium bowl, stir together the jumbo rolled oats and the apple juice. Place in refrigerator and soak overnight.", "Serve with dried fruits, fresh fruits, nuts, seeds and/or yoghurt."]

title: Frying Bacon
ingredients: ["12 strips Bacon"]
directions: ["See related blog post for photos of the entire process.", "Most people know how to fry bacon. I am one of those people now. I was NOT one of those people five years ago. In fact, I completely embarrassed myself trying to fry bacon in front of a former employee. I was a nanny for a guy who was a chef for the Library of Congress. ...not just a lowly line cook, mind you....he was a full on chef. (They paid me $30,000+ a year to watch their kiddo, so he was making quite a tidy sum I'm guessing...) Anyway, I was cooking lunch for his 3 year old and he happened to be home. I decided to make BLT's. I didn't know that you shouldn't fry bacon on HIGH heat. So I burned the bacon and filled the house with smoke...SO embarrassing...", "I eventually learned how to fry bacon correctly. It starts with a pan on MEDIUM to maybe medium-high heat. Lay out the bacon closely, but not touching (or they will become friends, bond together and be hard to flip).", "See how those strips in the back are starting to bubble just a bit? That is good. Here go a few more...", "When they start browning on the bottom they are almost ready to flip.", "Flip the strips one by one with a fork and fry the other side. As soon they have some froth on top, light brown all over and shriveled up a bit, pull it off quickly and get it onto a plate lined with paper towels (to catch the grease).", "If you are being more precise, you could have several plates to line the bacon up on to dry so that it doesn't clump together, but I didn't need to be precise with this recipe.", "After you finish pulling the bacon out of the pan, make sure you turn the burners off! I let the grease sit in the pan until cool, then slide it off with a spatula and save it for things like sliding grease under the skin of a turkey or making a pot of beans taste delicious. The grease will freeze too and also makes good suet bakes with birdseed during winter. Do not use bacon fat suet in the summer because it might rot and/or attract meat eaters."]

title: Baked Bacon
ingredients: ["1 pound Bacon"]
directions: ["Place a long sheet of foil on a baking sheet. Place the bacon on top of the sheet about an inch apart from each slice.", "Put the sheet in the oven and turn it to 425\u00b0F and bake for 15-16 minutes.", "Remove and place the bacon on several sheets of paper towels to soak up the grease. Serve."]

title: Roasted Strawberries
ingredients: ["1 pound Strawberries, Stems Removed", "3 Tablespoons Granulated Sugar Or Raw Sugar"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F. Quarter the large strawberries and halve the smaller ones.", "Place the strawberries in a 9-inch pie plate or 8x8 baking dish. Sprinkle the sugar over the strawberries and toss several times.", "Roast the strawberries for 15-20 minutes, stirring once during the baking time. The strawberries are done when they have softened and the juices are thick and bubbly.", "Cool completely and store in the fridge."]

title: Ginger & Spice Chocolate Bark
ingredients: ["8 ounces, fluid Dark Chocolate", "3/4 cups Gingersnap Cookies Crushed", "1/2 cups Chocolate Chips, Plus 1 Tablespoon To Melt And Drizzle Over Bark"]
directions: ["Place wax paper on a large sheet pan and set aside on countertop. Bring a pot filled about halfway to a boil. Reduce heat to simmer and place a glass bowl on top. Place dark chocolate in the bowl and melt, stirring occasionally until the mixture becomes very smooth.", "While the chocolate cooks, place gingersnap cookies in a Ziploc bag and crush with a rolling pin or by hand until broken into tiny pieces. Transfer to a bowl and set aside.", "Once chocolate is melted, remove from heat and pour onto the prepared wax paper. Spread evenly with a spatula.", "Sprinkle crushed gingersnap bits on top of the melted chocolate and press gently so they stick. Sprinkle chocolate chips. Heat remaining tablespoon of chocolate chips in the microwave and drizzle over the chocolate sheet. Place the sheet in the fridge to harden 20 minutes. Break apart and serve."]

title: Kiwi And Pineapple Parfait
ingredients: ["1 cup Plain, Fat-free Greek-style Yogurt", "2 Tablespoons Honey", "2 teaspoons Pure Vanilla Extract", "1-1/2 cup Peeled Pineapple, Cut Into Small Pieces", "6 Tablespoons Almonds Cut Into Very Small Pieces", "1-1/2 cup Peeled Kiwi, Cut Into Small Pieces"]
directions: ["Combine the Greek-style yogurt, half of the honey (save the other part for topping) and vanilla extract in a bowl.", "Layer the ingredients in each of 6 glasses in this order: yogurt mixture, pineapple, almonds, kiwi, yogurt mixture, pineapple, kiwi and almonds. Top each glass evenly with honey."]

title: Cilantro Lime Jalapeno Corn
ingredients: ["4 ears Fresh Corn", "3 Tablespoons Butter", "1 Tablespoon Cilantro, Chopped", "1 Tablespoon Jalapeno, Chopped", "1 Tablespoon Lime Juice", "1 teaspoon Pepper"]
directions: ["1. Bring a large pot of water to boil. Add corn and cook about 15 minutes.", "2. Mix remaining ingredients until evenly distributed. Refrigerate until ready to use.", "3. Spread desired amount of butter over corn. Enjoy!"]

title: Butter Toffee
ingredients: ["1 cup Pecans, Chopped, Divided", "1 cup Butter", "1 cup Brown Sugar", "2 bars (about 1.5 Oz. Size) Chocolate (like Hershey's)"]

Bring to a boil, stirring constantly to 290\u00b0F, or if you don't have a candy thermometer, boil for 12 minutes.", "Pour over the nuts, spread out to an even layer over the pecans. When set but still warm, put the chocolate bars on top and spread as the chocolate melts. Sprinkle on remaining nuts. Cut or break into small squares."]

title: Baked Bacon
ingredients: ["8 slices Thick Cut Bacon"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F.", "Line a sheet pan with aluminum foil. Place the bacon on pan and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until the", "bacon is to your desired crispness. Drain on paper towels and serve."]

title: Hez’S Pulled Pork Dry Rub
ingredients: ["4 Tablespoons Paprika", "2 Tablespoons Salt", "2 Tablespoons Granulated Sugar", "2 Tablespoons Brown Sugar", "2 Tablespoons Cumin", "2 Tablespoons Chili Powder", "2 Tablespoons Black Pepper", "2 Tablespoons Sage", "1 Tablespoon Cayenne Pepper"]
directions: ["Mix all ingredients and store in an airtight container until ready to use. When ready to use, rub generously over all surfaces of the meat.", "This makes enough to cover 2-3 large pork sholders."]

title: Mango Banana Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 cup Mango, Frozen", "1/2 whole Banana, Frozen", "1 cup Non-fat Milk"]
directions: ["Add all ingredients into a blender and process until smooth."]

title: Easy Peasy Strawberry Freezer Jam
ingredients: ["1-1/2 cup Granulated Sugar", "5 Tablespoons Instant Pectin", "4 cups Hulled And Crushed Strawberries (about 2-3 Quarts)"]
directions: ["1.\tIn a small bowl, stir together sugar and instant pectin with a fork until well combined.", "2.\tRinse the strawberries well and remove the leafy green hulls.", "3.\tCrush the strawberries in a large bowl with a potato masher, or pulse 5-6 times in the bowl of a food processor until you can measure 4 cups of crushed fruit.", "4.\tPlace the crushed strawberries in a large bowl and pour the sugar mixture over top.", "5.\tStir the sugar mixture until blended into the strawberries, then continue to stir for 3 minutes.", "6.\tLadle the jam into clean jars, leaving 3/4 inch headspace for jam expansion during freezing.", "7.\tSecure the lids onto the jars, and let jam stand for 30 minutes at room temperature, or until thickened.", "8.\tServe immediately, or refrigerate for up to three weeks, or freeze for up to 3 months."]

title: Grilled Peaches With Vanilla Mascarpone
ingredients: ["1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract, Divided", "1-1/2 Tablespoon Honey", "4 ounces, weight Mascarpone Cheese", "2 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter", "1-1/2 Tablespoon Brown Sugar", "1 teaspoon Cinnamon, Divided", "2 whole Ripe, But Firm Peaches, Halved And Pitted"]
directions: ["1. Preheat grill to medium-high heat.", "2. Stir 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract and all of the honey into your mascarpone until well blended. Set aside.", "3. Melt butter in a saucepan over a low heat and stir in brown sugar, cinnamon and remaining vanilla extract.", "4. Slice peaches in half, removing the pits. Brush butter/sugar glaze over the peaches.", "5. Place peaches cut side down on the hot grill and cook for about four minutes on each side or until tender - be sure to get those awesome grill marks on there!", "6. Transfer to a plate or platter and spoon a dollop of mascarpone into the center of each peach half. Devour!"]

title: High Antioxidant Dark Chocolate Blueberry Pistachio Bark
ingredients: ["12 ounces, weight Dark Chocolate Chips", "2/3 cups Dried Blueberries", "1/2 cups Shelled Pistachios, Coarsely Chopped"]

Add half of the dried blueberries and half of the pistachios.", "Pour the mixture onto a foil-lined cookie sheet and spread to 1/8\" thickness. Sprinkle remaining blueberries and pistachios on top. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator-the pure chocolate will melt on contact with your fingertips!"]

title: Biscoff No Bake Cookies

title: Mama’S Hot Fudge
ingredients: ["10 ounces, weight Semi-Sweet Baking Chocolate Or Chocolate Chips. I Started With A 12 Oz. Bag, But After Everyone Ate Some, It Was Probably About 10 Oz!!", "1 stick Butter", "1 cup Sugar", "1/8 teaspoons Salt", "1 cup Cream"]
directions: ["In a double boiler, melt chocolate chips.", "Add butter and melt, stirring constantly.", "Add sugar and salt and stir until dissolved.", "Add cream and cook for five minutes.", "Store in refrigerator and heat as needed-or just eat it right now-it's up to you!"]

title: Grey Poupon Dijon Mustard Salad Dressing
ingredients: ["1 teaspoon Dijon", "2 Tablespoons Wine Vinegar", "6 Tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil", "1/2 teaspoons Salt", "1/2 teaspoons Pepper", "Optional Add-ins (See Note)"]
directions: ["Blend all the ingredients together well. You can just use the base recipe or add the additions; it depends on your taste.", "Note: I usually add one or all of these additions:", "1 teaspoon soy sauce", "1 teaspoon fresh/dried parsley or dill", "1 pressed garlic glove", "1 teaspoon oregano", "1 teaspoon parmigiano cheese", "Taste and you can always adjust based on your taste. title: Mango Lassi

title: Maple Cashew Butter

We love this on all types of baked goods. Hope you enjoy!"]

title: Maple Milk

title: Citrus-Wine Poached Pears

title: Homemade Sauerkraut

title: Mini Pommes Anna

Slice potatoes as thin as you can with a knife or use a vegetable peeler to get paper thin slices.", "Place sliced potatoes in a bowl and toss with melted butter.", "Start layering slices in a circular pattern in each muffin well. Remove foil and bake for another 15 minutes until edges start to turn golden brown.", "To remove, cover the top with foil and turn the pan upside down onto foil.Transfer released mini Pommes Anna to platter and serve."]

title: Simple Roasted Fennel

directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F and line a sheet pan with foil.", "Arrange fennel rings and slices on the pan. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with fronds, salt, and pepper. Bake 25-30 minutes, or until tender and browned."]

title: Apple Vodka
ingredients: ["1 bottle (750ml Size) Vodka (Wide-Mouthed Bottle)", "1 whole Apple, Sliced"]
directions: ["Remove 1/2 cup of vodka. I'll let you decide how to dispose of it.", "Slice apple and place in the bottle; fill to capacity. Keep the skin on the apple and use as much apple with skin as possible.", "Turn bottle over (or on its side-just move it around) once a day for 6 weeks.", "Note the lovely golden color that the vodka achieves!"]

title: Cilantro & Honey Sauce
ingredients: ["8 ounces, weight Fresh Cilantro", "1/2 cups Pure Honey", "1 whole Jalapeno Pepper (remove Seeds) Chopped Super Finely"]
directions: ["In a blender (or food processor), add cilantro and pulse several times. Add honey and finely chopped jalapeno and run blender to combine.", "Refrigerate in an airtight container until ready to use. Great condiment for tacos, hamburgers, black bean burgers."]

title: Homemade Peanut Butter Cups
ingredients: ["4 ounces, weight Ghirardelli White Chocolate Chips", "1/2 cups Creamy Peanut Butter", "16 ounces, weight Lindt Milk Chocolate", "2 Tablespoons Chopped Peanuts"]
directions: ["Line two 12 cup mini muffin tins with mini muffin cups and set aside.", "Melt the white chocolate chips in a microwave safe bowl for 1 minute. Stir in peanut butter and microwave for an additional 30 seconds if needed. The mixture should only be half melted so it kind of stays together when you are layering it between the melted chocolate. Make sure to use potholders when grabbing the bowl from the microwave. My bowls were so hot I almost dropped one!", "Next, melt the milk chocolate in the microwave in 30 to 40 second intervals until creamy and smooth. Stir out all the lumps or bubbles.", "Drop the melted milk chocolate evenly along the 24 cups, reserving half of the chocolate for the top layer. Shake the pans a little to even out the first layer. Then top off cups with remaining melted milk chocolate and chopped peanuts and put into the freezer for 15 minutes. They will be perfectly formed and ready to serve!", "You can keep these little guys in an air-tight container for up to two weeks."]

title: Chocolate Truffles
ingredients: ["1 cup Heavy Cream", "1-1/2 cup 60% Bittersweet Chocolate Pistoles", "Chopped Almond, Coconut, Graham Cracker, For Topping"]
directions: ["1. In a 2-quart, heavy-bottomed saucepan, bring the cream to a light simmer over medium heat.", "2. Meanwhile, measure the chocolate and place it in a heat resistant bowl.", "3. Once the cream reaches a light simmer, pour it over the chocolate. Wait about 10 seconds for the cream to work its way into all of the crevices of the chocolate, then whisk to combine.", "4. Let the ganche cool for 10 minutes before placing in the refrigerator until chilled, about 2 hours.", "5. Meanwhile, chop toppings for truffles. Don't feel limited to almond, coconut, and graham cracker-that's all I had lying around.", "6. Using a mini ice cream scoop, scoop ganache and roll into a ball with your hands. Time to get messy.", "7. Coat truffle in topping and place in a mini cupcake liner. (A tiny bit of sea salt added to one or all of the toppings is quite nice. Just saying.) Refrigerate until serving."]

title: Frosted Grapes

directions: ["Anise vodka: Add 2 whole star anise and 1 tablespoon anise seeds to vodka.", "Caraway vodka: Add 2 tablespoons caraway seeds to vodka.", "Ginger vodka: Add 6 quarter-size slices peeled fresh ginger to vodka with 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger.", "Hot chili vodka: Halve 1 rinsed fresh habanero or other hot chili lengthwise through stem; add half the chili to vodka. Habaneros are extremely hot; if you are sensitive to heat, substitute a milder chili, such as jalapeno.", "Lemon-coriander vodka: Lightly crush 1 tablespoon coriander seeds in a mortar or with the bottom of a heavy glass and add to vodka with 1 tablespoon slivered lemon peel.", "Peppercorn vodka: Lightly crush 1 teaspoon single- or multi-colored peppercorns in a mortar or with the bottom of a heavy glass; add to vodka.", "Saffron-orange vodka: Add 1/8 teaspoon loosely packed saffron threads and 1 tablespoon slivered orange peel to vodka."]

title: Mayo-Sour Cream Dressing
ingredients: ["3/4 cup mayonnaise", "1/2 cup sour cream", "1 1/2 tablespoons Dijon mustard", "3/4 teaspoon salt", "3/4 teaspoon lemon juice", "1/4 teaspoon pepper"]
directions: ["Stir together mayonnaise, sour cream, Dijon mustard, salt, lemon juice, and pepper."]

title: Classic Limeade
ingredients: ["1 cup sugar", "1 cup fresh lime juice", "Lime slices, for garnish, optional"]
directions: ["In a small saucepan over medium heat, combine sugar and 1 cup water. Cook until sugar is dissolved, about 2 minutes. Remove syrup from heat.", "In a large pitcher, combine syrup, lime juice and 4 cups cold water. Garnish each glass with lime slices, if desired."]

title: Seasoned Shredded Chicken
ingredients: ["6 skinless, bone-in chicken breasts", "6 chicken bouillon cubes", "Salt and seasoned pepper to taste"]
directions: ["Bring chicken, water to cover, and bouillon cubes to a boil over high heat in a large saucepan. Reduce heat, and simmer 20 to 25 minutes or until chicken is done. Remove chicken from broth, and cool slightly; pull meat from bones, and shred with a fork, discarding bones. Sprinkle with salt and seasoned pepper to taste. Place in quart-size zip-top plastic freezer bags, and freeze up to 1 month. Thaw in refrigerator overnight."]

title: Brandied Sweet Potatoes
ingredients: ["2 pounds medium-size sweet potatoes", "1/2 cup firmly packed brown sugar", "3 tablespoons butter or margarine", "3 tablespoons brandy or water", "1/2 teaspoon salt"]
directions: ["Cook potatoes in boiling water to cover in a large Dutch oven 30 to 35 minutes or until tender; drain. Cool slightly; peel. Cut potatoes crosswise into 1/2-inch-thick slices.", "Cook brown sugar and next 3 ingredients in a skillet over medium heat, stirring constantly, until bubbly. Add potato, and cook, stirring gently, until glazed. Serve immediately."]

title: Bourbon Pecan Ice Cream
ingredients: ["3 1/2 cups 2% reduced-fat milk", "1 cup half-and-half", "2 teaspoons vanilla extract", "1 (14-ounce) can fat-free sweetened condensed milk", "1/2 cup chopped pecans, toasted", "3 1/2 tablespoons bourbon"]
directions: ["Combine first 4 ingredients, stirring well with a whisk. Pour mixture into the freezer can of an ice-cream freezer, and freeze according to manufacturer's instructions. Stir in pecans and bourbon. Spoon ice cream into a freezer-safe container; cover and freeze 4 hours or until almost firm."]

title: Grapefruit Brûlée
ingredients: ["2 grapefruit", "1/4 cup packed light brown sugar", "1/2 cup nonfat Greek-style yogurt"]
directions: ["With a sharp knife, cut both ends off grapefruit. Set grapefruit on end on a flat surface and, following the shape of the fruit, cut away and discard peel. Cut sections out from the fruit, leaving the membrane behind.", "Preheat broiler. Arrange grapefruit sections in 4 shallow ovenproof dishes (such as individual gratin dishes). Sprinkle with brown sugar. Broil until sugar melts and darkens, about 5 minutes (watch carefully). Serve warm, with dollops of yogurt.", "Note: Nutrition analysis is per serving."]

title: King Mackerel Steaks With Tomato-Wine Sauce
ingredients: ["6 (3/4-inch-thick) king mackerel steaks", "2 tablespoons butter or margarine, melted", "1 teaspoon salt", "1/8 teaspoon pepper", "Paprika"]
directions: ["Rinse fish thoroughly in cold water; pat dry. Place on greased rack in a broiler pan. Brush surface of each fish steak with butter, and sprinkle with salt, pepper, and paprika. Broil 5 inches from heating element 5 minutes; turn steaks, and baste with Tomato-Wine Sauce. Broil an additional 5 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve immediately with remaining sauce."]

title: Horseradish Sauce
ingredients: ["1 cup mayonnaise", "1 1/2 tablespoons prepared horseradish"]
directions: ["Stir together mayonnaise and horseradish until blended. Cover and chill up to 2 days."]

title: Zucchini Toss
ingredients: ["Sliced zucchini", "Sliced onion", "Dried thyme (to taste)", "Salt (to taste)"]
directions: ["Saute sliced zucchini and onion in olive oil. Season with dried thyme and salt to taste."]

title: Sweet And Peppery Bacon
ingredients: ["24 slices bacon", "2 to 3 Tbsp. pepper", "2 to 3 Tbsp. dark brown sugar"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F. Line a baking sheet with foil; place a baking rack on top. Mist rack with cooking spray. Arrange 12 slices of bacon on rack. Sprinkle on 1 to 1 1/2 Tbsp. pepper and dark brown sugar. Roast until bacon begins to brown, about 15 minutes. Remove sheet from oven. Place bacon on a paper towel-lined plate. Pour grease out of tray into a bowl. Repeat with 12 more slices of bacon, pepper and brown sugar. When bacon is cool, wrap in plastic wrap and chill overnight. Reheat in batches in microwave."]

title: Horseradish-Dijon Potato Salad
ingredients: ["6-8 medium potatoes (about 3 lb.)"]
directions: ["Cook 6 to 8 medium potatoes (about 3 lb.), cubed, in boiling water to cover in a Dutch oven over medium heat 15 to 18 minutes or until tender. Drain and let cool slightly. Toss with 2/3 cup Horseradish-Dijon Sauce. Serve immediately, or cover and chill until ready to serve."]

title: Maple-Candied Bacon
ingredients: ["16 pieces thick-sliced bacon (1 1/4 lb.)", "1/2 cup maple syrup"]
directions: ["Line two 10- by 15-inch baking pans with foil. Lay bacon slices side by side on foil.", "Bake in a 350\u00b0 regular or convection oven until bacon edges begin to curl, 10 to 15 minutes. Remove pan from oven. Set a rack inside pan against bacon to hold in place; tilt pan slightly and spoon off and discard fat (see notes).", "Pour syrup evenly over bacon.", "Return to oven and bake until bacon is deep golden brown, 10 to 15 minutes longer.", "With tongs or a wide spatula, lift bacon from pan and set in a single layer on a rack over paper towels. If bacon sticks to pan, return to oven just until maple glaze softens, then remove from pan immediately. Let cool until crisp, about 5 minutes.", "Young children need adult supervision when spooning fat from pan. Prepare bacon through step 3 up to 1 day ahead; cool, cover, and chill. Uncover and bake in a 350\u00b0 oven until browned, 15 to 20 minutes. Let stand at room temperature up to 1 hour."]

title: Berry Boost
ingredients: ["1/3 cup blueberries", "1/3 cup raspberries", "1/2 banana", "1/2 cup fat-free milk"]
directions: ["Blend 1/3 cup blueberries and 1/3 cup raspberries with 1/2 banana, and 1/2 cup fat-free milk.", "Smart tip: Raspberries are rich in the phytonutrient rheosmin-also known as raspberry ketone-which is said to speed up your fat metabolism."]

title: Spoiled Milk
ingredients: ["3 drops green food coloring", "8 ounces milk", "Straws"]
directions: ["Put 3 drops green food coloring in the bottom of a clear cup. Pour milk and watch it \"spoil!\""]

title: Praline Kisses
ingredients: ["1 egg white", "1 cup firmly packed brown sugar", "1 teaspoon vanilla extract", "1 1/2 cups finely chopped pecans"]
directions: ["Beat egg white (at room temperature) in a medium mixing bowl until foamy. Gradually add sugar, 1 tablespoon at a time, beating until stiff peaks form and sugar dissolves. Fold in vanilla and pecans.", "Drop by heaping teaspoonfuls 3 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake at 225\u00b0 for 1 1/2 hours. Turn oven off; cool cookies in oven at least 1 hour. (Do not open oven door.) Remove from cookie sheets, and serve immediately, or store in airtight containers."]

title: Broccoli And Cheese Potatoes
ingredients: ["2 baked potatoes", "broccoli", "4 ounce Mexican-flavored cheese spread"]
directions: ["Prepare two baked potatoes. Meanwhile, microwave broccoli in a bowl covered with plastic wrap for 2 to 3 minutes, then add 4 oz. Mexican-flavored cheese spread. Cover and microwave for 1 minute. Cut potatoes lengthwise and spoon half of broccoli mixture over each."]

title: Glazed Grilled Peaches
ingredients: ["6 firm-ripe peaches (6 oz. each)", "6 tablespoons butter or margarine", "1/4 cup sugar"]
directions: ["Rinse peaches; cut each in half and pit. In a 9- to 10-inch frying pan over medium-high heat, melt butter; add sugar and stir until well blended. Remove pan from heat, set peaches in butter mixture, and turn them to coat evenly.", "Lay peaches, cut side down, on a barbecue grill over a solid bed of medium coals or medium heat on a gas grill (you can hold your hand at grill level only 4 to 5 seconds); close lid on gas grill. Cook until peaches are hot and lightly browned on the bottom. Brush tops with more butter mixture, then turn fruit over and brush cooked sides with mixture. Cook until peaches are warm but still hold their shape, 6 to 10 minutes total."]

title: Caramel Glaze
ingredients: ["3/4 cup firmly packed light brown sugar", "6 tablespoons butter", "3 tablespoons milk", "1 teaspoon vanilla extract"]
directions: ["Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly; boil, stirring constantly, 1 minute. Remove from heat, and stir in vanilla. Stir constantly 2 minutes; use immediately."]

title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
ingredients: ["3 cups plain fat-free Greek-style yogurt (such as Fage)", "1 teaspoon vanilla extract", "4 teaspoons honey", "28 clementine segments", "1/4 cup shelled, unsalted dry-roasted chopped pistachios"]
directions: ["Combine yogurt and vanilla in a bowl. Spoon 1/3 cup yogurt mixture into each of 4 small parfait glasses; top each with 1/2 teaspoon honey, 5 clementine sections, and 1/2 tablespoon nuts.", "Top parfaits with the remaining yogurt mixture (about 1/3 cup each); top each with 1/2 teaspoon honey, 2 clementine segments, and 1/2 tablespoon nuts. Serve immediately."]

title: Pesto Mayo
ingredients: ["1/3 cup mayonnaise"]
directions: ["Stir pesto into mayonnaise. Use as a dipping sauce or sandwich spread."]

title: Curried Shrimp With Salad
ingredients: ["1 1/2 tablespoon mayonnaise", "1/2 teaspoon curry powder", "1 celery (large)", "1 teaspoon black pepper", "7 ounce fresh or frozen medium-sized shrimp", "1/3 tablespoon fresh lemon juice"]
directions: ["Wash and chop celery. If using fresh shrimp, peel and clean; if using cooked frozen, rinse and pat dry. For fresh shrimp, cook in a pot of boiling water and cook until shrimp turns bright pink, about 3-4 minutes. In a medium mixing bowl, combine shrimp, chopped celery, black pepper, lemon juice, mayonnaise, and curry powder. If desired, cover and chill in the refrigerator ~1 hour, to allow flavors to blend. Serve over salad greens."]

title: Roast Salmon With Tomatoes And Tarragon
ingredients: ["4 (6-ounce) salmon fillets (about 1 1/2 inches thick)", "1/4 teaspoon salt", "1/4 teaspoon black pepper", "1 1/2 cups chopped seeded peeled tomato (about 1 pound)", "2 teaspoons low-sodium soy sauce", "2 1/2 teaspoons coarsely chopped fresh or 3/4 teaspoon dried tarragon", "2 teaspoons Dijon mustard", "Tarragon sprigs (optional)"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 425\u00b0.", "Sprinkle salmon fillets with salt and pepper. Place the fillets, skin sides up, in a large skillet or small roasting pan. Spoon chopped tomato around fillets, and drizzle fillets with soy sauce. Wrap handle of skillet with foil, and bake the fillets at 425\u00b0 for 12 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Remove skin from fillets, and discard skin. Remove fillets from pan, and keep warm. Add the chopped tarragon and mustard to tomato, stirring well. Spoon tomato mixture over fillets. Garnish with tarragon sprigs, if desired."]

title: Smoked Salmon Spread
ingredients: ["1 1/2 cups cottage cheese", "8 ounces smoked salmon", "2 tablespoons dry white wine (optional)", "2 tablespoons lemon juice", "2 teaspoons Dijon mustard", "2 tablespoons chopped fresh dill", "Salt and pepper"]
directions: ["Line a strainer with cheesecloth and set over a bowl. Place cottage cheese in strainer, cover, and chill at least 8 hours or up to 1 day. Discard liquid.", "Finely dice about a third of the salmon; coarsely chop remainder. In a blender or food processor, whirl drained cottage cheese, coarsely chopped salmon, wine, lemon juice, and mustard until smooth. Stir in diced salmon, dill, and salt and pepper to taste.", "Spoon mixture into a bowl, cover, and chill at least 4 hours or up to 2 days."]

title: Apricot-Ginger Salmon
ingredients: ["8 (6-oz.) salmon fillets", "1/2 teaspoon salt", "1/2 teaspoon pepper"]
directions: ["Sprinkle fillets evenly with salt and pepper. Cook, skin sides up, in a lightly greased, large, ovenproof nonstick skillet over medium-high heat 2 minutes; turn and cook 2 more minutes. Pour Apricot-Ginger Sauce over salmon.", "Bake at 350\u00b0 for 4 to 6 minutes or until a sharp knife is warm to the touch when inserted into center of fillet and removed. Remove from oven, and let stand 2 minutes."]

title: Asparagus
ingredients: ["1 pound asparagus, trimmed and cut into 1 1/2-inch pieces"]
directions: ["Place asparagus in a vegetable steamer. Steam, covered, 9 minutes or until very tender. Remove asparagus from steamer, reserving cooking liquid.", "Place asparagus in a food processor; process until smooth, adding cooking liquid, 1 tablespoon at a time, to reach desired consistency. Strain using a sieve or food mill, if needed; discard solids.", "Maintaining Nutrients You may notice that most of the purees call for steaming rather than boiling. That's because the less water the vegetable or fruit comes in contact with, the more vitamins and minerals the food retains. Some nutrients still leach into the water when you steam, which is why we recommend saving and using the cooking liquid to help smooth and thin your purees.", "Easy Freezing This recipe is based on 1/4-cup serving sizes. If you freeze batches in ice-cube trays, one cube usually holds 2 tablespoons. We recommend defrosting just one cube when baby is new to solid food. Later on when baby has started eating more, defrost two to four cubes (2 to 4 ounces or 1/4 to 1/2 cup).", "Freezes well"]

title: Pickled Salsify
ingredients: ["1 pound salsify, scraped and cut into 2-inch pieces", "1/3 cup firmly packed brown sugar", "3 tablespoons vinegar", "1 tablespoon butter or margarine", "1/2 teaspoon salt", "1/4 teaspoon pepper"]
directions: ["Cook salsify in a small amount of salted boiling water 10 minutes or until tender; drain well. Set aside.", "Combine sugar, vinegar, butter, salt, and pepper in a medium saucepan. Add salsify; cook over low heat 30 minutes or until thickened, stirring occasionally."]

title: Corn-On-The-Cob
ingredients: ["14 ears of fresh corn, husks and silks removed", "1 tablespoon salt", "1/2 cup butter or margarine, melted", "1 tablespoon lemon juice"]
directions: ["Place ears of corn in a Dutch oven; cover with cold water. Add salt; bring to a boil. Cover and cook over medium heat 20 minutes or until tender. Drain well.", "Combine butter and lemon juice; stir well. Pour butter mixture over corn before serving."]

title: Smoked Turkey Rolls
ingredients: ["24 thin slices smoked turkey", "1 (8-ounce) package cream cheese, softened", "Watercress", "Paprika"]
directions: ["Spread each slice of turkey with about 2 teaspoons cream cheese. Roll each slice lengthwise, jellyroll fashion. Cut each roll in half, and pierce with wooden pick to hold, if necessary. Tuck watercress into one end of each roll. Sprinkle with paprika."]

title: Pasta With Tomato, Sausage And White Wine Sauce
ingredients: ["1 pound pasta, such as spaghetti", "1 tablespoon olive oil", "1/2 pound Italian sausage (removed from casings)", "1/2 cup dry white wine", "1 24- to 26- ounce jar marinara sauce"]
directions: ["Cook pasta according to the package directions.", "Meanwhile, heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sausage and cook, breaking it up, until browned, 6 to 8 minutes. Add wine and cook for 3 minutes. Add the sauce and cook until heated through, 2 to 3 minutes. Serve over the pasta."]

title: Citrus-Lemongrass Vodka
ingredients: ["6 (3-in.-long) lemon peel strips", "6 (3-in.-long) lime peel strips", "1 lemongrass stalk (smashed and roughly chopped)", "2 cups (16 oz.) vodka"]
directions: ["Place lemon peel strips, lime peel strips, and lemongrass stalk in a clean, dry glass jar. Pour vodka into jar. Cover and store at room temperature 8 hours or overnight. Pour mixture through a fine wire-mesh strainer into a clean glass jar; discard solids. Cover and store in refrigerator up to 2 weeks."]

title: Broiled Chicken Deluxe
ingredients: ["1 (3- to 3 1/2-pound) broiler-fryer, split", "1 lemon, halved", "2 teaspoons salt", "1/4 teaspoon pepper", "1/2 teaspoon paprika", "1/2 cup butter or margarine, melted and divided", "2 teaspoons sugar"]
directions: ["Place chicken, breast side up, in a shallow roasting pan. Rub entire surface of chicken halves with lemon, squeezing out juice occasionally. Combine salt, pepper, and paprika; sprinkle over chicken. Brush chicken with 1/4 cup butter; sprinkle with sugar. Bake, uncovered, at 450\u00b0 for 10 minutes. Baste with remaining butter. Reduce heat to 350\u00b0; cover and bake an additional 35 minutes or until tender."]

title: Ghee
ingredients: ["1/2 cup butter"]
directions: ["Place butter in a medium saucepan over medium-low heat. Cook 20 minutes or until solids have turned a nut brown, stirring occasionally. Skim solids from surface of melted butter; discard solids. Slowly pour remaining butter out of pan, leaving remaining solids in pan; discard solids."]

title: Simple Syrup
ingredients: ["1 cup sugar"]
directions: ["Bring sugar and 1 cup water to a boil in a small saucepan. Stir constantly about 1 minute or until sugar dissolves. Remove from heat, and let cool to room temperature, about 15 minutes."]

title: Spicy Grilled Corn
ingredients: ["1/2 cup butter, softened", "1/2 cup mayonnaise", "1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper", "1/4 teaspoon salt", "8 ears fresh corn, shucked"]
directions: ["Combine first 4 ingredients in a bowl. Spread about 1 1/2 tablespoons butter mixture on each ear of corn, and wrap each ear in heavy-duty aluminum foil.", "Grill corn over high heat (400\u00b0 to 500\u00b0) 20 minutes, turning frequently."]

title: Blueberry And Yogurt Soup With Lime Swirl
ingredients: ["4 cups blueberries", "1/4 cup honey", "1/2 teaspoon cinnamon", "2 tablespoons plus 1 3/4 cups plain Greek yogurt (not nonfat)", "Juice and zest of 1 medium lime", "2 teaspoons sugar"]
directions: ["Reserve a few small blueberries for garnish. Place remaining berries in a large saucepan and pour in 1/2 cup water. Stir in honey and cinnamon. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat, about 5 minutes. Cook, stirring occasionally, just until berries start to soften and give off liquid, about 2 minutes. Transfer to a bowl and let cool slightly. Puree blueberry mixture in a blender until smooth. Transfer to a large bowl, cover and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled, at least 2 hours.", "Combine 2 Tbsp. yogurt, lime juice, lime zest and sugar in a small bowl. Stir to blend, cover and refrigerate until ready to serve soup.", "Just before serving, whisk remaining 1 3/4 cups yogurt into blueberry mixture. Ladle soup into chilled bowls. Drop 2 tsp. of lime-yogurt mixture into center of each bowl. Use tip of a sharp knife to make decorative swirls. Garnish with reserved berries and serve cold.", "MyRecipes is working with Let's Move!, the Partnership for a Healthier America, and USDA's MyPlate to give anyone looking for healthier options access to a trove of recipes that will help them create healthy, tasty plates. For more information about creating a healthy plate, visit", "."]

title: Turnip-Bacon Turnovers
ingredients: ["1 small turnip, peeled and grated", "1/2 small onion, finely chopped", "4 to 5 pieces finely chopped, cooked bacon", "1/4 teaspoon salt", "1/4 teaspoon pepper", "1 (15-ounce) package refrigerated piecrusts", "2 tablespoons butter, melted"]
directions: ["Combine turnip, onion, and bacon in a small bowl. Toss with salt and pepper.", "Unfold piecrusts, and press out fold lines. Cut out 30 rounds with a 2-inch round cutter.", "Place 1 teaspoon turnip mixture on half of each round, and fold the other half over. Press edges together with a fork to seal. Place on an ungreased baking sheet; brush tops with melted butter.", "Bake at 375\u00b0 for 15 to 17 minutes or until edges are lightly browned."]

title: Pineapple-Berry Ice Pops
ingredients: ["2 cups fresh or frozen pineapple cubes", "1/4 cup unsweetened pineapple juice or apple juice", "1 tablespoon honey", "1 cup fresh or frozen blueberries"]
directions: ["Combine first 3 ingredients in a blender, and process until smooth. Pour mixture evenly into 6 (3-ounce) ice pop molds, leaving about 1 to 2 tablespoons puree in blender.", "Add blueberries to blender with reserved puree. Process until well blended; pour over pineapple mixture in ice pop molds. Insert wooden sticks, and cover if necessary to hold wooden sticks upright. Freeze 4 hours or until firm."]

title: Fresh Asparagus In Bacon Rings
ingredients: ["4 slices bacon", "1 pound fresh asparagus spears, cleaned and cooked", "2 tablespoons butter or margarine, melted", "Salt and pepper to taste"]
directions: ["Invert a large muffin pan, and place bacon slices around the outside of 4 individual muffin cups. Secure ends of bacon with wooden picks.", "Place inverted muffin pan with bacon on upper shelf of oven. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 15 minutes or until bacon is crisp. Remove from oven, and carefully remove bacon rings from muffin cups. Remove wooden picks.", "Gently slide 5 to 6 cooked asparagus spears inside each bacon ring. Pour a small amount of melted butter over each serving, and season with salt and pepper. Serve immediately."]

title: Raspberry Chambord Caramel Sauce
ingredients: ["1 cup sugar", "1 cup raspberries, divided", "1/4 cup Chambord liqueur", "1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice"]
directions: ["In a medium saucepan, combine sugar and 1/2 cup water. Boil over high heat (don't stir) until a spot starts to turn brown, about 8 minutes.", "Turn off heat and add 1/2 cup raspberries, Chambord, and lemon juice. Stir until well combined, then add another 1/2 cup raspberries."]

title: Baked Ziti With Italian Sausage
ingredients: ["1 (16-oz.) package ziti pasta", "1 cup (4 oz.) shredded part-skim mozzarella cheese"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0. Prepare pasta according to package directions. Stir together pasta, Spicy Tomato Sauce With Italian Sausage, and 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese. Spoon mixture into a lightly greased 11- x 7-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with remaining 1/2 cup cheese. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese is melted. Let stand 10 minutes before serving."]

title: Broiled Salmon With Sweet-And-Sour Cucumbers
ingredients: ["2 tablespoons Dijon mustard", "1 tablespoon brown sugar", "1/2 teaspoon salt", "8 (6-ounce) salmon fillets (about 1 inch thick)", "Cooking spray"]
directions: ["Prepare broiler.", "Combine the first 3 ingredients. Brush mustard mixture over fillets. Place fillets, skin sides down, on a broiler rack coated with cooking spray; broil 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. Serve fish with Sweet-and-Sour Cucumbers.", "(Totals include Sweet-and-Sour Cucumbers)"]

title: Mango & Lime
ingredients: ["2/3 cup chopped mango", "1 lime"]
directions: ["Squeeze lime over 2/3 cup chopped mango. Garnish with lime zest for added flavor."]

title: Broiled Rib Eyes
ingredients: ["6 (3/4-pound) rib eyes, 1 inch thick", "Salt and pepper to taste"]
directions: ["Place rib eyes on a well greased rack in a shallow roasting pan. Broil 5 to 6 inches from heating element 8 to 10 minutes on each side or until desired degree of doneness. Transfer rib eyes to a warm serving platter, and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste. Serve immediately."]

title: Caramel Glaze
ingredients: ["1 cup firmly packed light brown sugar", "1/2 cup butter", "1/4 cup milk", "1 teaspoon vanilla extract"]
directions: ["Bring brown sugar, butter, and milk to a boil in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly; boil, stirring constantly, 1 minute. Remove from heat, and stir in vanilla extract. Stir 2 minutes; use immediately."]

title: Cranberry- Orange Sauce
ingredients: ["1 cup sugar", "1 1/4 cups orange juice", "grated zest of 1 orange", "1 teaspoon cinnamon (optional)", "12 ounces fresh cranberries"]
directions: ["In a saucepan, combine 1 cup sugar, 1 1/4 cups orange juice, grated zest of 1 orange and, if desired, 1 tsp. cinnamon. Warm until sugar dissolves. Add 12 oz. fresh cranberries and bring to a boil. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes. Cool, cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Serves"]

title: Iceberg Lettuce-Wedge Salad
ingredients: ["2 heads (1 1/4 to 1 1/2 lb. each) iceberg lettuce, rinsed and crisped", "Salt and pepper"]
directions: ["Trim and discard stem ends and bruised leaves from lettuce; cut lettuce, through core, into 8 to 10 equal wedges. Lay each wedge on a salad plate. Add salad dressing and salt and pepper to taste."]

title: Yogurt Sauce
ingredients: ["1 (6-ounce) container plain yogurt", "1/3 cup mayonnaise", "1 tablespoon dijon mustard", "1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce", "Salt and pepper to taste", "Sugar to taste"]
directions: ["Whisk together yogurt and next 3 ingredients; add salt, pepper, and sugar to taste."]

title: Peach Iced Tea
ingredients: ["1 (46-oz.) bottle peach nectar", "2 tablespoons lemon juice"]
directions: ["Prepare Southern Sweet Tea using 1/2 cup sugar. Stir together 1 1/2 qt. tea, peach nectar, and lemon juice. Serve over ice."]

title: Peaches
ingredients: ["4 ripe peaches (about 1 1/2 pounds), peeled, halved, and pitted"]
directions: ["Place peaches in a vegetable steamer. Steam, covered, 6 minutes or until tender.", "Place peaches in a food processor; process until smooth.", "Kitchen Tip The riper the fruit, the less steaming time it takes to soften the flesh, so use the lower end of the cook time range."]

title: Berries And Beets Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 cup blueberries", "1/2 cup fresh or frozen unsweetened raspberries", "1/3 cup sliced, cooked beets", "1/4 cup plain fat-free Greek yogurt", "1/4 cup fresh orange juice", "1 teaspoon honey"]
directions: ["Place all ingredients in a blender; process until smooth."]

title: Coconut Syrup
ingredients: ["1 (13.5-oz.) can coconut milk, well shaken", "1 cup granulated sugar"]
directions: ["Whisk together coconut milk and sugar in a medium saucepan. Bring to a simmer over medium-high; cook, whisking often, until sugar is dissolved and mixture is emulsified, about 3 minutes. Remove from heat; cool completely, about 30 minutes. Store in an airtight container in refrigerator up to 2 weeks."]

title: Cottage Cheese And Fruit
ingredients: ["1/2 cup cottage cheese"]
directions: ["Combine all ingredients in a small bowl, stirring well. For a smoother texture, place all ingredients in a food processor, and process until desired consistency."]

title: Tea Vodka
ingredients: ["12 ounces vodka", "1 bag English Breakfast tea"]
directions: ["In a jar, combine the vodka with the English Breakfast tea bag. Let stand at room temperature for 2 hours, then discard the tea bag."]

title: Fresh Pineapple Vodka
ingredients: ["1 pound pineapple slices", "1 1/2 cups vodka"]
directions: ["Put pineapple slices into a 1-qt. jar. Pour in vodka, cover, and chill at least 5 days and up to 3 weeks."]

title: French Onion Dip
ingredients: ["1 container (16 oz.) sour cream", "1/2 cup Hellmann's(R) or Best Foods(R) Real Mayonnaise", "1 package Knorr(R) French Onion recipe mix"]
directions: ["Combine all ingredients in medium bowl. Chill, if desired.", "Serve with your favorite dippers."]

title: Honey-Glazed Shrimp
ingredients: ["1/3 cup soy sauce", "1/4 cup honey", "1/4 cup frozen orange juice concentrate", "2 pounds large shrimp, peeled and deveined"]
directions: ["Combine first 3 ingredients in a small bowl; set aside one-half of glaze. Brush shrimp with remaining glaze.", "Grill shrimp over medium-high heat 3 to 4 minutes or until done. Brush with reserved glaze, and serve immediately with sauces."]

title: Spaghetti And Italian Meatballs
ingredients: ["1 egg, lightly beaten", "1/3 cup dry bread crumbs", "1/4 cup KRAFT Grated Parmesan Cheese", "1/4 cup milk", "1/4 cup onion, finely chopped", "1 package (19 ounce) JOHNSONVILLE(R) Ground Mild Italian Sausage or Links removed from casing*(*Cut sausage link end to end, about three-quarters of the way through. Flip sausage link over, grasp casing and pull off.)"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F.", "In a large bowl, combine the egg, bread crumbs, KRAFT Grated Parmesan cheese, milk and onion.", "Remove sausage from casings.", "Add sausage to the bread crumb mixture and mix well.", "Shape into 20 meatballs; arrange on a shallow baking pan.", "Bake for 20 minutes or until meatballs are cooked through (160\u00b0F).", "Serve with your favorite sauce and spaghetti."]

title: Infused Sake
ingredients: ["1 bottle (750 ml.) sake", "1 cup sliced peeled fresh pineapple", "or", "1 cup sliced peeled, pitted firm-ripe mango"]
directions: ["In a 4- to 6-cup widemouthed jar, combine sake and pineapple or mango. Cover and chill until sake has a subtle fruit flavor, about 5 days. Lift out fruit with a slotted spoon and discard. Serve cold--the sooner, the better. Leftover sake (without fruit) will keep up to 1 week when stored airtight in the refrigerator."]

title: Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: ["8 (1-ounce) squares unsweetened chocolate", "1 (13-ounce) can evaporated milk", "2 cups sugar", "2 tablespoons strong coffee", "1 teaspoon vanilla extract", "Dash of salt"]
directions: ["Place chocolate in top of a double boiler; place over boiling water, and cook, stirring constantly, until chocolate melts. Add milk, sugar, coffee, vanilla, and salt, stirring until well blended. Cook over boiling water, stirring constantly with a wire whisk, until mixture is thoroughly heated and smooth. Remove from heat. Serve sauce warm or chilled over ice cream."]

title: Sweet-And-Sour Beets
ingredients: ["1/2 pound beets, cleaned and boiled", "2 cups vinegar", "1 cup sugar", "3/4 teaspoon salt"]
directions: ["Cut beets into 1/4-inch-thick slices; set aside.", "Combine vinegar, sugar, and salt in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Add beets and cover. Reduce heat; simmer 10 minutes. Remove from heat; cover and chill."]

title: Coffee Syrup
ingredients: ["1 cup brewed coffee", "2 cups sugar"]
directions: ["Combine both ingredients in a heavy saucepan; cook over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves. Bring to a boil, without stirring; boil 2 minutes. Remove from heat; cool to room temperature. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator."]

title: Pecan Filling
ingredients: ["3/4 cup firmly packed brown sugar", "1/2 cup chopped pecans, toasted", "1 large egg, lightly beaten", "1 tablespoon butter, melted", "1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract", "1/8 teaspoon salt"]
directions: ["Whisk together all ingredients until well blended."]

title: Broccoli
ingredients: ["1 (1 3/4-pound) bunch broccoli"]
directions: ["Cut broccoli stalk into 1-inch pieces; separate head into small florets. Place stalk and florets in a vegetable steamer. Steam, covered, 14 minutes or until very tender. Remove broccoli from steamer, reserving cooking liquid.", "Place broccoli in a food processor; process until smooth, adding cooking liquid, 1 tablespoon at a time, to reach desired consistency. Strain using a sieve or food mill, if needed; discard solids.", "Maintaining Nutrients", "You may notice that most of the purees call for steaming rather than boiling. That's because the less water the vegetable or fruit comes in contact with, the more vitamins and minerals the food retains. Some nutrients still leach into the water when you steam, which is why we recommend saving and using the cooking liquid to help smooth and thin your purees."]

title: Grandma Lori'S Mamalade Glazed Ham
ingredients: ["1 (8 to 10) pound fully cooked spiral sliced ham", "1 (18 oz.) jar Smucker's(R) Sweet Orange Marmalade", "3/4 cup firmly packed brown sugar"]
directions: ["1 HEAT ham according to package directions.", "2 COMBINE orange marmalade and brown sugar in small bowl until blended. Remove ham from oven 30 minutes before end of suggested bake time. Brush glaze over ham.", "3 BAKE an additional 30 minutes. Remove ham from oven and let rest 5-10 minutes. Spoon pan juices over ham and serve.", "TIP For a thicker sauce to serve with baked ham: Drain pan juices into a small saucepan. Heat to boiling; reduce to medium heat. Stir 3 tablespoons cornstarch into 3 tablespoons cold water until smooth. Blend into pan juices, stirring constantly until thickened. Spoon warm sauce over ham and serve."]

title: Citrus Vinaigrette Grilled Chicken
ingredients: ["8 bone-in chicken breasts"]
directions: ["Reserve 1/2 cup Citrus Vinaigrette (cover and chill up to 5 days). Place 1 cup Citrus Vinaigrette in a large zip-top plastic freezer bag; add half of chicken, turning to coat. Repeat procedure with remaining vinaigrette and chicken. Seal bags, and chill at least 2 hours or up to 24 hours.", "Light one side of grill, heating to 400\u00b0 to 500\u00b0 (high); leave other side unlit. Remove chicken from marinade, discarding marinade. Arrange chicken, skin sides up, over unlit side, and grill, covered with grill lid, 1 hour or until a meat thermometer inserted into thickest portion registers 170\u00b0. Let stand 15 minutes before serving. Serve half of chicken immediately. Cover and chill remaining chicken 2 to 3 days.", "Direct Heat Cooking Times: To cook chicken directly over heat, reduce heat to 350\u00b0 to 400\u00b0 (medium-high) heat, and grill, covered with grill lid, 28 minutes or until a meat thermometer inserted into thickest portion registers 170\u00b0, turning every 7 minutes. Let chicken stand 15 minutes before serving."]

title: Honey Taffy
ingredients: ["Cooking spray", "1 pound honey (about 1 1/2 cups)"]
directions: ["Line a baking sheet with parchment paper; lightly coat with cooking spray.", "Place honey in a medium saucepan. Cook over medium-low heat, uncovered, until honey begins to boil (about 8 minutes). Continue cooking until a candy thermometer registers 280\u00b0, about 10 minutes. Quickly pour mixture onto prepared pan, spreading evenly. Cool 20 minutes.", "Lightly spray your hands with cooking spray. Using your hands, fold the honey over itself to form a ball. Stretch honey into a long strand (about 2 feet long). Double strand back onto itself twice, pressing ends together. Continue pulling and folding honey for about 5 minutes or until the color changes from dark amber to a soft tan. Wrap in plastic wrap coated with cooking spray, and chill for 10 minutes.", "Coat a knife with cooking spray, and cut the taffy into 4 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a 12-inch log. Cut each log into 6 pieces. Roll each piece into a log, and wrap each piece in confectionary paper, cellophane wrappers, or wax paper."]

title: Brownie Buttons
ingredients: ["1 (16.5-oz.) refrigerated roll triple chocolate chunk brownie batter (we tested with Pillsbury)", "1 bag of assorted miniature peanut butter cup candies and chocolate-coated caramels (we tested with Rolos)"]
directions: ["Spray miniature (1 3/4\") muffin pans with cooking spray, or line pans with paper liners and spray liners with cooking spray. Spoon brownie batter evenly into each cup, filling almost full. Bake at 350\u00b0 for 19 to 20 minutes. Cool in pans 3 to 4 minutes, and then gently press a miniature candy into each baked brownie until the top of candy is level with top of brownie. Cool 10 minutes in pans. Gently twist each brownie to remove from pan. Cool on a wire rack."]

title: Pesto Butter
ingredients: ["2 tablespoons pesto", "1/2 cup butter, softened"]
directions: ["Stir pesto into butter; cover and chill 8 hours. Serve on chicken breasts, baked potatoes, assorted steamed vegetables, or pasta."]

title: Our Favorite Roast Chicken
ingredients: ["1 chicken (6 to 8 lb.)", "Salt and pepper"]
directions: ["Remove giblets from chicken and reserve for other uses. Pull off and discard lumps of fat. Rinse bird well inside and out; pat dry.", "Sprinkle chicken lightly with salt and pepper. If desired, fold wing tips under first joint. Set bird breast up on a V-shaped rack in an 11- by 17-inch pan.", "Roast in a 425\u00b0 regular or convection oven until a thermometer inserted through thickest part of breast to bone reaches 170\u00b0, or 180\u00b0 through thickest part of thigh at joint, 1 1/4 to 1 3/4 hours. If drippings start to smoke, tilt pan, skim fat and discard; then add about 1/4 cup water.", "Insert a carving fork into body cavity, piercing carcass; lift bird and tilt to drain juices into pan. Set chicken on a rimmed platter and let rest in a warm place about 15 minutes.", "Meanwhile, skim and discard fat from pan. Stir juices to release browned bits and pour through a fine strainer, if desired, into a small bowl. Carve chicken and serve with juices. Add salt and pepper to taste."]

title: Creamy 100-Calorie Iced Coffee
ingredients: ["2 1/2 cups hot espresso or strong brewed coffee", "2 cups 1% low-fat milk", "3 tablespoons sugar", "1 teaspoon vanilla extract"]
directions: ["Whisk together all ingredients in a medium saucepan over medium heat, and cook, whisking occasionally, 10 minutes or until steamy.", "Let cool completely (about 20 minutes). Pour 1 1/2 cups coffee mixture into compartments of 1 ice cube tray, and freeze 4 hours or until firm. Chill remaining coffee mixture until ready to serve. Place coffee ice cubes in a pitcher, and pour remaining coffee mixture over ice cubes. Serve immediately."]

title: Cheese Twists
ingredients: ["1 1/2 cups grated Parmesan cheese", "2 teaspoons paprika", "1/4 teaspoon cayenne pepper, or to taste", "1 large egg, beaten with 1 tablespoon water", "Salt, to taste"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0. Combine first 3 ingredients in a medium bowl. Divide Faux Puff Pastry dough in half. Roll 1 half into a 12- x 24-inch rectangle, 1/8 inch thick; brush surface with some of the egg mixture. Sprinkle half of Parmesan mixture evenly over half of the rectangle. Fold other side over to make a 12-inch square. Roll lengthwise until the 2 halves stick together. (You should have a 12- x 13-inch rectangle.) Repeat process with remaining half of dough.", "Cut rectangles crosswise, using a pizza cutter or sharp knife, into 3/4-inch-wide x 12-inch-long strips. Twist ends of each strip in opposite directions to make a spiral. Place twists on a lightly greased or parchment-lined baking sheet. Brush tops lightly with egg mixture, then sprinkle with salt. Bake twists at 400\u00b0 for 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown. Cool on wire rack."]

title: Eleanor'S Macaroni And Cheese
ingredients: ["2 cups cottage cheese", "1 (8-ounce) container sour cream", "1 large egg", "3/4 teaspoon salt", "1/2 teaspoon pepper", "2 cups (8 ounces) shredded sharp Cheddar cheese", "1 (8-ounce) package macaroni, cooked", "Paprika"]
directions: ["Stir together first 6 ingredients in a large bowl; stir in macaroni. Spoon mixture into a lightly greased 2-quart baking dish, and sprinkle with paprika.", "Bake at 350\u00b0 for 45 minutes, and let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving."]

title: Braised Chestnuts
ingredients: ["2 tablespoons butter or margarine", "1 medium onion, finely chopped", "1 cup dry red wine or port", "3 cups chicken broth", "1 pound whole chestnuts, shelled (about 2 1/2 to 3 cups nut meat)", "1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme", "1/8 teaspoon salt", "1/4 teaspoon pepper"]
directions: ["Melt butter in a Dutch oven over medium heat; add onion, and saute 10 minutes or until tender and slightly browned. Add wine, and bring to a boil; cook, stirring occasionally, 1 minute. Add broth and remaining ingredients; reduce heat to medium-low, cover, and simmer 1 hour or until chestnuts are tender and liquid is almost absorbed."]

title: Turkey Sandwiches With Cranberry Salsa
ingredients: ["1 pound thinly sliced smoked turkey", "Lettuce leaves"]
directions: ["Cut Corn Light Bread into 12 slices.", "Broil bread slices on an ungreased baking sheet 5 1/2 inches from heat for 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until lightly toasted.", "Spoon 1/4 cup Cranberry Salsa on one side of 6 bread slices, reserving remaining Cranberry Salsa for other uses. Layer evenly with turkey and lettuce. Top with remaining bread slices.", "* Substitute your favorite bread for Corn Light Bread"]

title: Gorgonzola Cream
ingredients: ["2 tablespoons butter", "1 cup half-and-half", "1/2 cup crumbled Gorgonzola cheese"]
directions: ["Melt butter in a small skillet over low heat; stir in half-and-half and crumbled Gorgonzola cheese, stirring until cheese is melted."]

title: How To Prepare Fresh Beets
ingredients: ["1 1/2 pounds small beets"]
directions: ["To Clean and Boil: Leave root and 1 inch of stem on beets; scrub with a brush. Place beets in a medium saucepan with water to cover. Bring to a boil. Trim off beet stems and roots; rub off skins.", "Note: Care should be taken not to cut the stem too close to the beet or break off the roots. title: Blueberry Blender
ingredients: ["3 cups fresh orange juice", "1/4 cup honey", "1 pint fresh or frozen blueberries", "1 medium cucumber, quartered"]
directions: ["Combine all ingredients in a blender; process until smooth. Cover and chill 8 hours or overnight. Strain the mixture through a cheesecloth-lined sieve into a medium bowl, pressing solids with a wooden spoon or a rubber spatula to squeeze out juice; discard solids."]

title: Cucumber-Dill Sauce
ingredients: ["1 (8-ounce) carton plain yogurt", "1/3 cup mayonnaise or salad dressing", "1/2 cup chopped unpeeled cucumber", "1/4 teaspoon salt", "1/4 teaspoon dried dillweed"]
directions: ["Combine all ingredients, stirring well. Cover and chill."]

title: Praline Sauce
ingredients: ["1 cup firmly packed brown sugar", "1/2 cup half-and-half", "1/2 cup butter", "1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract"]
directions: ["Bring first 3 ingredients to a boil in a small saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly. Cook, stirring constantly, 1 minute. Remove from heat, and stir in vanilla; cool slightly (about 10 minutes). Serve warm.", "Make 3 days ahead; cover, chill, then reheat over low heat."]

title: Raisin Penuche

directions: ["Combine sugar, milk, and butter in a medium Dutch oven. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sugar dissolves. title: Grilled Apricots With Mustard-Tarragon Glaze
ingredients: ["2 pounds firm-ripe apricots, halved and pitted", "3 tablespoons honey", "2 tablespoons Dijon mustard", "2 teaspoons minced fresh tarragon leaves"]
directions: ["Thread apricot halves onto 2 parallel 6- to 12-inch-long slender metal skewers (you will need several pairs).", "Mix honey, mustard, and tarragon. Cook to brown other side, about 2 more minutes.", "Push fruit from skewers onto a platter."]

title: Chocolate Sauce
ingredients: ["2 (0.78-oz.) dark chocolate bars, broken into pieces", "1/4 cup 1% low-fat milk"]
directions: ["Microwave chocolate and milk in a small microwave-safe bowl at HIGH 30 to 45 seconds or until chocolate is melted. Stir until mixture is smooth.", "Note: For testing purposes only, we used CocoaVia Original Chocolate Bars."]

ingredients: ["1 cup firmly packed brown sugar", "1 cup chopped walnuts", "1 cup sweetened flaked coconut", "1/2 cup butter, softened", "1/3 cup milk"]

title: Stove-Top Pork Barbecue

title: Basil Puree

Strain skimmed butter through a fine wire-mesh sieve lined with cheesecloth, discarding any solids."]

title: Creamy Lemon-Garlic Dressing
ingredients: ["1/4 cup buttermilk", "Pinch of salt"]
directions: ["Stir together all ingredients."]

title: Orange Sorbet
ingredients: ["1 large orange", "1/4 cup unsweetened orange juice", "1 tablespoon sugar"]
directions: ["Cut orange in half crosswise; remove and discard seeds. Clip membrane, and carefully remove pulp. Set pulp aside. Drain orange shells upside down on paper towels.", "Position knife blade in food processor bowl; add orange pulp. Process until smooth. Pour puree into a wire-mesh strainer; press with back of spoon against the sides of the strainer to squeeze out juice. Discard pulp remaining in strainer. Cover and freeze at least 8 hours or until firm.", "Position knife blade in food processor bowl; add frozen orange mixture. Process until smooth but not thawed. To serve, scoop into 2 dessert dishes or into orange shells, if desired. Serve immediately."]

title: Clarified Butter Sauce
ingredients: ["1 cup butter", "1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon Dijon mustard", "Juice of 1 lemon"]
directions: ["Melt butter over low heat in a 1-quart saucepan. The fat will rise to the top, and the milk solids will sink to the bottom. Remove from heat. Skim the white froth off the top. Strain off the clear yellow butter, keeping back the sediment of milk solids. Discard the milk solids. Combine the clarified butter, mustard, and lemon juice, mixing well."]

title: Maple Glaze

title: Simple Baked Rutabaga Fries

title: Slow Cooker Dulce De Leche

directions: ["Remove the label from the canned sweetened condensed milk and place the can on its side in a slow cooker. Pour Jam into jars and seal.", "**I have substituted sugar for Splenda and used sugar free Strawberry Jello and jam still turns out yummy!"]

title: Mashed Sweet Potato With Lime
ingredients: ["2 whole Medium Sweet Potatoes", "3 Tablespoons Butter, Melted", "2 Tablespoons Lime Juice", "1/2 Lime, Zested", "2 Tablespoons Maple Syrup", "1 pinch Salt"]
directions: ["Set the oven to 350\u00b0F. Wash and dry the sweet potatoes and prick each of them with a knife. Place the sweet potatoes on a baking sheet and bake for at least 1 hour, until they are softened.", "Peel the potatoes and add the flesh to a food processor or mixer bowl. Add butter, lime juice, lime zest, maple syrup and salt to the bowl. Pulse or whip the mixture to mash the potatoes and combine all the ingredients."]

title: Grilled Pineapple
ingredients: ["1 teaspoon Cinnamon", "3 Tablespoons Granulated Sugar", "1 Fresh Pineapple, Ripe But Not Too Soft, Cored If Preferred"]
directions: ["Preheat a grill to medium heat, then lower it to low heat.", "Mix the cinnamon and sugar together until fully incorporated.", "Slice pineapple into 1/2-inch rings or chop into 1-inch chunks for kabobs. Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar on both sides. If making kabobs, skewer the pineapple.", "Place the pineapple directly on the grill slats and grill for about 1 or 2 minutes per side. Do not burn. Flip when the pineapple has defined grill marks. Grill the second side for 1 or 2 minutes, then remove from the grill.", "Serve plain, with vanilla or pineapple yogurt, or with vanilla ice cream, topped with a sprinkle of cinnamon and sugar."]

title: Potato Chips
ingredients: ["6 whole Idaho Potatoes", "Butter, To Taste", "Old Bay Seasoning (or Your Favorite Seasoning) To Taste"]
directions: ["Heat oven to 350 Degrees. Line and grease a baking sheet.", "Slice up your potatoes thinly, potato chip style. Lay flat on the baking sheet, using all available room. Put a small pat of butter on each potato and liberally season all the potatoes.", "Bake for about half an hour or until the potatoes are nice and crispy. (I usually throw in some onions to roast as well, cuz I love love love roasted onions!)", "Serve immediately.", "Enjoy!"]

title: No-Bake S’Mores Bars
ingredients: ["9 pieces Honey Graham Crackers", "2 Tablespoons Butter, Melted", "2 cups Mini Marshmallows", "9 ounces, weight Dark Chocolate (chocolate Of Choice)"]
directions: ["Place all the crackers in a large resealable bag and smash them into fine crumbs using a heavy object (roller, serving spoon, or such). It helps to place the bag on a layered hand towel to absorb the impact. Take 1 tablespoon of the cracker crumbs out and set aside.", "Transfer crackers to a medium bowl, add butter and mix until uniform. Pour onto a 9x5 loaf pan with fitted parchment paper on all sides (see picture). Press cracker mixture down as hard as you can using the back of a spoon. Then place it in the freezer for the duration of the next step.", "Note: This step will require quick actions, so be sure to read the instructions first!", "Pour the marshmallows in a medium bowl and microwave for about 30 seconds. Because microwave power varies a lot, it's best that you watch the marshmallows \"melt\". The key is to stop the microwave when the marshmallows start to puff-up like a balloon. Again, this will only take a few seconds (30 seconds for me!). Remove from microwave and quickly stir with a spatula. Quickly pour melted marshmallow over the cracker layer and start spreading right away. If the marshmallow becomes too hard to spread, simply spray the marshmallow layer with cooking spray and using the back of a clean spoon continue to spread until the marshmallow layer has coved the entire pan. Set aside.", "Break the chocolate into small pieces and microwave for 45 seconds, remove and stir with a spatula. If needed add more time until the chocolate has melted. Pour melted chocolate over the marshmallow layer evenly. Sprinkle with reserved cracker crumbs and place it in the freezer for 15-20 minutes (waiting is the hardest part!).", "Remove from freezer. Carefully lift parchment paper along with frozen s'mores. Place it on top of a cutting board. Using a large sharp knife, cut the s'mores into full-sized bars.", "The marshmallow will slightly expend at room temperature and become softer, which is perfect to bite into. Serve cold and store remaining s'more bars in the refrigerator."]

title: One Ingredient Milk Caramel Spread
ingredients: ["1 can (14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk"]
directions: ["Remove the label and the label adhesive from the can of sweetened condensed milk. This is necessary to prevent any paper or adhesive from potentially gumming up the pressure cooker's release valve.", "Place the can in a pressure cooker and cover with water, to a minimum of 2 fingers over the can.", "Seal the pressure cooker and turn it to pressure mode.", "Place on a burner over medium heat and cook until the pan starts to hiss, indicating the buildup of pressure. Once the hissing starts, set a timer for 20 minutes.", "When the 20 minutes are up, turn off the burner and turn the release valve to allow the pressure and steam to escape the pan. When the pressure has been released, open the pressure cooker and, using a set of tongs or a canning lifter, lift the can out of the pan.", "important: Do not open the can until it is completely cooled! The milk caramel will be liquid and very hot. This creates pressure in the can. If it is not completely cooled, the contents of the can could spray and potentially cause burns, not to mention make quite a mess. I cool mine in a sink full of cold water.", "Open the can after it has cooled and transfer the milk caramel to a glass container with a lid for storage.", "Use as a spread over bread or fruits (such as apples or bananas).", "Note: This is a pressure cooker recipe."]

title: Peach Raspberry Jam
ingredients: ["1 cup Pureed Raspberries", "3 cups Pureed Peaches", "7-1/2 cups Sugar", "2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice", "1 package Pectin", "1 Tablespoon Butter"]
directions: ["Puree the raspberries and peaches (I usually do them separately so that I know I have enough of each fruit, and exactness is key with this jam) to the consistency you like. Less if you want it chunky, more if you want it smooth.", "Add the fruit, sugar and lemon juice to a large pot and stir to combine. Cook over medium-low heat until it starts to boil, stirring constantly (burnt jam smells nasty, just trust me). If you find your jam is foaming a lot, a little butter will help reduce the foam.", "When the jam comes to a nice rolling boil, add the pectin according to package instructions (mine says add pectin and boil for one minute). Remove from heat then ladle into hot jars, add the lid and process for your altitude, etc.", "Enjoy!"]
