As the jars begin to cool, they will seal and you will hear them \"popping.\" Jam must be refrigerated after opening and remaining jars can be stored in a pantry."]

title: Grilled Peaches With Ice Cream
ingredients: ["4 whole Peaches", "2 Tablespoons Melted Butter", "4 whole Scoops Ice Cream"]
directions: ["Heat grill to medium-low.", "Halve and pit the peaches. Brush both sides of peaches with melted butter.", "Place peaches on grill face down; cover grill. Cook 4-5 minutes on one side, flip and grill 4-5 minutes on other side. Cook until charred and softened.", "Scoop vanilla ice cream onto warm peach and serve immediately."]

title: Peach Jam
ingredients: ["3 pounds Peaches", "1 cup Sugar", "3 Tablespoons Lemon Juice"]
directions: ["Drop whole peaches into a pot of boiling water for 40 seconds. Take them out of the water using a slotted spoon and place in a bowl of ice water.", "Once cooled, cut a slit in the skin and peel skin off. Remove pits and coarsely chop peaches. Place peaches and remaining ingredients in a large saucepan. Boil for 20 minutes or so until it thickens. Stir often.", "Remove from heat. Using an immersion blender, blend peaches to jam consistency. Ladle into sterilized jars or storage containers and keep in the refrigerator for up to one month or in the freezer for about a year."]

title: Strawberry Rhubarb Smoothie
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Rhubarb, Diced", "1 cup Strawberries, Frozen", "6 ounces, weight Vanilla Flavored Greek Yogurt", "1/2 cups Coconut Milk, From Carton, Unsweetened Or Milk Of Choice", "1 teaspoon Honey"]
directions: ["Add all ingredients into a blender, put the lid on and process until smooth."]

title: Magic Banana Mango Ice Cream
ingredients: ["1 whole Banana, Peeled And Cut Into 1/2\" Slices", "1 cup Frozen Mango Chunks (Dole Mango Chunks Are Available Frozen In 16 Oz. Bags)"]
directions: ["1. Place sliced banana on a parchment lined cookie sheet or baking pan and place it in the freezer until frozen, at least 1 hour.", "2. Add the frozen banana slices and frozen mango chunks to a food processor.", "3. Cover and process, occasionally stopping to scrape down the sides and push the mixture down towards the blade. It will take about 3-5 minutes.", "4. The mixture will come together and become creamy when it is ready to serve. Enjoy now or cover and enjoy later.", "Adapted from La Phemme Phoodie Magic One Ingredient Ice Cream."]

title: Grandma Zella’S Magical Strawberry Rhubarb Jam
ingredients: ["5 cups Rhubarb, Chopped", "3 cups Sugar", "1 package (3 Oz. Package) Strawberry Jell-O Mix"]
directions: ["Combine rhubarb and sugar in a pot, stir to coat the rhubarb, then let it sit overnight to get juicy.", "Then put it on medium heat and let it boil for 10 minutes or until it reaches liquid consistency. Add box of strawberry gelatin and stir until dissolved.", "Pour into resealable containers and store in the refrigerator. Easy peasy and oh so good on hot buttermilk biscuits!"]

title: Lemon Lime Gelato
ingredients: ["1/2 whole Lemon", "1/2 whole Lime", "1-1/2 cup Heavy Whipping Cream", "1/2 cups Milk", "1 cup Sugar"]
directions: ["Juice the lemon and lime halves (you should get about 1/4 Cup total juice). Then zest them as well.", "Pour cream, milk, sugar, juice, and zests into an 8x8 inch pan. Mix it gently until sugar is well incorporated. Cover dish and freeze for 8 hours.", "If you want your ice cream sooner, put it in a larger pan so it's thinner and freezes more quickly."]

title: Raspberry Gelato
ingredients: ["8 ounces, weight Frozen Raspberries", "3/4 cups Sugar", "2 cups Milk (2%)", "3/4 cups Heavy Cream"]
directions: ["In a blender, add the frozen raspberries, sugar and milk. Blend until well combined. Add in the whipping cream and blend until just combined.", "Pour mixture into an ice cream machine and churn according to your machine's instructions. (Mine took about 20 minutes).", "Put in an airtight container in the freezer (after having a good sample first of course!).", "Makes about 1 quart.", "(Recipe adapted from Tyler Florence.)"]

title: Magic Shell
ingredients: ["1 cup Chocolate Chips", "1 Tablespoon Coconut Oil"]
directions: ["Combine the chocolate and coconut oil in a microwave safe bowl. Microwave for 20-40 seconds. Stir and give another short nuke if necessary.", "Pour over ice cream and let it sit for 30-60 seconds until it hardens.", "Store at room temperature for up to 5 days."]

title: Gelato Crunch Cake
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Crushed Graham Crackers", "1/2 cups Crushed Salty Pretzels", "1/2 sticks Unsalted Butter, melted", "1 pint Gelato Or Ice Cream, Your Choice Of Flavor"]
directions: ["Preheat the oven to 400\u00b0F.", "Combine the graham crackers and pretzels in the bowl of a food processor and pulse until crushed. Pour in the melted butter and continue pulsing until all the crumbs are coated.", "Press the crumbs into the bottom and halfway up the sides of a 4\" springform pan. You should have a couple of tablespoons left over. Spread the leftover mixture on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and place the filled pan next to it. Bake for 10 minutes. Allow to cool completely.", "Remove gelato from the freezer and allow to sit at room temperature for 5 - 10 minutes until slightly softened. Scoop into a bowl and gently fold in the loose baked crumbs. Add the mixed gelato to the baked crust, top with a few more crumbs and freeze for a few hours or overnight.", "When ready to unmold, run a sharp knife under very hot water for a few minutes and gently run it along the sides of the springform pan. Repeat until you've loosened the whole thing and then open the mold. The cake should pop right out. Return to the freezer until ready to serve.", "Note that I doubled the recipe and made two cakes at the same time, but you could also triple or quadruple it to make more flavors."]

title: Fresh Peach Sherbet (2 Ingredients!)
ingredients: ["5 whole Large Ripe Peaches", "1 can (14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk"]
directions: ["Peel the fresh peaches over a wax paper lined baking sheet to catch the juice. Pit and slice the peaches and freeze them (and any accumulated juice) in a single layer on the wax paper lined baking sheet until frozen. This should take about 4 hours.", "Add the peaches and sweetened condensed milk into a blender and puree until the peaches are the consistency of soft serve ice cream. This can be done in batches if needed.", "Serve immediately or freeze in an airtight container for an ice cream consistency.", "Recipe adapted from Martha Stewart."]

title: Blueberry Sherbet
ingredients: ["2 cups Fresh Or Thawed Blueberries", "1 cup Buttermilk", "1/2 cups Sugar", "1 Tablespoon Fresh Lemon Juice", "1/2 teaspoons Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["Put all the ingredients into a blender and process until smooth.", "Line a 9x9 pan with plastic wrap. (You can omit this but it makes it much easier later in the recipe.) Place blended mixture in the pan and freeze for at least 4 hours.", "Remove from the pan and process again in the blender in small batches until smooth.", "Place in a freezer container, cover and freeze again for 4 hours.", "Recipe from The All New Ultimate Southern Living Cookbook."]

title: Homemade Lime Sherbet
ingredients: ["3 cups Whole Milk", "1 cup Frozen Lime Concentrate, Thawed", "5 Tablespoons Sugar", "3 drops Green Food Coloring"]
directions: ["Combine the milk, lime concentrate and sugar in a blender. Add green food coloring and blend.", "Pour into freezer bowl of ice cream maker and run for 30 minutes.", "Place in the freezer for an hour or two if you want it firmer.", "Makes about 5 cups."]

title: Braised Artichokes With A Butter Lemon Sauce
ingredients: ["1 whole Artichoke", "1 cup Vegetable Broth", "4 Tablespoons Butter", "1 whole Lemon, Zest And Juice", "Salt And Pepper"]
directions: ["First, cut the artichoke in half (vertically) down the middle. Remove spiky choke with a spoon and wash clean.", "In a large sauce pan (with a lid), add vegetable broth and place artichokes cut side down. Add enough water to come half way up the artichokes. Bring water to a boil and simmer covered for 20 to 25 minutes until tender.", "While artichokes are braising, melt butter in a small dish and squeeze half of the lemon into the butter. Taste and add more lemon juice if wanted.", "When artichokes are done, sprinkle with salt, pepper, and lemon rind. Serve immediately with butter lemony dipping sauce."]

title: Rhubarb Butter
ingredients: ["4 pounds Rhubarb", "3-1/2 cups Sugar", "2 Tablespoons Store-bought Lemon Juice"]
directions: ["1. Chop the rhubarb into a large bowl. Stir in the sugar. Let sit at room temperature for 2 hours, stirring frequently and scraping the sides of the bowl to incorporate all the sugar. Cover and refrigerate overnight.", "2. When you're ready to can, pull the rhubarb from the fridge and put 2 or 3 small plates in the freezer for testing later.", "Drain the juice from the bowl of rhubarb into an 8-qt. stockpot. Scrape any undissolved sugar into the pot as well.", "3. Bring the juice to a boil then add chopped rhubarb. Return to a rolling boil-one that does not stir down-and boil for 20 minutes. Decrease the heat to avoid scorching and still maintain the boil. Stir frequently, if not continuously.", "4. When the 20 minutes is up, pull a chilled plate from the freezer. Spoon a bit of the cooked rhubarb onto the plate and let it sit for a couple of minutes. Push the outside edge of this small bit of rhubarb to test the set. If it's too runny, continue cooking and checking every 2 minutes until you reach the set you like. If the set is to your liking, you are ready to can!", "5. Stir in the lemon juice and remove from heat. Fill four, hot, clean pint jars, leaving 1/8 inch head space. Process in a hot water bath for 5 minutes. Cool slowly, away from drafts.", "There are pictures and more detail on the related blog post. Enjoy!"]

title: Patriotic Berries
ingredients: ["1 pint Strawberries", "2 cups White Chocolate Melting Disks (or More If Big Berries)", "1/2 cups Blue Sugar, Sprinkles Or Jimmies"]
directions: ["Wash and completely dry your berries. In a small, deep bowl, melt chocolate in your microwave in 30-second intervals, stirring until smooth (careful not to burn it). In another small bowl place your sprinkles/sugar. Line a baking sheet with parchment or wax paper.", "Dip your berries one at a time into the melted chocolate; let the excess drip off. Then gently place the end of them into your blue sugar/jimmies. Now you have a red, white and blue berry! Gently place it on your parchment/wax paper-lined baking sheet and repeat. Give each berry some space. Place the baking sheet into your refrigerator to allow the melted chocolate to firm up.", "Have a fun, tasty and safe 4th of July weekend!"]

title: Sweet Potato And Brown Butter Soup
ingredients: ["1 Tablespoon Olive Oil", "1 whole Onion, Peeled And Chopped", "1 whole Sweet Potato, Peeled And Chopped", "4 cups, 3 tablespoons, 1-7/8 teaspoons, 1/4 pinches Chicken Stock", "4 Tablespoons Butter", "1-7/8 ounces, weight Goat Cheese", "1 cup Watercress Sprigs, For Garnish"]
directions: ["1. Heat a large pan with oil over high heat. Add in the onion and sweet potato and cook for 3-5 minutes, or until the onion is tender. Pour in the chicken stock and bring to a boil. Once boiling, reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 20 minutes.", "2. Once the potatoes are tender, puree the soup in batches in a food processor. Return to the pot.", "3. Using a saute pan, set to high heat. Once hot, add in the butter and swirl the pan over the heat to brown the butter evenly. As soon as the foaming settles down and the butter is browned, add it to the pot of soup, reserving a tablespoon.", "4. Ladle the soup into the bowls and top with goat's cheese and watercress. Drizzle the reserved brown butter over top and serve."]

title: Mimosa Granita
ingredients: ["2 cups Orange Juice", "1 cup Champagne Or Prosecco"]
directions: ["Mix together the orange juice and the Prosecco. Pour into a shallow dish (I used a pie plate) and cover with plastic wrap. Freeze for about 10 hours or until frozen. Every few hours scrape the granita with a fork to make it fluffy.", "Serve in glasses garnished with orange slices."]

title: Grilled Peaches With Honey-Ginger Cream Cheese Fluff
ingredients: ["4 ounces, weight 1/3 Of The Fat Neufchatel Cheese, Softened", "1-1/2 Tablespoon Honey", "1/2 teaspoons Ginger", "1/8 teaspoons Nutmeg", "4 ounces, weight Fat Free Cool Whip, Thawed", "1 pound Peaches, Washed And Halved", "Honey And Nutmeg For Garnish"]
directions: ["1. In a small bowl, add neufchatel cheese and honey. Beat with a hand mixer until creamy, about 2 minutes. Add in the ginger and nutmeg. Beat again for another 2 minutes.", "2. Gently fold in the Cool Whip with a spoon just until combined. Refrigerate while you grill the peaches.", "3. Cover grate of grill with aluminum foil. Place peaches, cut side down, on grill. Grill on low heat for 3-6 minutes, or until soft.", "4. Remove peaches to a plate. Top with cream cheese fluff. Drizzle with honey and sprinkle with nutmeg."]

title: Gluten Free Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: ["1 cup Creamy Peanut Butter", "1 cup Granulated Sugar", "1 Egg", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract", "Coarse Sea Salt"]
directions: ["1. Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.", "2. Beat peanut butter, sugar, egg, and vanilla until fully incorporated. Spoon 1 tablespoon of mixture 1 inch apart on the baking sheet. Flatten with fork, making a crosshatch pattern on the cookies. Sprinkle coarse salt over the top of the cookies", "3. Bake for 10 minutes; they should still be soft to the touch when removed from oven. Let cool."]

title: Fresh Pumpkin Puree
ingredients: ["1 whole (4-6 Lb. Size) Pie Pumpkin"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 375\u00b0F.", "Slice the pumpkin in half, crosswise through the stem, and scoop out the seeds and strings. Feel free to keep the seeds for later to roast.", "Place halves, cut-side down, onto a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil. Roast, uncovered, for 40-60 minutes, or until tender.", "Remove from oven and allow to cool enough to handle. When cool, carefully scrape flesh from skin. Discard the skin.", "Using a food processor or blender, puree until even and smooth."]

title: Mango Lassi
ingredients: ["500 grams Canned Mango Pulp", "500 grams Natural Yogurt", "1 pinch Salt"]
directions: ["Put mango, yogurt, salt into a blender and blend for 2 minutes.", "Serve chilled with a scoop of vanilla or mango ice cream on top. Drizzle with some mango pulp."]

title: Pumpkin Affogato
ingredients: ["2 Scoops Pumpkin Ice Cream", "2 Tablespoons (1 Shot) Freshly Brewed Espresso (or Strong Coffee)", "Sprinkle Of Ground Cinnamon"]
directions: ["Place ice cream in a small glass or bowl. Top with espresso. Sprinkle with cinnamon for garnish and serve immediately."]

title: Brigadeiros
ingredients: ["1 can (14 Oz. Size) Condensed Milk", "2 ounces, weight Unsweetened Chocolate", "2 Tablespoons Unsalted Butter", "1/8 teaspoons Salt", "FOR ASSEMBLY:", "1 Tablespoon Butter, For Greasing"]
directions: ["Pour the condensed milk in a large microwaveable bowl. Add the chocolate and butter. Microwave on high for about 45 seconds. Take the bowl out and give the mixture a good stir.", "Microwave for another 5 minutes, taking the bowl out every 2 minutes or so to thoroughly mix it. The brigadeiro mixture is done when it has become thick and fudgey, and you can pull it away from the side of the bowl when you stir it. (Your cooking time may vary by a minute or two depending on the power of your microwave). Stir in the salt.", "Spoon the mixture onto a large plate and chill for at least 3 hours, or overnight.", "Shape the brigadeiros. With a spoon, scoop out about 2 teaspoons of the brigadeiro mixture. Rub a little butter into your palms, to prevent the chocolate from sticking. Roll the brigadeiro into a ball, and roll the ball in your topping of choice.", "Brigadeiros keep at room temperature for about 2 days, and in the refrigerator for up to a week. Yields about 15 brigadeiros.", "Recipe loosely adapted from Betty Crocker."]

title: Spiced Pumpkin Butter Spread
ingredients: ["10 cups Pureed Cooked Pumpkin", "2 Tablespoons Cinnamon", "2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice", "1-1/2 teaspoon Nutmeg", "1 teaspoon Ginger", "1/2 teaspoons Salt", "1 pound Light Brown Sugar"]
directions: ["1. Place all ingredients into a large slow cooker. Stir to combine.", "2. Cover with the lid and cook on low for 3 hours. Stir every 30 minutes.", "3. Remove the lid and continue cooking on low for 1 hour or until thick.", "4. Turn off the heat. Allow to cool.", "5. Place in airtight containers and store in the refrigerator."]

title: Special Ingredient Chocolate Covered Strawberries
ingredients: ["1/2 bags (12 Oz. Size) Good Quality Semi-sweet Chocolate Chips", "1/2 teaspoons Coconut Oil, Or More As Needed For Taste Or Texture", "1 pound Strawberries"]
directions: ["Pour the chocolate chips into a microwave safe bowl and microwave for 30 seconds. Stir the chips and microwave in 20-second intervals, stirring in between. Add the coconut oil and stir. You want the chocolate to be slightly liquid and pourable, so add a spoontip-ful of coconut oil as needed. Dip strawberries and place on wax paper. Refrigerate until chocolate is hardened.", "Note: Normally I use canola oil to thin out the chocolate but I was all out the last time. My eyes fell upon the coconut oil and I realized how perfect it was! It added a little flair of flavor and helps the chocolate solidify better than canola because of its naturally solid state."]

title: Banana, Peach & Granola Smoothie
ingredients: ["1 whole Ripe Banana, Peeled And Frozen", "1 cup Frozen Peaches", "1/2 cups Granola, Plus More For Garnish", "1 cup Milk"]
directions: ["Blend together all ingredients in a blender until smooth. Serve in a glass and garnish with granola."]

title: Savory Sweet Smokin` Hot Bacon
ingredients: ["1 Tablespoon Brown Sugar", "1 teaspoon Smoked Paprika", "1/2 teaspoons Cayenne Pepper", "1 package Bacon (thick Center Cut) 12 Ounce Package"]
directions: ["Preheat your oven to 400 F for 5 minutes.", "In a small bowl combine the sugar and spices.", "Line a rimmed cookie sheet or a baking rack that you've set inside of a rimmed baking sheet with bacon strips and sprinkle all of the sweet and savory mixture over all the bacon evenly.", "Bake at 400 F for 11 minutes for really crispy bacon."]

title: Fuzzy Grilled Peaches
ingredients: ["2 Ripe Peaches", "1 teaspoon Cinnamon", "1 Tablespoon Raw Cane Sugar"]
directions: ["Heat the grill to medium-high. Slice peaches in half and remove the pit. Mix cinnamon and sugar on a plate and press the peaches, flesh side down, into the mixture. Use light pressure the make sure the sugar sticks.", "Turn grill to low and once it's heated place the peaches onto the grill, flesh side down. Sear the peaches for 3-5 minutes. Then place peaches on the top rack (or over indirect heat) and cook with the grill lid closed for 25-30 minutes until peaches are tender.", "Serve warm with your favorite sorbet (I like raspberry or mango) or ice cream."]

title: 3 (Or 4) Ingredient Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: ["1 cup Peanut Butter", "1 cup Sugar", "1 Egg", "1/2 cups Chocolate Chips (optional)"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F.", "Mix all ingredients together until dough forms. Drop on ungreased cookie sheet by the tablespoon. For this, I use a small cookie scooper. You can use a fork to press the design into the top at this point if you'd like.", "Bake 10-12 minutes.", "Cool on cookie sheet for a few minutes. Transfer to cooling rack to complete cooling.", "Enjoy!"]

title: Vanilla Spice Coffee Creamer
ingredients: ["1-1/2 cup Half-and-half", "1-1/2 cup Lowfat Milk", "2 Tablespoons Honey", "2 teaspoons Real Vanilla Extract", "1 teaspoon Cinnamon"]
directions: ["Bring all ingredients to a simmer, stirring often. Remove from heat and cool. Remove film off top, if one forms. Pour into a mason jar or other container to store in the fridge. Splash into your coffee and enjoy!"]

title: Beer Biscuits
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Sour Cream", "2 cups Bisquit Mix", "1/2 cups Beer", "4 Tablespoons Butter"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 450\u00b0F.", "1. Cut the sour cream into the biscuit mix until it is a crumbly dough.", "2. Pour beer into dough and mix till just blended.", "3. Sprinkle biscuit mix on countertop and pat dough out on counter. You may need to add more biscuit mix to the top of dough as it is really sticky.", "4. Put butter in an 8-inch square or round pan and place into a 450\u00b0F oven till butter is melted.", "5. Cut dough with a biscuit cutter or knife and place into the pan with melted butter.", "6. Bake at 450\u00b0F for 12-15 minutes."]

title: Pumpkin Cream Cheese
ingredients: ["4 ounces, weight Reduced Fat Cream Cheese", "3 Tablespoons Canned Pure Pumpkin", "1 teaspoon Cinnamon", "3 Tablespoons Brown Sugar", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["Stir all ingredients until creamy and pumpkin-y throughout. Slather on everything in sight and enjoy!"]

title: Pudgy Husband Bark
ingredients: ["2 pounds Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips", "8 Tablespoons Peanut Butter", "1 cup Lightly Crushed Pretzels"]
directions: ["Line a cookie sheet with a silicone mat or parchment paper. Fill a large pot with water and set it over medium high heat. Dump the chocolate chips into a lager glass bowl and set it over the pot. Stir until all the chocolate is melted. Using a rubber spatula, scrape the chocolate onto the prepared cookie sheet. Spread the chocolate out into one even layer and then plop the peanut butter tablespoon by tablespoon onto the chocolate. Use a fork to swirl into the dollops of peanut butter and then sprinkle the crushed pretzels over top, pushing them lightly into the chocolate. Refrigerate for 20 minutes and then break into pieces and store in an airtight container."]

title: Lazy Man’S Cherry Cobbler
ingredients: ["1 can (21 Oz. Can) Cherry Pie Filling", "1 can (20 Oz. Can) Crushed Pineapple", "1 box (18.25 Oz. Box) Yellow Or Butter Recipe Cake Mix", "1-1/2 stick Butter", "1 cup Chopped Pecans"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F. Spread the pie filling in the bottom of a dish; top with the crushed pineapple (undrained). Sprinkle the cake mix over the fruit. Cube butter into small pieces and place evenly on the top of the cake mix; top with chopped pecans. Bake until golden and bubbly, about 45 minutes. Serve warm with ice cream, if desired."]

title: Hawaiian Cornbread
ingredients: ["8 ounces, weight Can Crushed Pineapple, Drained", "1 cup Frozen Corn", "1 whole Egg", "1/3 cups Milk", "8-1/2 ounces, weight Box Corn Muffin Mix"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400 degrees (F).", "Grease an 8 x 8 inch baking pan.", "In a medium bowl combine pineapple, corn, egg and milk. Add corn muffin mix and stir until just combined, batter will be slightly lumpy. Let batter rest for 3 to 4 minutes.", "Pour into prepared pan.", "Bake for 25 minutes."]

title: Broiled Grapefruit
ingredients: ["1 whole Grapefruit", "2 teaspoons Agave Nectar", "2 pinches Ginger Or Cinnamon, Or To Taste"]
directions: ["Wash the grapefruit and cut it in half. Use a small paring knife to cut around the outside of the grapefruit. Top each half with one teaspoon of agave, using the back of the spoon to rub it into the fruit. Sprinkle with ginger or cinnamon. Broil for 3 minutes, or until grapefruit is warm and caramelized in places. Serve warm."]

title: Pumpkin Chocolate Chip Cake Mix Cookies
ingredients: ["1 box (18 Oz.) Spice Or Carrot Cake Mix", "15 ounces, weight Canned Pumpkin (1 Small Can)", "1 cup Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips"]
directions: ["This is one of my favorite recipes! And it is really easy to make.", "Preheat the oven to 350 degrees.", "Dump the cake mix in a bowl. If it is lumpy, sift the cake mix. I promise it is worth it. You don't want to bite down on a lump of dry cake mix. (Believe me, I've done it before.)", "Add in the entire can of pumpkin. Keep mixing together until completely combined and smooth. Dough should look like a thicker, softer ball of pumpkin.", "Add semi-sweet chocolate chips. (Or if you're like me, add 1 1/2 cup.) Mix until combined.", "Grease a cookie sheet. Spoon cookie dough onto the cookie sheet. I use large tablespoons because I like large cookies. Yup, they'll look all rough and scraggily, but they taste good!", "Bake for 15 to 17 minutes. You'll know they are done when you touch them and they bounce back a little bit.", "Let cool on the baking sheet for 2 minutes, then transfer to waxed paper, tin foil, or the counter. Don't put them on a cooling rack. They are too soft for that and they will fall right through.", "Mmmm. Enjoy! Eat with milk, if you like that sort of thing. They definitely are rich enough! But a lady at the store told me that they are actually low-fat because you use pumpkin instead of oil and eggs. I don't really care either way-they are delicious! (And EASY!)", "Here is the recipe doubled:", "* 2 boxes Spice Cake Mix (you can also use carrot cake)", "* 1 - 29 oz can pumpkin", "* 1 bag or 2 cups semi-sweet chocolate chips", "Combine all ingredients. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 to 17 minutes.", "Makes 70 large cookies or 96 small cookies."]

title: Spicy Sausage And Pumpkin Soup
ingredients: ["1 whole Onion, finely chopped", "1 pound Spicy Pork Sausage", "1 can Pumpkin (28 Oz)", "4 cups Chicken Stock", "1/2 cups Half-and-half", "1/2 teaspoons Cayenne Pepper To Taste"]
directions: ["Brown onion and sausage until sausage is no longer pink and onion is translucent. DO NOT DRAIN! Add onion, sausage, pumpkin, chicken stock, and half-and-half to a large dutch oven and stir until smooth. Cook over low heat for 30 minutes. Add cayenne pepper immediately before serving, if desired. If soup is too thin, you can add some instant potato flakes to thicken it.", "Serve hot. This soup is best eaten immediately. I find it does not keep well for leftovers."]

title: Oven-Baked Bacon
ingredients: ["20 strips Bacon"]
directions: ["Prepare bacon strips by removing rind and extra fat so you're left with long, lean strips.", "Roll each strip around your thumb and secure by threading onto a long wooden skewer. You should be able to fit four rolled up bacon strips on each skewer.", "Place in the oven over a wire rack sitting atop a baking tray to catch the grease.", "Bake in the oven (200C - hot) for about twenty minutes or until crisped to your liking."]

title: Cherry Cola
ingredients: ["1-1/2 ounce, fluid Cherry Vodka", "3 ounces, fluid Diet Cherry Coke/Pepsi Or Diet Root Beer"]
directions: ["Combine vodka and cola in a glass with ice and stir."]

title: Creamy Vanilla Bean Popsicles
ingredients: ["1 can (14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk", "1 cup Whole Milk", "1 cup Heavy Cream", "1 Vanilla Bean (See Note)"]
directions: ["In a large bowl, combine sweetened condensed milk, whole milk, and cream. Whisk until well-combined.", "Slice the vanilla bean lengthwise. Using the back of a small knife, scrape out the vanilla paste (seeds) inside. Add the vanilla to the milks and whisk until well combined.", "Using a ladle or a vessel with a spout for pouring, carefully pour the mixture into popsicle molds, being careful not to overfill. Cover and place sticks in the molds. Freeze overnight.", "Note: You can substitute vanilla bean with 1 teaspoon vanilla paste or 1 tablespoon vanilla extract."]

title: Watermelon Sour Cream Popsicles
ingredients: ["1 slice Watermelon, Large", "1 Ripe Banana", "7 ounces, weight Sour Cream", "2-1/3 ounces, weight Fruit Yogurt", "4 Tablespoons Sugar", "3 Tablespoons Honey", "1 Lemon, Juiced", "Vanilla Extract, To Taste"]
directions: ["Remove rind of watermelon. Place in the blender together with the rest of the ingredients and blend until very smooth. Add more sugar/honey or lemon juice according to your taste.", "Pour the mixture into the popsicle moulds and freeze."]

title: Watermelon Strawberry Mango Popsicles
ingredients: ["2 cups Cubed Watermelon", "1 cup Strawberries", "1/2 cups Diced Mango", "1 Tablespoon Lime Juice"]
directions: ["Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth.", "Pour the juice into popsicle molds and freeze for at least 3 hours. After popsicles have frozen, remove from the freezer and serve."]

title: Strawberry Greek Yogurt Popsicles
ingredients: ["1-1/2 cup Strawberries", "1 cup Coconut Greek Yogurt", "2 Tablespoons Sugar"]
directions: ["Note: If using fresh strawberries, rinse and remove stems. If you are using frozen, rinse under cool water and then allow them to sit in a bowl in the fridge to defrost (about 1 hour). Mix with the sugar and let the fruit sit for about 5 minutes to help pull the natural sugars out.", "In a food processor (or using a handheld blender) mix together the strawberries and yogurt until smooth. Taste away.", "Pour equally into your molds and place in freezer for 4 hours before serving!"]

title: Mango Pineapple Popsicles
ingredients: ["2 cups Diced Mango", "2 cups Diced Pineapple", "1/2 cups Fresh Lime Juice", "1 Tablespoon Honey, Or More Based On Sweetness Of Fruit (optional)"]
directions: ["Place mango, pineapple, lime juice and honey to food processor and grind until a nice and smooth puree is formed.", "Pour puree to the popsicle mold, add wooden sticks and freeze at least 4 hours."]

title: Strawberry Daiquiri Popsicles
ingredients: ["1 pound Fresh Organic Strawberries, Hulled And Halved", "1 whole Lime, Juiced", "6 ounces, fluid Honey Vanilla Greek Yogurt", "1 teaspoon Honey, More Or Less To Taste"]
directions: ["Place your prepared strawberries into the food processor bowl. Next add lime juice, yogurt and honey. Pulse until you've reached desired consistency. Pour into popsicle molds and freeze for about 4 hours or until solid. To remove the popsicle from the mold, just run a little warm water over the outside of the mold until the popsicle comes loose. Serve and enjoy!", "* The size of your molds will determine how many popsicles this will make. The puree yields 3 cups."]

title: Homemade Fruit Popsicles
ingredients: ["2 cups Plain Yogurt", "1/2 cups Apple Juice", "1 cup Real Fruit", "1/4 cups Sugar, Or Sugar Substitute"]
directions: ["In a blender add the yogurt, apple juice, fruit, and sugar and blend until it's creamy.", "Next, take the mix and pour into popsicle molds (recipe should make about 6). Then freeze. I froze mine overnight. When ready to serve... I run the mold under warm water until the pops come out easily."]

title: Strawberry Blackberry Banana Soymilk Popsicles
ingredients: ["12 whole Strawberries", "1 whole Riped Banana", "16 whole Blackberries", "1-1/2 cup Unsweetened Soy Milk", "3 Tablespoons Honey"]
directions: ["Remove stems and halve the strawberries. Add fruit to a blender, then add soy milk and honey. Blend until smooth.", "Pour smoothie into popsicle holders. Freeze overnight or until frozen.", "After popsicles are frozen, run holders under room temperature water to loosen. Carefully pull popsicles out of the holder.", "Makes about 10 popsicles."]

title: Boozy Pomegranate Popsicles
ingredients: ["3-1/2 cups Sliced Strawberries", "1 whole Lemon, Zested", "3-1/2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice", "1/3 cups Pomegranate Infused Tequila"]
directions: ["Place strawberries, lemon zest, lemon juice and tequila in a food processor. Pulse until mixture is smooth. Add additional tequila to taste (or if mixture is too thick).", "Carefully pour mixture into 6 Dixie cups and freeze for about 1 1/2 hours.", "Carefully insert wooden popsicle sticks into the middle of the popsicle. Re-freeze for about 3 hours or until set.", "Enjoy!"]

title: Cherry Yogurt Popsicles
ingredients: ["16 ounces, weight Frozen Pitted Cherries, Defrosted", "1 cup Plain Yogurt", "2 Tablespoons Pure Honey"]
directions: ["Tools: 1 popsicle mold for ten 3-ounce size popsicles and 10 popsicle sticks.", "1. Place defrosted cherries in a food processor or blender. Process until smooth, about 1 minute.", "2. Put the yogurt into a medium-sized bowl. Into the yogurt, add honey and stir to combine.", "3. Pour about 2 tablespoons of the cherry puree into the popsicle molds. Next, pour 2 tablespoons of the yogurt honey mixture into the molds. Repeat until the molds are full and you have layers of cherry puree and yogurt. With the end of a spoon or a chopstick, lightly stir the cherry puree and the yogurt until it just begins to have a swirled effect.", "4. Place popsicle sticks into the molds and place in the freezer. Freeze at least 4 hours or until frozen. To remove popsicles from the molds, pour warm water briefly over the outside of the popsicle molds and then pull on the popsicle stick."]

title: Homemade Tropical Ice Pops
ingredients: ["1 can (about 13.5 Oz. Can) Coconut Milk", "1 cup Crushed Pineapple (with Juice)", "1/2 cups Milk", "1/2 cups Sugar", "1 pinch Grated Nutmeg"]
directions: ["This easy ice pop recipe is packed full of tropical flavors. You can cut back on the sugar a bit if you want. I started out with 1/4 cup but after tasting, I added more sugar.", "Mix all ingredients together in a spouted bowl. Grate a pinch of fresh nutmeg over the bowl and mix well. Pour into ice pop molds and freeze.", "If you don't like big chuncks of fruit in your ice pops, whirl the entire mixture in the blender for about 30 seconds then fill the ice pop molds."]

title: Chorizo Corn Chowder
ingredients: ["1 pound Mild Pork Breakfast Sausage", "1/2 pounds Chorizo (beef Or Pork)", "24 ounces, weight Frozen Potatoes (or About 5 Fresh Potatoes, Cubed)", "10 ounces, weight Frozen Corn", "14 ounces, fluid Chicken Broth", "2 cups Milk", "4 ounces, weight Sharp Cheddar Cheese, Shredded", "2 Tablespoons Hot Sauce"]
directions: ["1. Cook sausage and chorizo in a skillet until well browned and cooked through.", "2. In a large soup pot, add frozen potatoes, frozen corn and chicken broth.", "3. Bring to boil and reduce to simmer until the potatoes are soft but not falling apart. If you can slide a fork through easily and back out, they are done.", "4. Add sausage and milk to the pot and stir to combine.", "5. Stir in cheddar cheese and favorite hot sauce.", "6. Simmer for about 10 minutes until the soup is thick and hot.", "7. Serve topped with extra shredded cheddar cheese.", "For the slow cooker, add everything except the corn, milk and cheese to the slow cooker after cooking the sausage and chorizo. Add corn and milk 30 minutes before you're ready to serve."]

title: Gluten Free Thick Clam Chowder
ingredients: ["6 whole Slices Thick Bacon, Diced", "2 Tablespoons Butter", "1 whole Onion Or Leek, Diced", "6 whole Celery, Diced", "1 teaspoon Thyme", "1 teaspoon Pepper Or To Taste", "51 ounces, weight Canned Clams", "3 pounds Russet Potatoes, Peeled And Diced", "1-1/2 cup Cream Or Half-and-Half (Milk Works Too But The Soup Will Be Browner)", "3/4 cups Scallions, Sliced And Reserved (Optional)"]
directions: ["Place bacon in a large stock pot over medium high heat. Brown bacon and remove to a paper towel. Set aside.", "Drain fat out of the pot but leave the brown bits. Add butter and onion to the pot. Cook onion until caramelized. Then add the celery, thyme and pepper.", "Drain clam juice off the clams and add juice to the pot. Reserve clams.", "Add potatoes to the mixture and stir. Cover with a lid and cook over medium low heat or just barely simmering, until potatoes are fork tender.", "When potatoes are soft, remove pot from heat and use a potato masher and smash half of the potatoes until the mixture is thick. Add clams, the cream or half-and-half to the pot and stir soup well.", "Place clam chowder into bowls and top with crumbled bacon and scallions."]

title: Mom’S Corn Chowder
ingredients: ["2 Tablespoons Butter", "1 cup Sliced Onion", "3 cups Unpeeled Diced Potatoes", "1/2 cups Chopped Celery (optional)", "2 cups Milk", "2 cups Frozen Corn", "2 cups Shredded Cheddar Cheese", "Salt To Taste"]
directions: ["Saute butter and onions.", "Cook potatoes; drain. Add onion and celery, then milk and corn. Season with salt (to taste).", "Heat to serving temperature, then take off heat. Stir in cheese. Do not boil."]

title: O’Oatmeal
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Old Fashioned Or Steel Cut Oats (NOT Quick Oats)", "3 dashes Milk Or Cream, More Or Less As Needed", "5 dashes Bailey's Irish Cream, More Or Less As Needed"]
directions: ["Note: the amounts of Bailey's and milk listed are approximate. It really all depends on your taste, but these are general guidelines.", "1. Cook the oats according to the directions on the box:", "-Boil the water first", "-Add oats and cook at low boil, usually about 4-5 minutes", "-When most of the water has cooked off, add cream/milk", "2. About a minute before you're ready to eat it, add the desired amount of Bailey's to the oatmeal.", "3. Add optional ingredients (that make it taste so good):", "-blueberries", "-walnuts", "-a little Splenda/sugar", "I ate this for breakfast nearly everyday on a trip through Ireland. So simple, but I never would have thought of it."]

title: Shrimp & Roasted Asparagus Risotto
ingredients: ["1 bunch Asparagus", "3 Tablespoons Olive Oil, Divided, Plus 1 Teaspoon For Cooking Shrimp", "Salt And Pepper", "1/2 pounds Shrimp", "6 cups Chicken Broth", "2 whole Shallots", "1-1/2 cup Arborio Rice", "4 Tablespoons Butter", "1/2 cups Parmesan Cheese, Freshly Grated"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 425\u00b0F. Rinse asparagus and place on a large baking sheet. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons olive oil, and 1 teaspoon each salt and pepper. Roast in oven for 20-25 minutes. Allow to cool then cut into bite size pieces. Set aside.", "Peal and devein shrimp. Sprinkle with a little bit of salt and pepper on both sides. Heat 1 teaspoon olive oil in pan over medium heat. Add shrimp and cook on both sides 1-2 minutes until pink. Allow shrimp to cool until easily touched, then cut into bite size pieces. Set aside.", "In a saucepan, warm the broth over low heat. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil to skillet, and stir in the shallots. Cook 1 minute. Add rice, stirring to coat with oil, about 2 minutes. When the rice has taken on a pale, golden color, pour in 1/2 cup of broth, stirring constantly until the broth is fully absorbed. Add another 1/2 cup broth to the rice, and stir until the broth is absorbed. Continue adding broth 1/2 cup at a time, stirring continuously, until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is al dente, about 15 to 20 minutes.", "Remove from heat, and stir in butter, parmesan, asparagus, and shrimp. Season with salt and pepper to taste.", "Enjoy!", "(Recipe adapted from allrecipes.com)"]

title: Mango Soft Ice Cream (With Dairy Free Variation)
ingredients: ["2 cups Frozen Mango Chunks", "5 ounces, weight Mango Jam Or Preserves", "1 cup Heavy Cream", "1 teaspoon Pure Vanilla Extract"]
directions: ["In a food processor or bullet-type blender, combine the frozen mango chunks, mango jam, cream, and vanilla. Process until smooth.", "Spoon into four 4-ounce custard dishes and serve immediately.", "For dairy-free version, use unsweetened, full-fat coconut milk in place of the heavy cream. Chill one 13-ounce can of coconut milk overnight. Chilling the milk causes the the coconut cream to separate from the coconut water. Scoop out all of the solid cream on the top and add just this to the food processor along with the frozen mango and mango jam. Process until smooth. Enjoy immediately!"]

title: Four-Ingredient Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients: ["1 cup Creamy Unsweetened Peanut Butter", "1 cup Firmly Packed Brown Sugar", "1 whole Egg", "1/2 cups Dark Chocolate Chips Or Finely Chopped Chocolate"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F. Line 2 baking sheet with parchment paper, Silpats, or coat with nonstick cooking spray.", "In a medium bowl, put the peanut butter, brown sugar, and egg. Use a rubber spatula to mash and stir the ingredients into a smooth batter. Add the chocolate, and stir again until evenly distributed.", "Pinch up 1 tablespoon of dough and roll in the palms of your hands into a smooth ball. Cover each baking sheet with 12 balls. Press a fork firmly into the dough, first in one direction, and then the opposite direction. If the dough crumbles a bit, just patch it back together.", "Bake until the cookies brown slightly and you start to see a hint of a darker rim around the cookie, 10 to 12 minutes.", "Remove from oven and cool. Store in an airtight container.", "Inspired by Real Simple magazine's Peanut Butter Cookies."]

title: 2-Ingredient Fudgy Chocolate Cake
ingredients: ["1 can (15 Oz) Pumpkin Puree", "1 box (18 Ounce Box) Chocolate Cake Mix", "2/3 cups Pecans (optional)", "2/3 cups Semi-sweet Chocolate Chips (optional)"]
directions: ["Mix together all of the ingredients - the pecans and chocolate chips are optional - so they don't count against the 2-ingredient tally! Transfer into greased loaf pan. Put into the preheated oven at 350 degrees F for 25-35 minutes. It is done when toothpick comes out of the middle, (fairly) clean."]

title: Chai Ice Cream
ingredients: ["1 can (14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk", "1-1/2 cup Tazo Chai Tea Brew (or Prepared Chai Tea)", "1/2 cups Half-and-half", "1 pinch Ginger", "1 pinch Cardamom", "1 pinch Cinnamon"]
directions: ["Whisk all ingredients well, and store in refrigerator until well chilled.", "Freeze in ice cream maker according to manufacturer's directions, then place in freezable container until needed.", "This will be very soft when churned, so allow for extra freezing time. It does not get super-hard, but it will still be firm enough to scoop.", "Goes very well with warm apple pie, giving it more depth than using vanilla ice cream.", "Makes about 1 quart."]

title: Roasted Asparagus With Thyme & Parmesan
ingredients: ["2 pounds Asparagus", "1 Tablespoon Olive Oil", "2 teaspoons Fresh Thyme", "Salt And Pepper, to taste", "4 ounces, weight Freshly Grated Parmesan Cheese"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 425\u00b0F. On a large baking sheet lined with tinfoil, spread the asparagus in an even layer. Drizzle with olive oil. Evenly distribute fresh thyme, salt, and pepper. Sprinkle the Parmesan cheese atop the asparagus.", "Roast for 10 to 12 minutes depending upon the size of the asparagus, until bright green and just tender. Enjoy!"]

title: Cheddar Panko Asparagus
ingredients: ["2 pounds Asparagus", "Pepper To Taste", "1-1/4 cup Shredded Sharp Cheddar Cheese", "1/2 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "1 cup Panko", "1 Tablespoon Fresh Minced Parsley Or Tarragon For Garnish"]
directions: ["Add water to a vegetable steamer and begin to bring to a boil. Wash and snap the ends off of the asparagus. Once the water in the steamer is boiling, add the asparagus. Steam covered for 3-4 minutes, or until it's just fork tender and then rinse with cold water.", "Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and evenly arrange the asparagus on the sheet. Season with pepper to taste. Sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese.", "Mix olive oil with panko, and then sprinkle it over the layer of cheddar cheese. Place the pan on the middle rack of the oven under a broiler for 2-3 minutes. The dish is done when the cheddar is melted and the panko is golden brown. Garnish with fresh minced parsley or tarragon before serving."]

title: Lemon Panko Asparagus
ingredients: ["1 pound Asparagus, Tough Ends Trimmed Off", "1 Tablespoon Olive Oil", "1 teaspoon Herbes De Provence", "2 Tablespoons Butter", "1/2 cups Panko Bread Crumbs", "1 whole Lemon, Zest And Juice", "2 Tablespoons Fresh Parmesan Cheese, Shredded", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Preheat the oven to 425 F.", "Lay the trimmed asparagus on a baking sheet and drizzle with olive oil. Sprinkle the herbs de Provence on top and place into the oven. Roast for about 15 minutes until just tender.", "While the asparagus is roasting, melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Add the panko bread crumbs and stir for 3-4 minutes until the panko is golden brown. Remove the saucepan from the heat and add the lemon juice and zest and stir. Transfer the panko to a paper towel lined plate and let cool.", "Once the asparagus is done, remove the baking sheet from the oven. Transfer the asparagus to a serving platter and sprinkle with the panko mixture. Add the Parmesan cheese on top and season with salt and pepper as needed. Serve immediately."]

title: Roasted Asparagus And Brie
ingredients: ["1 bunch Asparagus", "2 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "1 pinch Kosher Salt And Coarse Ground Pepper", "4 slices Brie Cheese"]
directions: ["1. Rinse the asparagus and lop off the white ends and any rotten tops.", "2. Lay in a single flat layer on a cookie sheet, toss with olive oil until coated. Sprinkle with salt and pepper.", "3. Roast the asparagus in a middle rack of the oven at 375\u00b0F, turning once, until tender, between 10-15 minutes.", "4. Lay the slices of Brie cheese across the spears and return to the oven for an additional 5 minutes to melt. Serve."]

title: Simple Skillet Asparagus
ingredients: ["3 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "1 bunch Asparagus", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Heat olive oil over medium heat in a cast iron skillet. Snap the ends off of your asparagus stalks and cut the remainder in half. Pour into the skillet, toss with oil and add salt and pepper. Saute 10-15 minutes until crisp tender."]

title: Easy Roasted Asparagus
ingredients: ["2 pounds Asparagus", "3 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "1/2 teaspoons Nutmeg", "Salt", "Pepper"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0F. Rinse clean the asparagus. Break the tough ends off of the asparagus and discard.", "Lay the asparagus spears out in a single layer in a baking dish. Drizzle olive oil over the spears and roll the asparagus back and forth until they are all covered with a thin layer of olive oil. Sprinkle salt, pepper and nutmeg. Rub over the asparagus so that they are evenly distributed.", "Place pan in the oven and cook for approximately4-8 minutes, depending on how thick your asparagus spears are, until tender but still with a little bite."]

title: Baked Sweet Potato Fries With Asparagus
ingredients: ["1 bunch Asparagus", "1 pound Regular Or Fingerling Sweet Potatoes", "3 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "1/4 teaspoons Chili Powder", "1/2 teaspoons Cinnamon", "Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["Preheat the oven to 450F. Peel the sweet potatoes if you want, but I don't find it necessary. Cut the sweet potatoes into some sort of fry-shape (with the fingerlings, I just quartered them lengthwise) and place them in a mixing bowl. Toss in the olive oil and sprinkle over any seasonings you want (I used those listed above). Mix to coat the potatoes with the oil. Spread out into a single layer on a greased baking sheet, and put in the oven for about 15 minutes. While baking, break off the tough ends of the asparagus, and toss them into the bowl you tossed the sweet potatoes in, adding more oil if you want.", "After 15 minutes, the sweet potatoes should be fairly tender. Stir them around a bit, and throw the asparagus on top, trying to spread the mixture out evenly again but don't worry if it doesn't fit in one layer. Put back in the oven for about 10 minutes, at which point the asparagus should be done, and the sweet potatoes crispy in places. Devour in one sitting."]

title: Strawberry Blackberry Crumbles
ingredients: ["1 quart Strawberries, Quartered", "1 pint Blackberries", "1/2 cups Fresh Orange Juice", "1 teaspoon Vanilla Extract", "1-1/2 Tablespoon Cold Ghee", "1/2 cups Almond Meal", "1 pinch Sea Salt", "1/2 teaspoons Cinnamon", "1/2 cups Chopped Raw Almonds"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F.", "Place berries in a bowl, add juice and vanilla, and stir gently to mix. Evenly place berries and juice in small (4- to 5-ounce) ramekins. Roast for 20 minutes.", "Meanwhile prepare topping. In a mini food processor, place cold ghee, almond meal, salt and cinnamon. Pulse 5 or 6 times. Add chopped nuts and pulse 2 or 3 times.", "Remove roasted berries from oven and place a heaping tablespoonful of topping onto each ramekin. Return to oven and roast 10-15 minutes more or until topping is lightly browned.", "Allow to cool slightly before serving."]

title: Baked Asparagus
ingredients: ["Asparagus", "Olive Oil", "Salt (or Garlic Salt If You'd Like)"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 400\u00b0.", "Wash asparagus. Cut tips of ends off (on the non-leafy/ flowery side). Place in a large Ziploc bag. Drizzle with olive oil until lightly coated. Sprinkle in some salt to your liking. Close bag and toss.", "Dump asparagus onto a baking sheet. Spread out, making sure none are on top of each other (they can touch, just don't pile them).", "Bake for about 10-12 minutes until cooked through to your liking (I like it crunchier, which takes 10 minutes, if you like them softer, leave in longer). I usually like to flip them over 1/2 way through. Cool slightly and enjoy!"]

title: Fat Man Follies
ingredients: ["12 ounces, weight Shredded Coconut", "14 ounces, fluid Sweetened, Condensed Milk", "4 ounces, weight Pecan Pieces", "1 teaspoon Vanilla"]
directions: ["Mix ingredients, form into balls, and bake at 350\u00b0F for 12 minutes or until browned."]

title: Roasted Asparagus With Goat Cheese
ingredients: ["10 spears Asparagus", "2 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "3 Tablespoons Walnuts, Chopped", "1 ounce, weight Goat Cheese, Chopped"]
directions: ["1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees.", "2. Rinse and trim the asparagus.", "3. Add olive oil to a small rimmed baking sheet.", "4. Add asparagus to the oil and shake to coat.", "5. Sprinkle with walnuts.", "6. Bake for about 20 minutes (until tender).", "7. Remove from the pan, place on a serving dish, and sprinkle with goat cheese, adding more if desired."]

title: Hot Buttered Rum For One
ingredients: ["1 Tablespoon Butter", "1 teaspoon Brown Sugar", "1 ounce, fluid Rum", "1 pinch Nutmeg"]
directions: ["Add ingredients to a mug and fill with hot water.", "Yum!"]

title: Proscuitto Wrapped Asparagus
ingredients: ["1 pound Asparagus", "3 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "2 teaspoons Salt", "2 teaspoons Black Pepper", "8 ounces, weight Prosciutto"]
directions: ["Preheat your oven to 425F and line a deep cookie sheet with foil for easier cleanup.", "Snap (or cut) the ends off the asparagus and lay out evenly on the cookie sheet. Pour the olive oil, salt and pepper over the asparagus and mix around making sure everything is coated.", "Separate the asapargus into bundles or 4 or 5 stalks, depending on the size of the stalks. Wrap each bundle with a piece of proscuitto and place back on the cookie sheet, seam side down.", "Cook for about 15 minutes. You want crispy ends on the asparagus but not dried out leather-like proscuitto so you'll want to check on this once or twice.", "This is a great addition to a chicken dinner."]

title: Lemon Pepper Asparagus Salad
ingredients: ["1 bunch Asparagus (rinsed)", "2 Tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil", "1 teaspoon Salt", "2 teaspoons Black Pepper", "1/2 whole Lemon, Juice And Zest"]
directions: ["Chop the asparagus into small pieces.", "Put the asparagus and a splash of water in a pot on the stove top. Cover with a lid and cook on medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes, until the asparagus turns bright green.", "Turn off the heat and transfer the asparagus to the ice bath. Allow to sit in the ice water for a couple of minutes.", "Drain and transfer to a mixing bowl.", "Add the oil, salt, pepper, and lemon juice and stir well.", "Chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve. Garnish with extra lemon zest if desired."]

title: Holiday Fiesta Bark
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Raw Pepitas (or Pistachios)", "1/2 teaspoons Olive Oil", "1 pinch Sea Salt", "1 pound White Chocolate (chips Or Solid)", "1/2 cups Dried Pomegranate Cranberries (or Any Flavor)"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350F.", "Toss pepitas with olive oil and salt. Spread evenly on baking sheet.", "Note - If using dry roasted and salted pistachios, you can skip this part. Otherwise, roast the pepitas for 5-7 minutes. Let cool. Set aside.", "Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside.", "Melt the white chocolate over a double boiler (or in 30-second intervals in the microwave on 50% power, stirring after each). Once the chocolate is melted, remove from the heat and let sit for a few minutes to cool slightly, stirring occasionally. Add the cooled pepitas and cranberries and stir to combine.", "Spread the chocolate mixture onto the prepared pan in an even layer (depending on the size of the pan and how thick you'd like your bark, you may not need the entire surface of the pan).", "Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or until set. (Or if you live in Minnesota - set it out on your back porch for 5 minutes!)", "Using a sharp knife, cut the bark into pieces. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator."]

title: Roasted King Trumpet Mushrooms With Asparagus
ingredients: ["1 pound Asparagus, Ends Trimmed", "1 pound Hokto Kinoko King Trumpet Mushrooms, Ends Trimmed", "2 Tablespoons Olive Oil", "1 ounce, weight Shaved Parmesan Cheese", "1/8 teaspoons Salt And Pepper, to taste"]
directions: ["1. Preheat the oven to 400F degrees. Cut the mushrooms lengthwise into 1/2\" slices.", "2. On a baking sheet, spread the mushroom slices and the asparagus evenly. Toss the vegetables with the olive oil and roast in the oven for 10 to 12 minutes, flipping the vegetables halfway through.", "3. Season the vegetables with salt and freshly ground black pepper and top with the shaved Parmesan."]

title: Asparagus Pasta Salad
ingredients: ["1 bunch Asparagus", "2 cups Dry Pasta", "1/2 cups Parmesan Cheese", "2 Tablespoons Extra Virgin Olive Oil", "Pepper And Salt To Taste"]
directions: ["Clean asparagus thoroughly. Cut off ends (from the bottom to about 1 inch in). Cut the remaining asparagus into bite-sized pieces (1-2 inches).", "Fill a large pot halfway full with water (approximately 8 cups). Bring to a boil. When at a boil, add a dash of salt and the pasta. Cook pasta (per directions on the box) until only 3 minutes remain in the cooking time. Add the chopped asparagus into the water with the pasta to cook for the remaining 3 minutes.", "Strain the pasta and asparagus and immediately rinse with cold water. This will stop the cooking process and also cool your asparagus and pasta for serving purposes. Rinse until the pasta and asparagus are cool to the touch.", "Place asparagus and pasta into a bowl. Grate your Parmesan cheese and add into the bowl along with the olive oil and pepper and salt. Mix thoroughly and enjoy!"]

title: Potato & Cabbage Soup
ingredients: ["1 pound Cabbage, Sliced", "3 whole Russet Potatoes, Peeled And Cut Into Chunks", "1 cup Ham, Diced", "6 cups Chicken Stock", "1 cup Half-and-half"]
directions: ["1. Combine all ingredients except half-and-half in slow cooker.", "2. Cover. Cook on high for 6 hours.", "3. Remove 2 cups of the 'solids' and 1 cup of 'liquid' from the cooker and puree in blender. Return to cooker.", "4. Stir in half-and-half and cook on low for 20 minutes more."]

title: Triple Berry Jam
ingredients: ["2-1/2 cups Strawberries, Hulled", "1-1/2 cup Raspberries", "1 cup Blackberries", "2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice", "1 box Pectin", "7 cups Sugar"]
directions: ["Have your jars sterilized and waiting for you in a large canning pot, sitting in simmering water. Make sure that the water covers them by an inch or two. Have you lids waiting in a seperate warm water bath.", "Crush berries one layer at a time with a potato masher, and put into a 5 to 6 qt. saucepan. Dump in the lemon juice. Measure the sugar in a separate bowl and set aside.", "Stir the pectin into the fruit and bring to a full boil. Quickly stir in the sugar all at once and return to a full boil. Boil for 1 minute.", "Take off the heat, and skim off the foam with a metal spoon. Ladle quickly into hot sterile jar, leaving 1/8\" head space. Clean rims and threads, put a lid on it (har de har har), fasten rings, and hand-tighten them. Immediately return each jar to the hot water bath as you fill it.", "Once your water bath is full (do not stack jars), pump up the heat. Once it is at a full boil, let it boil for 10 minutes, turn off the heat, and let it rest in the hot water for an additional 5 minutes. Remove and place in a draft-free area to set. If they do not seal, follow normal canning procedures with the defective jars, i.e. try to re-lid, and repeat the water bath OR, if it's just a jar or two, be a piggo and stick it in your fridge once it's cool, just making sure to use it within a week or so.", "This recipe has been successful for me with a wide variety of berries. Another great combo: raspberry, blueberry, and strawberry, or, when I can get them, I will use lingonberries as a base. ANY combination is incredible, and limited only by the varieties of berries accessible to you. Please, enjoy. I sure as sugar do!"]

title: Popcorn Cauliflower
ingredients: ["1 head Cauliflower", "1/4 cups Olive Oil (approximate)", "Sea Salt And Pepper, To Taste"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 450 F. Wash cauliflower and cut up into florets.", "Put florets in a 9-by-13-inch pan, then drizzle with olive oil. You probably won't need a full quarter-cup; you want a moderate amount, not a complete coating. Sprinkle with sea salt and pepper. Stir well.", "Put in the oven for 45-50 minutes, stirring once or twice. If the tips start to look browned or black, don't worry-that caramelization gives it its great flavor. You want some browning and blackening.", "That's it-enjoy! This also can be done with broccoli."]

title: Daddy’S Famous Caramel Popcorn
ingredients: ["2 bags (3.3 Oz. Bag) Microwave Popcorn (about 16 Cups Of Popped Popcorn)", "1/2 cups Butter", "7 whole Large Marshmallows (or 70 Mini Marshmallows)", "1/2 cups Brown Sugar"]
directions: ["Melt the butter, marshmallows and brown sugar in a saucepan over medium heat, stirring constantly. Dump the popped popcorn in a big bowl and drizzle the caramel sauce all over the top. Toss to coat!", "(To be honest, we always double the caramel sauce but keep the two bags of popcorn. We are super naughtly like that.)", "Helpful tip: if using microwave popcorn and you need to get rid of the unpopped kernels, after you have dumped the popcorn into a bowl (before adding the caramel) place a cooling rack over the top of the bowl and shake over your sink or garbage. All the unpopped kernels will fall out, leaving the popped popcorn in the bowl."]

title: Popcorn Cake
ingredients: ["2 bags (3.3 Oz. Size) Popocorn", "1-1/2 cup Broken Pretzel Sticks", "2 cups M&Ms", "1 stick Butter", "16 ounces, weight Marshmallows"]
directions: ["Pop popcorn and pick out any remaining kernels. Mix in a large bowl with pretzel pieces and M&Ms.", "Melt the butter in a large pot. Add marshmallows and stir until melted completely and you have a nice sauce.", "Pour marshmallows over the popcorn mixture and coat evenly. Pour the popcorn mixture into a prepared bunt pan and cover loosely with tin foil. Let sit for a few hours."]

title: Popcorn Cake
ingredients: ["1 stick Butter", "16 ounces, weight Marshmallows", "10 cups Popped Popcorn", "1 cup Peanuts (optional)", "1 bag (19.2 Oz. Size) M&Ms"]
directions: ["Melt butter with marshmallows in a saucepan. Mix popped popcorn and peanuts in a large bowl. Pour marshmallow mixture over. Add a large bag of M&Ms. Put in a bundt pan. Let cool."]

title: Peanut Butter Frosting
ingredients: ["1 cup Creamy Peanut Butter", "1 pound Powdered Sugar", "1 stick Butter, Melted", "1 can (12 Oz. Can) Evaporated Milk, Or Less As Needed"]
directions: ["In a large mixing bowl, combine peanut butter, powdered sugar, and melted butter. Start mixing with an electric mixer on medium speed. While still mixing, slowly add evaporated milk a little at a time until the frosting is at the consistency you want. (I usually use 1/2 to 2/3 of the can of evaporated milk.)", "Use this frosting to top the cake of your choice. I use it to dress up plain ole yellow cake. Garnish with Reese's Peanut Butter Cups is you wanna."]

title: Chocolate Chocolate Popcorn
ingredients: ["2 bags (2.9 Oz. Bag) Microwave Popcorn, Butter Flavored", "12 ounces, fluid Premium White Chocolate Chips", "1-1/2 cup Chocolate Chips (milk Or Semi-sweet)"]
directions: ["Place the popped popcorn in a large bowl. (Tip: Place popcorn from one bag into a medium bowl. Give it a good couple of shakes so the kernels fall to the bottom of the bowl. Then with your hands, scoop the popped corn into the large bowl. This will help keep most of the kernels out of your treat.) Repeat with the remaining bag.", "In a microwave proof bowl, melt white chocolate for 20-30 seconds. Stir after each 10 seconds. Pour over popcorn and toss to coat. I use two large spoons to help me toss it all together. Place the bowl and spoons into the fridge and set your timer for 10 minutes. Once the time has passed, pull out your bowl and toss again. This will help the white chocolate dry more evenly and not make your popcorn one solid mass. Chill for another 10 minutes.", "Pour popcorn into a baking sheet. In another microwave proof bowl, melt your chocolate chips for 30-40 seconds, stirring after each 10 seconds. Drizzle chocolate over your popcorn. Chill the whole baking sheet for 20 minutes or until your chocolate is no longer glossy and wet. Serve.", "Warning: This is highly addictive!"]

title: Churro Popcorn
ingredients: ["6 Tablespoons Butter", "8 cups Popped Popcorn", "1/2 cups Granulated Sugar", "1/2 Tablespoons Cinnamon Or More To Taste", "Melted Chocolate, For Drizzling (optional)"]
directions: ["In microwave safe bowl or in a small saucepan on the stove, melt butter; set aside.", "If you have not already done so, pop your corn.", "In a small bowl, combine sugar and cinnamon. Mix until thoroughly combined.", "Place popcorn in a large mixing bowl (I like to use a giant mixing bowl-makes it easier to toss popcorn). Pour butter over popcorn in increments, tossing and stirring to coat after each addition.", "Shake cinnamon sugar mixture over popcorn, again doing this in increments and tossing or stirring to combine after each addition. Mix (I used my hands) until popcorn has been well-coated in cinnamon sugar.", "If desired, drizzle melted chocolate over popcorn. Serve and enjoy!"]

title: Creamy Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: ["5 pounds Russet Or Yukon Gold Potatoes", "3/4 cups Butter", "1 package (8 Oz.) Cream Cheese, Softened", "1/2 cups (to 3/4 Cups) Half-and-Half", "1/2 teaspoons (to 1 Teaspoon) Lawry's Seasoned Salt", "1/2 teaspoons (to 1 Teaspoon) Black Pepper"]
directions: ["Peel and cut the potatoes into pieces that are generally the same size. Bring a large pot of water to a simmer and add the potatoes. Bring to a boil and cook for 30 to 35 minutes. When they're cooked through, the fork should easily slide into the potatoes with no resistance, and the potatoes should almost, but not totally, fall apart.", "Drain the potatoes in a large colander. When the potatoes have finished draining, place them back into the dry pot and put the pot on the stove. Mash the potatoes over low heat, allowing all the steam to escape, before adding in all the other ingredients.", "Turn off the stove and add 1 1/2 sticks of butter, an 8-ounce package of cream cheese and about 1/2 cup of half-and-half. Mash, mash, mash! Next, add about 1/2 teaspoon of Lawry's Seasoning Salt and 1/2 a teaspoon of black pepper.", "Stir well and place in a medium-sized baking dish. Throw a few pats of butter over the top of the potatoes and place them in a 350-degree oven and heat until butter is melted and potatoes are warmed through.", "Note: When making this dish a day or two in advance, take it out of the fridge about 2 to 3 hours before serving time. Bake in a 350-degree oven for about 20 to 30 minutes or until warmed through."]

title: Caramel Cream Frosting
ingredients: ["1 cup Plus 2 Tablespoons White Granulated Sugar, Divided", "1/2 cups Butter", "1/2 cups Heavy Whipping Cream"]
directions: ["Place 2 tablespoons of sugar in a saucepan. Cook over medium heat until sugar is dissolved and becomes golden brown in color and set aside.", "Combine remaining 1 cup sugar, butter, and cream in a medium saucepan. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture comes to a boil. Stir in caramelized sugar, and return to a boil. Cook for 2 minutes, stirring constantly. Remove from heat. Beat until frosting has a good spreading consistency.", "Tips:", "I typically make 2 batches for 2 nine-inch layers. Since the caramel hardens quickly, I torte the layers and then frost with the first batch. Then, I make the second batch and finish frosting the cake."]

title: The Best Peanut Butter Cookies
ingredients: ["1 cup Granulated Sugar", "1 whole Egg", "1 cup Peanut Butter"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350", "Stir ingredients together well with fork. Roll into walnut sized balls (or larger) and place on cookies sheet 2-3 inches apart. Flatten with fork to make criss-crosses.", "Bake at 350 for approx. 10 minutes.", "This recipe makes about 1 1/2 dozen cookies depending on the size you make them."]

title: Date, Almond And Coconut Truffles
ingredients: ["1 cup Desiccated Coconut (unsweetened), Divided Use", "2 cups Pitted Dates, Juicy And Plump Dates Are Best (see Note)", "2 cups Slivered Almonds, Toasted", "2 Tablespoons Honey", "1/2 cups Sesame Seeds (optional)"]
directions: ["1. Set aside half of the coconut in a shallow bowl.", "2. Combine all the other ingredients in a food processor and pulse, scraping the sides as necessary until a soft dough is formed.", "3. Shape the mixture into bite-sized balls.", "4. Roll the balls in the set aside coconut.", "Notes :", "1. The recipe works best with juicy, plump dates. If your dates are little on the drier side, soak them in hot water for 30 minutes.", "2. Adjust the honey quantity according to taste and sweetness of the dates.", "3. Store leftover truffles in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 weeks."]

title: Yogurt Cream And Berries
ingredients: ["1-1/2 cup Plain, Unflavored Yogurt", "1-1/4 cup Heavy Cream", "1/2 cups (to 3/4 Cup) Brown Sugar", "Blueberries (or Other Fruit Of Your Choice)"]
directions: ["First, pour the yogurt into a bowl. Then add the cream. With a whisk carefully stir until combined. It should be nice and thick.", "Sprinkle the brown sugar evenly over the top of the yogurt mixture. Do not stir the mixture. Cover the bowl with foil or plastic wrap and tightly seal the edges. Place in the refrigerator for at least three or four hours.", "When you are ready to serve, place a small handful of berries (or other fruit) into a bowl or cup. Now, you can either not stir the mixture and have small visible bits of brown sugar in the finished product or you can whisk the mixture until smooth. This is how I like it. Stirred or not, spoon the yogurt mixture over the berries or fruit. Repeat the layers once, ending with berries on top.", "Now take this heavenly, creamy substance and indulge. You won't be sorry you did."]

title: Yellow Punch
ingredients: ["1 bottle Sunny Delight ( Large)", "1 bottle 7-up ( 2 Liter )"]
directions: ["Refrigerate the Sunny Delight and the 7-up.", "When ready to serve, pour all the Sunny Delight into the punch bowl and half of the 7-up. This is the easiest recipe ever, just remember the ratio is 2 parts Sunny Delight to 1 part 7-up.", "You can line a glass pitcher with thin slices of oranges and lemons; partially fill with crushed ice and fill with punch. This makes a beautiful presentation for showers or parties."]

title: World Peace Potatoes
ingredients: ["Potatoes", "Grated Cheddar Cheese", "Heavy Cream", "Jalapenos, Seeded And Diced"]
directions: ["*Preheat oven to 400.", "*Peel and thinly slice potatoes.", "*De-seed jalapenos and dice.", "*Grate cheese.", "Cover bottom of baking dish with potatoes. You can use a pie plate or a cake pan-it all depends on how many servings you need.", "Over potatoes, layer grated cheese. Sprinkle with jalapenos.", "Layer more potatoes. Lather, rinse, repeat until you have filled the pan, omitting the last layer of cheese.", "Pour heavy cream all over, until it reaches about 1/2 up the side of the dish.", "Add the remaining cheese and diced jalapenos.", "Bake at 400 until a knife slides easily into the center, or until the chunk that you took out of the corner is cooked.", "Don't lie, you know you totally did. Just rearrange the potatoes into the corner and nobody will ever know.", "Feel free to add bacon, omit the jalapenos, use different cheese- mix it up! Make it yours! Facilitate World Peace in your home or next potluck."]

title: Witches Brew
ingredients: ["1 package (0.14 Oz. Size) Green Kool-Aid, Prepared According To The Package Directions", "1 package Gummi Worms, 6 Ounce Bag"]
directions: ["Place the gummi worms in ice cube trays. Fill the trays with water, covering the worms, and freeze. Place ice cubes in a glass, and fill with Green Kool-Aid."]

title: Parmesan Corn
ingredients: ["1 cup Corn (I Used Frozen)", "2 Tablespoons Butter", "1 teaspoon Salt And Pepper", "1/3 cups Grated Fresh Parmesan Cheese"]
directions: ["In your favorite frying pan, fry corn in the butter. Add your salt and pepper. When the corn starts to show signs of browning, add the parmesan cheese and fry until just melted. Enjoy!"]

title: Raspberry Freezer Jelly
ingredients: ["4 cups Sugar", "1 package Ball Brand Pectin For Freezer Jam", "2 cups Pureed Raspberries"]
directions: ["Take the raspberries and run them through a strainer to remove seeds. Taking two cups of the Raspberry juice, add four cups of sugar. Stir together then put in microwave for 90 seconds. Then pull out, stir and put back in for 1 minute.", "While the Raspberries are in the microwave, cook your pectin, take 3/4 cup of COLD water, add your pectin and bring to a boil and boil for one minute.", "When the Raspberries are done cooking, let cool for a minute, then add Pectin, stir and immediately add to jar or container, add to freezer or you can let it set up on the counter. Whichever you prefer.", "Enjoy!", "Alternative, you can add an 1/8 of a cup of lemon juice, but need to cut back on the berries by that much."]

title: Peanut Butter Fudge
ingredients: ["2 Cups Sugar", "2/3 Cups Milk", "1/2 Stick Butter", "1 Cup Peanut Butter", "1 Teaspoon Vanilla"]
directions: ["Combine sugar, milk & butter in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring until sugar has dissolved.", "Cook to a soft ball stage for at least 5 mins.", "Remove from heat, adding peanut butter. Then add vanilla.", "Stir until mixture starts hardening. Pour into 9 in. square buttered pan."]

title: Wine Poached Pears
ingredients: ["1-1/2 cup Red Wine, Zinfandel Or Shiraz", "3/4 cups Sugar", "2 Tablespoons Lemon Juice", "2 teaspoons Vanilla", "2 teaspoons Cinnamon", "4 whole Anjou Or Bosc Pears, Peeled", "Mascarpone Cheese, To Serve"]
directions: ["Combine wine, sugar, lemon juice, vanilla and cinnamon in a medium-sized pot and bring to a boil. Then turn the heat down so the wine simmers and add the pears. Simmer pears for about 18-20 minutes, very turning them very carefully every 5 minutes. Remove pears and let them cool.", "Boil the wine sauce until reduced by half. Pour sauce over the pears and serve with a dollop of mascarpone cheese."]

title: Peanut Clusters
ingredients: ["1-1/2 cup Semi Sweet Chocolate Chips (I Use Ghirardelli)", "1 bag (10 Oz. Size) Peanut Butter Chips", "1-1/2 Tablespoon Coconut Oil Or Shortening", "2 cups Salted Or Unsalted Peanuts", "Sea Salt For Sprinkling, Optional"]
directions: ["Place chocolate chips, peanut butter chips and coconut oil in covered crockpot on low. Layer paper towels right under the lid. Stir every 20 minutes until melted.", "Once melted, stir in peanuts. Drop by rounded spoonfuls on wax paper covered cookie sheets. If desired sprinkle with sea salt. Allow to set.", "Store in airtight containers."]

title: Whitney’S Bbq Sauce
ingredients: ["1 cup Apple Or Apricot Jelly", "2 Tablespoons Apple Cider Vinegar ( You Can Use White Vinegar In A Pinch)", "1 cup Ketchup", "2 Tablespoons Chili Powder", "1 teaspoon Granulated Black Pepper"]
directions: ["Whisk all ingredients together in a 2-quart sauce pot. Cook on top of the stove on medium heat just until boiling. Boil for about 1 minute. Pour over any kind of meat and enjoy!"]

title: Easy Pleasy Ice Cream
ingredients: ["2 cans Condensed Milk", "1 bottle (2-liter Size) Root Beer Or Orange Soda"]
directions: ["Mix condensed milk and soda. Pour and prepare in ice cream freezer of choice.", "Feel free to change up the flavors. We love using orange, root beer and strawberry soda."]

title: Easy Cream Spinach
ingredients: ["Butter Or Margarine For Sauteing", "1 Med. Onion, Coarsely, Chopped", "1 Large Can Of Spinach Or 2 Regular Cans", "1 carton (small), Around A Half A Cup Of Sour Cream"]
directions: ["Take a small to med. size sauce pan and melt enough butter or margarine to saute' your chopped onion. I like a little crunch, so I usually saute' them until they are just barely translucent.", "While your onions are sauteing, you will need to drain your spinach. (You can use frozen, spinach but I find that canned spinach actually works better). Get as much of the water out as you can.", "When your onions are ready, dump in your spinach and mix well. Then add the sour cream, mixing well.", "Cook this on low to med. heat. Heat until you start to see bubbles. It won't take long. That's it. This is probably one of my most favorite ways to eat spinach. My family loves it. Enjoy."]

title: White Chocolate Peppermint Bark
ingredients: ["1/2 cups Peppermint Candy, Crushed", "12 ounces, weight Quality White Chocolate, Chopped", "1/2 teaspoons Peppermint Extract"]
directions: ["Line a cookie sheet with parchment paper or use a silicone mat. Place peppermint candy in a plastic bag. With a kitchen mallet, break up the candy into small pieces.", "Using a double boiler method, melt the white chocolate, stirring slowly until smooth. Remove from heat and quickly mix in the candy and extract. Pour melted chocolate onto the cookie sheet. Using a rubber spatula, spread out the chocolate evenly across the parchment paper until it is approximately 1/4 inch thick. Holding each side of the cookie sheet, lightly rap on the counter to remove any possible air bubbles. Set aside the cookie sheet in a cool area and allow 2-3 hours to harden. Once firm, break the bark into large pieces and serve. Bark should be stored in airtight containers to maintain freshness."]

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Fudge
ingredients: ["35 whole Mini Reese's Peanut Butter Cups", "1 bag (12 Oz. Size) Semi-Sweet Chocolate Chips", "1 can (14 Oz. Size) Sweetened Condensed Milk"]
directions: ["Line an 8 x 8 baking dish with foil and spray it well with unflavored cooking spray. Place 25 of the mini peanut butter cups in the bottom of the baking dish in rows of 5. Take the 10 remaining peanut butter cups and roughly chop them into little pieces. Set the roughly chopped cups aside. Then combine the chocolate chips and sweetened condensed milk in a medium saucepan and heat it up over medium heat. Let them both melt together while you stir with a heat proof spatula often until the mixture is shiny and smooth.", "Work quickly to pour that chocolate mixture over the peanut butter cups in the baking dish and even it out with the spatula. Sprinkle the chopped peanut butter cups evenly on top and press them into the chocolate so that they stick. Set the dish in the refrigerator to chill and set for at least 2 hours. Then cut it into 30 squares by making 4 even cuts down one side and 5 cuts going the other way. Serve and enjoy! Keep any leftovers stored in a container in the refrigerator, it will keep for a couple of days."]

title: Watermelon Infused Tequila Spicy Margarita
ingredients: ["4 slices Jalapeno, Divided", "1/2 ounces, fluid Lime Juice", "Ice, As Needed", "2 ounces, fluid Watermelon Infused Tequila", "1 ounce, fluid Cointreau", "Salt, For Rimming"]
directions: ["Put 2 slices jalapeno into shaker. Add lime and muddle. Add ice, followed by tequila and Cointreau.", "Use spent lime to moisten rim of a lowball glass. Salt rim and fill the same glass with ice.", "Shake cocktail in the shaker for about 30 seconds and strain into ice-filled glass. Garnish with remaining jalapeno slices."]

title: Vanilla Icing
ingredients: ["2 cups Sifted Powdered Sugar", "4 Tablespoons Butter, Melted", "1 teaspoon Vanilla", "3 Tablespoons Milk"]
directions: ["Combine the ingredients with enough milk to the desired consistency.", "To frost the Apple Pancake Cupcakes, place the frosting in a zip top bag, cut the tip off, and place a nice sized blob on top of the cupcake. It will spread out a bit over the next few minutes."]

title: Chipotle Brown Sugar Candied Bacon
ingredients: ["3/4 cups Packed Dark Brown Sugar", "3/4 teaspoons Smoked Chipotle Chili Powder, Or More To Taste", "1 pound Thickly Sliced Bacon"]
directions: ["Preheat oven to 350\u00b0F.", "In a small bowl, evenly mix dark brown sugar and chipotle chili powder (3/4 teaspoon chipotle chili powder produces a mild heat and 1 to 11/4 teaspoons produces a medium heat). If you really love spicy food you could add more, but be careful!", "On a large plate, rub brown sugar mixture onto both sides of each slice of bacon. The brown sugar should coat the bacon, but it shouldn't be caked on. If you over-apply the sugar it will drip and burn when you cook it.", "Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil to make clean-up easier later. Place an oven safe baking rack on the lined baking sheet. Next, evenly arrange the bacon on the baking rack so that it's touching, but not overlapping.", "Bake in a 350\u00b0F oven for 40-45 minutes. Do not flip the bacon. The bacon is done once it starts to appear crispy. Different people like their bacon cooked to different levels of doneness so adjust the cooking time to appeal to your particular preference.", "Once cooked, allow the bacon to cool for 5 minutes and then place it on a plate or a piece of wax paper so that it can cool without sticking to the baking rack. Take care not to burn yourself on the hot sugar. Do not place the bacon onto paper towels as the candied brown sugar will stick to it. Enjoy after the bacon has cooled for 5 more minutes or serve at room temperature."]

title: Lemonade Strawberries
ingredients: ["2 pints Small Strawberries, Whole Or Halved, Stemmed And Hulled", "1 whole Small Lemon, Zest And Juice", "2 teaspoons Sugar", "1 bunch Fresh Mint Leaves, Torn Or Shredded"]
directions: ["1. Toss the strawberries with the lemon and sugar in a serving bowl.", "2. Let stand for a few minutes, then stir in the mint and serve. I served mine with a lil' Cool Whip."]

title: Whipped Cream
ingredients: ["1 cup Heavy Cream", "1 Tablespoon Granulated Sugar Or 1 1/2 Tablespoons Powdered Sugar", "1/4 teaspoons Vanilla Extract", "1 dash Salt"]
directions: ["Chill a glass or metal mixing bowl and whisk attachment in the freezer for at least 5 minutes.", "Add cream to bowl and beat on high speed, using the whisk attachment, for about 30-40 seconds or until frothy. Add sugar, vanilla and salt and beat on high speed for another minute, or until stiff peaks are formed.", "Serve with French toast, waffles, pancakes, ice cream or dessert of choice."]

title: Watermelon Smoothie
ingredients: ["2 cups Seedless Watermelon Cubes", "1 cup Ice", "1 cup Sugar"]
directions: ["Put ingredients into a blender and blend on \"ice chop\" setting until blended. Pour into tall glasses and serve right away. You can even slice a piece of watermelon and stick it on the top of the glass as garnish."]

title: Watermelon Mojito Granita
